 277: 
 278: ## 3. Render Modes
 279: 
 280: ### InteractiveAuto (Default)
 281: 
 282: The application uses `InteractiveAuto` render mode:
 283: 
 284: ```razor
 285: @* In App.razor or page *@
 286: @rendermode InteractiveAuto
 287: ```
 288: 
 289: **Behavior**:
 290: 1. **First Visit**: Renders on server via SignalR (fast initial load)
 291: 2. **Background**: WASM runtime downloads in background
 292: 3. **Subsequent**: Client-side rendering (better performance)
 293: 
 294: ### When to Use Different Modes
 295: 
 296: | Mode | Use Case |
 297: |------|----------|
 298: | `InteractiveServer` | Real-time data, admin dashboards |
 299: | `InteractiveWebAssembly` | Offline-capable, compute-heavy UI |
 300: | `InteractiveAuto` | Default for most pages |
 301: | Static SSR | Simple content pages |
 302: 
 303: ### Declaring Render Mode
 304: 
 305: **Page-level**:
 306: ```razor
 307: @page "/events"
 308: @rendermode InteractiveAuto
 309: 
 310: <PageTitle>Events</PageTitle>
 311: ```
 312: 
 313: **Component-level**:
 314: ```razor
 315: <EventSessionManager @rendermode="InteractiveServer" EventId="@eventId" />
 316: ```
 317: 
 318: ---
 319: 
 320: ## 4. Service Layer Architecture
 321: 
 322: ### Interface-Based Design
 323: 
 324: All services implement an interface for testability.
 325: 
 326: **Generic Template:**
 327: 
 328: ```csharp
 329: // Interface definition
 330: public interface I{Entity}Service
 331: {
 332:     Task<ICollection<{Entity}ListDto>> GetAll{Entities}Async();
 333:     Task<{Entity}Dto?> Get{Entity}ByIdAsync({IdType} {entity}Id);
 334:     Task<BaseCommandResponse<{IdType}>?> Create{Entity}Async(Create{Entity}Dto dto);
 335:     Task<bool> Delete{Entity}Async({IdType} {entity}Id);
 336: }
 337: 
 338: // Implementation
 339: public class {Entity}Service : I{Entity}Service
 340: {
 341:     private readonly I{Entity}ApiClient _apiClient;
 342:     private readonly ILogger<{Entity}Service> _logger;
 343: 
 344:     public {Entity}Service(I{Entity}ApiClient apiClient, ILogger<{Entity}Service> logger)
 345:     {
 346:         _apiClient = apiClient ?? throw new ArgumentNullException(nameof(apiClient));
 347:         _logger = logger ?? throw new ArgumentNullException(nameof(logger));
 348:     }
 349: 
 350:     public async Task<ICollection<{Entity}ListDto>> GetAll{Entities}Async()
 351:     {
 352:         try
 353:         {
 354:             _logger.LogInformation("[{ENTITY} SERVICE] Fetching all {entities}...");
 355:             var response = await _apiClient.{Entity}GETAsync(pageNumber: 1, pageSize: 100);
 356:             return response?.Items ?? new List<{Entity}ListDto>();
 357:         }
 358:         catch (ApiException ex)
 359:         {
 360:             _logger.LogError(ex, "[{ENTITY} SERVICE] API error: {StatusCode}", ex.StatusCode);
 361:             return new List<{Entity}ListDto>();
 362:         }
 363:     }
 364: }
 365: ```
 366: 
 367: **Implementation Example: ISLAMU Event**
 368: 
 369: ```csharp
 370: // Interface definition
 371: public interface IEventService
 372: {
 373:     Task<ICollection<EventListDto>> GetAllEventsAsync();
 374:     Task<EventDto?> GetEventByIdAsync(Guid eventId);
 375:     Task<BaseCommandResponseOfGuid?> CreateEventAsync(CreateEventDto dto);
 376:     Task<bool> DeleteEventAsync(Guid eventId);
 377: }
 378: 
 379: // Implementation
 380: public class EventService : IEventService
 381: {
 382:     private readonly IEventApiClient _apiClient;
 383:     private readonly ILogger<EventService> _logger;
 384: 
 385:     public EventService(IEventApiClient apiClient, ILogger<EventService> logger)
 386:     {
 387:         _apiClient = apiClient ?? throw new ArgumentNullException(nameof(apiClient));
 388:         _logger = logger ?? throw new ArgumentNullException(nameof(logger));
 389:     }
 390: 
 391:     public async Task<ICollection<EventListDto>> GetAllEventsAsync()
 392:     {
 393:         try
 394:         {
 395:             _logger.LogInformation("[EVENT SERVICE] Fetching all events...");
 396:             var response = await _apiClient.EventGETAsync(pageNumber: 1, pageSize: 100);
 397:             return response?.Items ?? new List<EventListDto>();
 398:         }
 399:         catch (ApiException ex)
 400:         {
 401:             _logger.LogError(ex, "[EVENT SERVICE] API error: {StatusCode}", ex.StatusCode);
 402:             return new List<EventListDto>();
 403:         }
 404:     }
 405: }
 406: ```
 407: 
 408: ### Service Registration
 409: 
 410: Services are registered in `Program.cs`.
 411: 
 412: **Generic Template:**
 413: 
 414: ```csharp
 415: // {Project}.Blazor/Program.cs
 416: builder.Services.AddScoped<I{Entity}Service, {Entity}Service>();
 417: builder.Services.AddScoped<I{RelatedEntity}Service, {RelatedEntity}Service>();
 418: builder.Services.AddScoped<ICategoryService, CategoryService>();
 419: builder.Services.AddScoped<IAuthStateService, AuthStateService>();
 420: // ... etc
 421: ```
 422: 
 423: **Implementation Example: ISLAMU Event**
 424: 
 425: ```csharp
 426: // Explore.Blazor/Program.cs
 427: builder.Services.AddScoped<IEventService, EventService>();
 428: builder.Services.AddScoped<IOrganizationService, OrganizationService>();
 429: builder.Services.AddScoped<ICategoryService, CategoryService>();
 430: builder.Services.AddScoped<IAuthStateService, AuthStateService>();
 431: // ... etc
 432: ```
 433: 
 434: ### NSwag API Client
 435: 
 436: The API client is auto-generated from OpenAPI spec.
 437: 
 438: **Generic Template:**
 439: 
 440: ```csharp
 441: // Configured in Program.cs
 442: builder.Services.AddHttpClient<I{Entity}ApiClient, {Entity}ApiClient>(client =>
 443:     {
 444:         client.BaseAddress = new Uri({project}ApiBaseUrl);
 445:     })
 446:     .AddHttpMessageHandler<AccessTokenForwardingHandler>()
 447:     .ConfigurePrimaryHttpMessageHandler(() => new HttpClientHandler
 448:     {
 449:         // Dev SSL handling if needed
 450:     });
 451: ```
 452: 
 453: **Implementation Example: ISLAMU Event**
 454: 
 455: ```csharp
 456: // Configured in Program.cs
 457: builder.Services.AddHttpClient<IEventApiClient, EventApiClient>(client =>
 458:     {
 459:         client.BaseAddress = new Uri(exploreApiBaseUrl);
 460:     })
 461:     .AddHttpMessageHandler<AccessTokenForwardingHandler>()
 462:     .ConfigurePrimaryHttpMessageHandler(() => new HttpClientHandler
 463:     {
 464:         // Dev SSL handling if needed
 465:     });
 466: ```

 469: 
 470: ## 5. Component Patterns
 471: 
 472: ### Page Components
 473: 
 474: Page components are routable and typically:
 475: 1. Load data in `OnInitializedAsync`
 476: 2. Manage local state
 477: 3. Delegate to services for API calls
 478: 
 479: **Generic Template:**
 480: 
 481: ```razor
 482: @page "/{entities}"
 483: @inject I{Entity}Service {Entity}Service
 484: @inject ILogger<{Entity}List> Logger
 485: 
 486: <PageTitle>{Entities}</PageTitle>
 487: 
 488: @if (_isLoading)
 489: {
 490:     <MudProgressCircular Indeterminate="true" />
 491: }
 492: else
 493: {
 494:     @foreach (var item in _{entities})
 495:     {
 496:         <{Entity}Card {Entity}="@item" />
 497:     }
 498: }
 499: 
 500: @code {
 501:     private bool _isLoading = true;
 502:     private ICollection<{Entity}ListDto> _{entities} = new List<{Entity}ListDto>();
 503: 
 504:     protected override async Task OnInitializedAsync()
 505:     {
 506:         try
 507:         {
 508:             _{entities} = await {Entity}Service.GetAll{Entities}Async();
 509:         }
 510:         catch (Exception ex)
 511:         {
 512:             Logger.LogError(ex, "Error loading {entities}");
 513:         }
 514:         finally
 515:         {
 516:             _isLoading = false;
 517:         }
 518:     }
 519: }
 520: ```
 521: 
 522: **Implementation Example: ISLAMU Event**
 523: 
 524: ```razor
 525: @page "/events"
 526: @inject IEventService EventService
 527: @inject ILogger<EventList> Logger
 528: 
 529: <PageTitle>Explore Events</PageTitle>
 530: 
 531: @if (_isLoading)
 532: {
 533:     <MudProgressCircular Indeterminate="true" />
 534: }
 535: else
 536: {
 537:     @foreach (var evt in _events)
 538:     {
 539:         <EventCard Event="@evt" />
 540:     }
 541: }
 542: 
 543: @code {
 544:     private bool _isLoading = true;
 545:     private ICollection<EventListDto> _events = new List<EventListDto>();
 546: 
 547:     protected override async Task OnInitializedAsync()
 548:     {
 549:         try
 550:         {
 551:             _events = await EventService.GetAllEventsAsync();
 552:         }
 553:         catch (Exception ex)
 554:         {
 555:             Logger.LogError(ex, "Error loading events");
 556:         }
 557:         finally
 558:         {
 559:             _isLoading = false;
 560:         }
 561:     }
 562: }
 563: ```
 564: 
 565: ### Reusable Components
 566: 
 567: Components receive data via parameters and emit events.
 568: 
 569: **Generic Template:**
 570: 
 571: ```razor
 572: @* {Entity}Card.razor *@
 573: <MudCard Class="{entity}-card">
 574:     <MudCardContent>
 575:         <MudText Typo="Typo.h6">@{Entity}.Title</MudText>
 576:     </MudCardContent>
 577:     <MudCardActions>
 578:         <MudButton OnClick="@(() => OnViewDetails.InvokeAsync({Entity}.Id))">
 579:             View Details
 580:         </MudButton>
 581:     </MudCardActions>
 582: </MudCard>
 583: 
 584: @code {
 585:     [Parameter, EditorRequired]
 586:     public {Entity}ListDto {Entity} { get; set; } = null!;
 587: 
 588:     [Parameter]
 589:     public EventCallback<{IdType}> OnViewDetails { get; set; }
 590: }
 591: ```
 592: 
 593: **Implementation Example: ISLAMU Event**
 594: 
 595: ```razor
 596: @* EventCard.razor *@
 597: <MudCard Class="event-card">
 598:     <MudCardContent>
 599:         <MudText Typo="Typo.h6">@Event.Title</MudText>
 600:     </MudCardContent>
 601:     <MudCardActions>
 602:         <MudButton OnClick="@(() => OnViewDetails.InvokeAsync(Event.Id))">
 603:             View Details
 604:         </MudButton>
 605:     </MudCardActions>
 606: </MudCard>
 607: 
 608: @code {
 609:     [Parameter, EditorRequired]
 610:     public EventListDto Event { get; set; } = null!;
 611: 
 612:     [Parameter]
 613:     public EventCallback<Guid> OnViewDetails { get; set; }
 614: }
 615: ```
 616: 
 617: ### Parameter Conventions
 618: 
 619: | Convention | Example |
 620: |------------|---------|
 621: | Required parameters | `[Parameter, EditorRequired]` |
 622: | Nullable parameters | `[Parameter] public Guid? ParentId { get; set; }` |
 623: | Event callbacks | `[Parameter] public EventCallback<T> OnChanged { get; set; }` |
 624: | Cascading values | `[CascadingParameter] public Task<AuthenticationState> AuthState { get; set; }` |
 625: 
 626: ---
 627: 
 628: ## 6. MudBlazor Usage
 629: 
 630: ### Required Providers
 631: 
 632: In `MainLayout.razor`:
 633: 
 634: ```razor
 635: <MudThemeProvider Theme="@_theme" IsDarkMode="@_isDarkMode" />
 636: <MudPopoverProvider />
 637: <MudDialogProvider />
 638: <MudSnackbarProvider />
 639: ```
 640: 
 641: ### Common Components
 642: 
 643: **Data Display**:
 644: ```razor
 645: @* DataGrid with CRUD *@
 646: <MudDataGrid T="EventSessionListDto" Items="@sessions"
 647:              ReadOnly="false" EditMode="DataGridEditMode.Cell"
 648:              Bordered="true" Dense="true" Hover="true">
 649:     <Columns>
 650:         <PropertyColumn Property="x => x.Title" />
 651:         <PropertyColumn Property="x => x.StartTime" Format="s" />
 652:         <TemplateColumn StickyRight="true">
 653:             <CellTemplate>
 654:                 <MudIconButton Icon="@Icons.Material.Filled.Edit"
 655:                                OnClick="@(() => Edit(context.Item))" />
 656:             </CellTemplate>
 657:         </TemplateColumn>
 658:     </Columns>
 659: </MudDataGrid>
 660: ```
 661: 
 662: **Forms**:
 663: ```razor
 664: <MudForm @ref="_form" @bind-IsValid="@_isValid">
 665:     <MudTextField @bind-Value="model.Title"
 666:                   Label="Title"
 667:                   Required="true"
 668:                   RequiredError="Title is required" />
 669: 
 670:     <MudSelect @bind-Value="model.CategoryId"
 671:                Label="Category"
 672:                AnchorOrigin="Origin.BottomCenter">
 673:         @foreach (var cat in categories)
 674:         {
 675:             <MudSelectItem Value="@cat.Id">@cat.FullName</MudSelectItem>
 676:         }
 677:     </MudSelect>
 678: 
 679:     <MudDatePicker @bind-Date="model.StartDate"
 680:                    Label="Start Date" />
 681: </MudForm>
 682: ```
 683: 
 684: **Feedback**:
 685: ```razor
 686: @inject ISnackbar Snackbar
 687: 
 688: @code {
 689:     private async Task SaveAsync()
 690:     {
 691:         var result = await Service.CreateAsync(model);
 692:         if (result?.Success == true)
 693:         {
 694:             Snackbar.Add("Created successfully!", Severity.Success);
 695:         }
 696:         else
 697:         {
 698:             Snackbar.Add(result?.Message ?? "Error", Severity.Error);
 699:         }
 700:     }
 701: }
 702: ```

 705: 
 706: ## 7. State Management
 707: 
 708: ### Local Component State
 709: 
 710: For simple state, use private fields.
 711: 
 712: **Generic Template:**
 713: 
 714: ```csharp
 715: @code {
 716:     private bool _isLoading = true;
 717:     private List<{Entity}ListDto> _{entities} = new();
 718:     private string _searchText = "";
 719: }
 720: ```
 721: 
 722: **Implementation Example: ISLAMU Event**
 723: 
 724: ```csharp
 725: @code {
 726:     private bool _isLoading = true;
 727:     private List<EventListDto> _events = new();
 728:     private string _searchText = "";
 729: }
 730: ```
 731: 
 732: ### Cascading Values
 733: 
 734: For state shared across component tree:
 735: 
 736: ```razor
 737: @* In parent *@
 738: <CascadingValue Value="@_currentTenant" Name="CurrentTenant">
 739:     @Body
 740: </CascadingValue>
 741: 
 742: @* In child *@
 743: @code {
 744:     [CascadingParameter(Name = "CurrentTenant")]
 745:     public TenantDto? CurrentTenant { get; set; }
 746: }
 747: ```
 748: 
 749: ### AuthStateService
 750: 
 751: Centralized authentication state:
 752: 
 753: ```csharp
 754: public interface IAuthStateService
 755: {
 756:     Task<string> GetCurrentUserIdAsync();
 757:     Task<Guid> GetCurrentTenantIdAsync();
 758:     Task<bool> IsAuthenticatedAsync();
 759: }
 760: 
 761: // Usage in component
 762: @inject IAuthStateService AuthState
 763: 
 764: @code {
 765:     private async Task LoadUserDataAsync()
 766:     {
 767:         if (await AuthState.IsAuthenticatedAsync())
 768:         {
 769:             var userId = await AuthState.GetCurrentUserIdAsync();
 770:             // Load user-specific data
 771:         }
 772:     }
 773: }
 774: ```

 777: 
 778: ## 8. Pagination Patterns
 779: 
 780: ### Client-Side Pagination
 781: 
 782: For smaller datasets (< 1000 items), load all and paginate client-side.
 783: 
 784: **Generic Template:**
 785: 
 786: ```razor
 787: <MudPagination Count="@TotalPages"
 788:                Selected="@_currentPage"
 789:                SelectedChanged="@OnPageChanged"
 790:                Color="Color.Primary"
 791:                ShowFirstButton="true"
 792:                ShowLastButton="true" />
 793: 
 794: <MudText Typo="Typo.body2">
 795:     Showing @((_currentPage - 1) * _pageSize + 1) -
 796:     @(Math.Min(_currentPage * _pageSize, _allItems.Count))
 797:     of @_allItems.Count items
 798: </MudText>
 799: 
 800: @code {
 801:     private int _currentPage = 1;
 802:     private int _pageSize = 10;
 803:     private List<{Entity}ListDto> _allItems = new();
 804: 
 805:     private List<{Entity}ListDto> PagedItems => _allItems
 806:         .Skip((_currentPage - 1) * _pageSize)
 807:         .Take(_pageSize)
 808:         .ToList();
 809: 
 810:     private int TotalPages => _allItems.Count > 0
 811:         ? (int)Math.Ceiling((double)_allItems.Count / _pageSize)
 812:         : 1;
 813: 
 814:     private void OnPageChanged(int page)
 815:     {
 816:         _currentPage = page;
 817:     }
 818: }
 819: ```
 820: 
 821: **Implementation Example: ISLAMU Event**
 822: 
 823: ```razor
 824: @code {
 825:     private int _currentPage = 1;
 826:     private int _pageSize = 10;
 827:     private List<EventListDto> _allItems = new();
 828: 
 829:     private List<EventListDto> PagedItems => _allItems
 830:         .Skip((_currentPage - 1) * _pageSize)
 831:         .Take(_pageSize)
 832:         .ToList();
 833: 
 834:     private int TotalPages => _allItems.Count > 0
 835:         ? (int)Math.Ceiling((double)_allItems.Count / _pageSize)
 836:         : 1;
 837: 
 838:     private void OnPageChanged(int page)
 839:     {
 840:         _currentPage = page;
 841:     }
 842: }
 843: ```
 844: 
 845: ### Server-Side Pagination
 846: 
 847: For large datasets, use API pagination.
 848: 
 849: **Generic Template:**
 850: 
 851: ```csharp
 852: // Service method
 853: public async Task<PagedResult<{Entity}ListDto>> Get{Entities}PagedAsync(int page, int pageSize)
 854: {
 855:     var response = await _apiClient.{Entity}GETAsync(pageNumber: page, pageSize: pageSize);
 856:     return new PagedResult<{Entity}ListDto>
 857:     {
 858:         Items = response?.Items?.ToList() ?? new List<{Entity}ListDto>(),
 859:         TotalCount = response?.TotalCount ?? 0,
 860:         PageNumber = page,
 861:         PageSize = pageSize
 862:     };
 863: }
 864: ```
 865: 
 866: ```razor
 867: @code {
 868:     private int _currentPage = 1;
 869:     private int _pageSize = 10;
 870:     private int _totalCount = 0;
 871:     private List<{Entity}ListDto> _items = new();
 872: 
 873:     protected override async Task OnInitializedAsync()
 874:     {
 875:         await LoadPageAsync(_currentPage);
 876:     }
 877: 
 878:     private async Task LoadPageAsync(int page)
 879:     {
 880:         var result = await {Entity}Service.Get{Entities}PagedAsync(page, _pageSize);
 881:         _items = result.Items;
 882:         _totalCount = result.TotalCount;
 883:         _currentPage = page;
 884:     }
 885: 
 886:     private int TotalPages => _totalCount > 0
 887:         ? (int)Math.Ceiling((double)_totalCount / _pageSize)
 888:         : 1;
 889: 
 890:     private async Task OnPageChanged(int page)
 891:     {
 892:         await LoadPageAsync(page);
 893:     }
 894: }
 895: ```
 896: 
 897: **Implementation Example: ISLAMU Event**
 898: 
 899: ```csharp
 900: // Service method
 901: public async Task<PagedResult<EventListDto>> GetEventsPagedAsync(int page, int pageSize)
 902: {
 903:     var response = await _apiClient.EventGETAsync(pageNumber: page, pageSize: pageSize);
 904:     return new PagedResult<EventListDto>
 905:     {
 906:         Items = response?.Items?.ToList() ?? new List<EventListDto>(),
 907:         TotalCount = response?.TotalCount ?? 0,
 908:         PageNumber = page,
 909:         PageSize = pageSize
 910:     };
 911: }
 912: ```
 913: 
 914: ```razor
 915: @code {
 916:     private int _currentPage = 1;
 917:     private int _pageSize = 10;
 918:     private int _totalCount = 0;
 919:     private List<EventListDto> _items = new();
 920: 
 921:     protected override async Task OnInitializedAsync()
 922:     {
 923:         await LoadPageAsync(_currentPage);
 924:     }
 925: 
 926:     private async Task LoadPageAsync(int page)
 927:     {
 928:         var result = await EventService.GetEventsPagedAsync(page, _pageSize);
 929:         _items = result.Items;
 930:         _totalCount = result.TotalCount;
 931:         _currentPage = page;
 932:     }
 933: 
 934:     private int TotalPages => _totalCount > 0
 935:         ? (int)Math.Ceiling((double)_totalCount / _pageSize)
 936:         : 1;
 937: 
 938:     private async Task OnPageChanged(int page)
 939:     {
 940:         await LoadPageAsync(page);
 941:     }
 942: }
 943: ```
 944: 
 945: ### Filtering with Pagination
 946: 
 947: When filters change, reset to page 1.
 948: 
 949: **Generic Template:**
 950: 
 951: ```razor
 952: @code {
 953:     private {IdType}? _selectedCategoryId;
 954:     private string _searchText = "";
 955: 
 956:     private async Task OnCategoryChanged({IdType}? categoryId)
 957:     {
 958:         _selectedCategoryId = categoryId;
 959:         _currentPage = 1;  // Reset to first page
 960:         await ApplyFiltersAsync();
 961:     }
 962: 
 963:     private void OnSearch(string value)
 964:     {
 965:         _searchText = value;
 966:         _currentPage = 1;  // Reset to first page
 967:     }
 968: 
 969:     private List<{Entity}ListDto> FilteredItems => _allItems
 970:         .Where(e => string.IsNullOrEmpty(_searchText) ||
 971:                     e.Title.Contains(_searchText, StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase))
 972:         .Where(e => !_selectedCategoryId.HasValue ||
 973:                     e.CategoryId == _selectedCategoryId.Value)
 974:         .ToList();
 975: }
 976: ```
 977: 
 978: **Implementation Example: ISLAMU Event**
 979: 
 980: ```razor
 981: @code {
 982:     private Guid? _selectedCategoryId;
 983:     private string _searchText = "";
 984: 
 985:     private async Task OnCategoryChanged(Guid? categoryId)
 986:     {
 987:         _selectedCategoryId = categoryId;
 988:         _currentPage = 1;  // Reset to first page
 989:         await ApplyFiltersAsync();
 990:     }
 991: 
 992:     private void OnSearch(string value)
 993:     {
 994:         _searchText = value;
 995:         _currentPage = 1;  // Reset to first page
 996:     }
 997: 
 998:     private List<EventListDto> FilteredItems => _allItems
 999:         .Where(e => string.IsNullOrEmpty(_searchText) ||
1000:                     e.Title.Contains(_searchText, StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase))
1001:         .Where(e => !_selectedCategoryId.HasValue ||
1002:                     e.CategoryId == _selectedCategoryId.Value)
1003:         .ToList();
1004: }
1005: ```

1009: ## 9. Dialog Patterns
1010: 
1011: ### Creating Dialogs
1012: 
1013: ```razor
1014: @* CreateCategoryDialog.razor *@
1015: <MudDialog>
1016:     <DialogContent>
1017:         <MudForm @ref="_form" @bind-IsValid="@_isValid">
1018:             <MudTextField @bind-Value="_model.FullName"
1019:                           Label="Name" Required="true" />
1020:         </MudForm>
1021:     </DialogContent>
1022:     <DialogActions>
1023:         <MudButton OnClick="Cancel">Cancel</MudButton>
1024:         <MudButton Color="Color.Primary"
1025:                    Disabled="@(!_isValid)"
1026:                    OnClick="Submit">Create</MudButton>
1027:     </DialogActions>
1028: </MudDialog>
1029: 
1030: @code {
1031:     [CascadingParameter]
1032:     private MudDialogInstance MudDialog { get; set; } = null!;
1033: 
1034:     private MudForm _form = null!;
1035:     private bool _isValid;
1036:     private CreateCategoryDto _model = new();
1037: 
1038:     private void Cancel() => MudDialog.Cancel();
1039: 
1040:     private void Submit() => MudDialog.Close(DialogResult.Ok(_model));
1041: }
1042: ```
1043: 
1044: ### Opening Dialogs
1045: 
1046: ```csharp
1047: @inject IDialogService DialogService
1048: 
1049: @code {
1050:     private async Task OpenCreateDialogAsync()
1051:     {
1052:         var options = new DialogOptions
1053:         {
1054:             CloseOnEscapeKey = true,
1055:             MaxWidth = MaxWidth.Small,
1056:             FullWidth = true
1057:         };
1058: 
1059:         var dialog = await DialogService.ShowAsync<CreateCategoryDialog>(
1060:             "Create Category",
1061:             options);
1062: 
1063:         var result = await dialog.Result;
1064: 
1065:         if (!result.Canceled)
1066:         {
1067:             var newCategory = (CreateCategoryDto)result.Data;
1068:             await SaveCategoryAsync(newCategory);
1069:         }
1070:     }
1071: }
1072: ```
1073: 
1074: ### Dialogs with Parameters
1075: 
1076: ```csharp
1077: var parameters = new DialogParameters
1078: {
1079:     { "EventId", eventId },
1080:     { "Title", "Edit Event" }
1081: };
1082: 
1083: var dialog = await DialogService.ShowAsync<EditEventDialog>(
1084:     "Edit Event",
1085:     parameters,
1086:     options);
1087: ```
1088: 
1089: ### Confirmation Dialogs
1090: 
1091: ```csharp
1092: var confirmed = await DialogService.ShowMessageBox(
1093:     "Delete Item",
1094:     "Are you sure you want to delete this item?",
1095:     yesText: "Delete",
1096:     cancelText: "Cancel",
1097:     options: new DialogOptions
1098:     {
1099:         FullWidth = false,
1100:         MaxWidth = MaxWidth.ExtraSmall
1101:     }
1102: );
1103: 
1104: if (confirmed == true)
1105: {
1106:     await DeleteItemAsync(itemId);
1107: }
1108: ```
1109: 
1110: ---
1111: 
1112: ## 10. Authentication & Authorization
1113: 
1114: ### Checking Authentication State
1115: 
1116: ```razor
1117: @inject AuthenticationStateProvider AuthStateProvider
1118: 
1119: <AuthorizeView>
1120:     <Authorized>
1121:         <MudText>Welcome, @context.User.Identity?.Name!</MudText>
1122:         <MudButton Href="/logout">Logout</MudButton>
1123:     </Authorized>
1124:     <NotAuthorized>
1125:         <MudButton Href="/login">Login</MudButton>
1126:     </NotAuthorized>
1127: </AuthorizeView>
1128: ```
1129: 
1130: ### Protected Pages
1131: 
1132: ```razor
1133: @page "/my-events"
1134: @attribute [Authorize]
1135: 
1136: @* Page content only visible to authenticated users *@
1137: ```
1138: 
1139: ### Using AuthStateService
1140: 
1141: ```csharp
1142: @inject IAuthStateService AuthState
1143: 
1144: @code {
1145:     protected override async Task OnInitializedAsync()
1146:     {
1147:         if (!await AuthState.IsAuthenticatedAsync())
1148:         {
1149:             Navigation.NavigateTo("/login?returnUrl=/my-events");
1150:             return;
1151:         }
1152: 
1153:         var userId = await AuthState.GetCurrentUserIdAsync();
1154:         var tenantId = await AuthState.GetCurrentTenantIdAsync();
1155: 
1156:         // Load user-specific data
1157:     }
1158: }
1159: ```
1160: 
1161: ### User ID Claim Extraction
1162: 
1163: The `AuthStateService` uses a fallback chain:
1164: 
1165: ```csharp
1166: var userId = user.FindFirst(ClaimTypes.NameIdentifier)?.Value
1167:              ?? user.FindFirst("sub")?.Value
1168:              ?? user.FindFirst("http://schemas.xmlsoap.org/ws/2005/05/identity/claims/nameidentifier")?.Value
1169:              ?? user.FindFirst("sid")?.Value;
1170: ```
1171: 
1172: ---
1173: 
1174: ## 11. Theming
1175: 
1176: ### Theme Configuration
1177: 
1178: In `MainLayout.razor`:
1179: 
1180: ```csharp
1181: @code {
1182:     private bool _isDarkMode = false;
1183:     private MudTheme? _theme;
1184: 
1185:     protected override void OnInitialized()
1186:     {
1187:         _theme = new()
1188:         {
1189:             PaletteLight = _lightPalette,
1190:             PaletteDark = _darkPalette,
1191:             LayoutProperties = new LayoutProperties()
1192:         };
1193:     }
1194: 
1195:     private readonly PaletteLight _lightPalette = new()
1196:     {
1197:         Black = "#110e2d",
1198:         AppbarText = "#424242",
1199:         AppbarBackground = "rgba(255,255,255,0.8)",
1200:         DrawerBackground = "#ffffff",
1201:         GrayLight = "#e8e8e8",
1202:         GrayLighter = "#f9f9f9",
1203:     };
1204: 
1205:     private readonly PaletteDark _darkPalette = new()
1206:     {
1207:         Primary = "#7e6fff",
1208:         Surface = "#1e1e2d",
1209:         Background = "#1a1a27",
1210:         // ... etc
1211:     };
1212: }
1213: ```
1214: 
1215: ### Theme Persistence
1216: 
1217: Theme preference is stored in localStorage and cookie:
1218: 
1219: ```javascript
1220: // wwwroot/js/theme.js
1221: window.ExploreTheme = {
1222:     getStoredTheme: () => localStorage.getItem('theme'),
1223:     setStoredTheme: (theme) => localStorage.setItem('theme', theme),
1224:     setThemeCookie: (theme) => {
1225:         document.cookie = `theme=${theme};path=/;max-age=31536000`;
1226:     }
1227: };
1228: ```
1229: 
1230: ### Dark Mode Toggle
1231: 
1232: ```csharp
1233: private async Task DarkModeToggle()
1234: {
1235:     _isDarkMode = !_isDarkMode;
1236:     var themeValue = _isDarkMode ? "dark" : "light";
1237: 
1238:     await JSRuntime.InvokeVoidAsync("ExploreTheme.setStoredTheme", themeValue);
1239:     await JSRuntime.InvokeVoidAsync("ExploreTheme.setThemeCookie", themeValue);
1240: }
1241: ```
1242: 
1243: ---
1244: 
1245: ## 12. CSS & Styling Conventions
1246: 
1247: ### CSS Isolation Architecture
1248: 
1249: Blazor provides **CSS isolation** via `.razor.css` files that scope styles to individual components, preventing global collisions.
1250: 
1251: #### How CSS Isolation Works
1252: 
1253: **Build-Time Process**:
1254: 1. Blazor generates unique scope attribute: `b-<10-char-string>` (e.g., `b-3xxtam6d07`)
1255: 2. Appends scope attribute to all selectors in `.razor.css`
1256: 3. Applies scope attribute to rendered DOM elements
1257: 4. Bundles scoped CSS into `{Project}.styles.css`
1258: 
1259: **Example Transformation**:
1260: ```css
1261: /* Author in Counter.razor.css */
1262: h1 { color: brown; }
1263: 
1264: /* Compiled in Explore.styles.css */
1265: h1[b-3xxtam6d07] { color: brown; }
1266: ```
1267: 
1268: **Rendered HTML**:
1269: ```html
1270: <h1 b-3xxtam6d07>Counter</h1>
1271: ```
1272: 
1273: **Result**: Styles apply ONLY to component's elements, never globally.
1274: 
1275: ---
1276: 
1277: ### BEM Methodology with CSS Isolation
1278: 
1279: Use BEM (Block Element Modifier) naming **even with isolation** for explicit, maintainable styling hooks.
1280: 
1281: #### BEM Pattern Structure
1282: 
1283: ```
1284: .block
1285: .block__element
1286: .block--modifier
1287: .block__element--modifier
1288: ```
1289: 
1290: #### Component Example (EventCard)
1291: 
1292: **File Structure**:
1293: ```
1294: Components/
1295: ├── EventCard.razor
1296: └── EventCard.razor.css
1297: ```
1298: 
1299: **EventCard.razor**:
1300: ```razor
1301: <MudCard Class="event-card event-card--featured">
1302:     <MudCardHeader Class="event-card__header">
1303:         <MudText Typo="Typo.h6" Class="event-card__title">@Title</MudText>
1304:         <span class="event-card__badge event-card__badge--new">New</span>
1305:     </MudCardHeader>
1306:     <MudCardContent Class="event-card__body">
1307:         <MudText Class="event-card__description">@Description</MudText>
1308:     </MudCardContent>
1309:     <MudCardActions Class="event-card__footer">
1310:         <MudButton Class="event-card__action">Register</MudButton>
1311:     </MudCardActions>
1312: </MudCard>
1313: ```
1314: 
1315: **EventCard.razor.css** (scoped automatically):
1316: ```css
1317: /* Block */
1318: .event-card {
1319:     border-radius: 12px;
1320:     transition: box-shadow 0.2s ease;
1321: }
1322: 
1323: .event-card:hover {
1324:     box-shadow: var(--mud-elevation-4);
1325: }
1326: 
1327: /* Block modifier */
1328: .event-card--featured {
1329:     border-left: 4px solid var(--mud-palette-success);
1330: }
1331: 
1332: /* Elements */
1333: .event-card__header {
1334:     background: var(--mud-palette-surface-variant);
1335: }
1336: 
1337: .event-card__title {
1338:     font-weight: 600;
1339:     color: var(--mud-palette-primary);
1340: }
1341: 
1342: .event-card__badge {
1343:     display: inline-block;
1344:     padding: 4px 8px;
1345:     border-radius: 4px;
1346:     font-size: 0.75rem;
1347: }
1348: 
1349: /* Element modifier */
1350: .event-card__badge--new {
1351:     background: var(--mud-palette-success);
1352:     color: var(--mud-palette-success-text);
1353: }
1354: 
1355: .event-card__body {
1356:     padding: 16px;
1357: }
1358: 
1359: .event-card__description {
1360:     line-height: 1.6;
1361: }
1362: 
1363: .event-card__footer {
1364:     justify-content: flex-end;
1365: }
1366: ```
1367: 
1368: **Compiled Output** (automatic):
1369: ```css
1370: /* All selectors receive scope attribute */
1371: .event-card[b-xyz123] { ... }
1372: .event-card--featured[b-xyz123] { ... }
1373: .event-card__header[b-xyz123] { ... }
1374: /* Prevents collision with other components' .event-card */
1375: ```
1376: 
1377: ---
1378: 
1379: ### Styling Child Components
1380: 
1381: #### Pattern A: Child's Own CSS (Preferred)
1382: 
1383: Each component styles itself in its own `.razor.css`.
1384: 
1385: ```css
1386: /* Parent.razor.css */
1387: .parent {
1388:     display: grid;
1389:     gap: 16px;
1390: }
1391: 
1392: /* EventCard.razor.css (child owns its styles) */
1393: .event-card {
1394:     padding: 12px;
1395:     background: var(--mud-palette-surface);
1396: }
1397: ```
1398: 
1399: **Why**: Separation of concerns; child owns its presentation.
1400: 
1401: ---
1402: 
1403: #### Pattern B: Wrapper Container (Safe Descendant Styling)
1404: 
1405: Wrap child in HTML element to enable parent's descendant selectors.
1406: 
1407: ```razor
1408: <div class="parent">
1409:     <div class="parent__child-wrapper">
1410:         <ChildComponent />
1411:     </div>
1412: </div>
1413: ```
1414: 
1415: ```css
1416: /* Parent.razor.css */
1417: .parent__child-wrapper {
1418:     padding: 8px;
1419:     border: 1px solid var(--mud-palette-divider);
1420: }
1421: ```
1422: 
1423: **Why**: Wrapper gets scope attribute; you can style without penetrating child.
1424: 
1425: ---
1426: 
1427: #### Pattern C: The ::deep Selector (Last Resort)
1428: 
1429: **Purpose**: Penetrate child component encapsulation.
1430: 
1431: **Transformation**:
1432: ```css
1433: /* Author */
1434: .parent ::deep .child-element { color: red; }
1435: 
1436: /* Compiled */
1437: .parent[b-xyz123] .child-element { color: red; }
1438: ```
1439: 
1440: **Example** - Styling MudBlazor Component:
1441: ```css
1442: /* Host.razor.css */
1443: .host ::deep .mud-table-cell {
1444:     padding: 12px 16px;
1445: }
1446: ```
1447: 
1448: **When to Use ::deep**:
1449: - ✅ Styling third-party components with no exposed API
1450: - ✅ Overriding MudBlazor internals when necessary
1451: 
1452: **When NOT to Use ::deep**:
1453: - ❌ Styling your own child components (use child's `.razor.css`)
1454: - ❌ First resort (prefer wrapper or component parameters)
1455: 
1456: **Tradeoffs**:
1457: - ⚠️ **Fragile**: Coupled to child's internal markup
1458: - ⚠️ **Upgrade Risk**: Library updates may break selectors
1459: 
1460: ---
1461: 
1462: ### CSS Isolation File Structure
1463: 
1464: **Required Pattern**:
1465: - Place `ComponentName.razor.css` next to `ComponentName.razor`
1466: - File names must match (case-insensitive)
1467: - Reference `{Project}.styles.css` bundle in `App.razor` or `index.html`
1468: 
1469: **Example Structure**:
1470: ```
1471: Components/
1472: ├── EventList.razor
1473: ├── EventList.razor.css       ✅ Scoped to EventList
1474: ├── EventCard.razor
1475: └── EventCard.razor.css       ✅ Scoped to EventCard
1476: ```
1477: 
1478: **Bundle Reference** (`App.razor`):
1479: ```html
1480: <link href="Explore.styles.css" rel="stylesheet" />
1481: ```
1482: 
1483: ---
1484: 
1485: ### Debugging Scoped CSS
1486: 
1487: **Step 1: Inspect Element Scope Attribute**
1488: ```html
1489: <h1 b-3xxtam6d07>Counter</h1>
1490: ```
1491: 
1492: **Step 2: Find Matching Selector in DevTools**
1493: ```css
1494: h1[b-3xxtam6d07] { color: brown; }
1495: ```
1496: 
1497: **Step 3: Verify Bundle Reference**
1498: 
1499: Check `App.razor` includes:
1500: ```html
1501: <link href="Explore.styles.css" rel="stylesheet" />
1502: ```
1503: 
1504: #### Common Issues & Solutions
1505: 
1506: | Symptom | Cause | Fix |
1507: |---------|-------|-----|
1508: | Styles not applying | Missing bundle reference | Add `<link>` to `{Project}.styles.css` |
1509: | Child not styled | Using parent CSS | Add `.razor.css` to child OR use ::deep |
1510: | ::deep not working | Child renders to body | Use component's `Target` parameter |
1511: 
1512: ---
1513: 
1514: ### Global Styles
1515: 
1516: Global styles go in `wwwroot/css/app.css`:
1517: 
1518: ```css
1519: /* Custom utility classes */
1520: .isl-typo-h5 {
1521:     font-size: 1.5rem;
1522:     font-weight: 600;
1523:     line-height: 1.3;
1524: }
1525: 
1526: .isl-button-pill {
1527:     border-radius: 20px;
1528:     padding: 8px 16px;
1529:     cursor: pointer;
1530: }
1531: 
1532: .isl-popover-menu {
1533:     border-radius: 8px;
1534:     box-shadow: var(--mud-elevation-4);
1535: }
1536: 
1537: .isl-popover-menu__option {
1538:     padding: 8px 12px;
1539:     cursor: pointer;
1540:     border-radius: 4px;
1541: }
1542: 
1543: .isl-popover-menu__option:hover {
1544:     background-color: var(--mud-palette-action-default-hover);
1545: }
1546: ```
1547: 
1548: ---
1549: 
1550: ## 13. Error Handling
1551: 
1552: ### Service-Level Error Handling
1553: 
1554: ```csharp
1555: public async Task<ICollection<EventListDto>> GetAllEventsAsync()
1556: {
1557:     try
1558:     {
1559:         var response = await _apiClient.EventGETAsync(pageNumber: 1, pageSize: 100);
1560:         return response?.Items ?? new List<EventListDto>();
1561:     }
1562:     catch (ApiException ex) when (ex.StatusCode == 401)
1563:     {
1564:         _logger.LogWarning("Unauthorized access attempt");
1565:         return new List<EventListDto>();
1566:     }
1567:     catch (ApiException ex) when (ex.StatusCode == 404)
1568:     {
1569:         _logger.LogInformation("Resource not found");
1570:         return new List<EventListDto>();
1571:     }
1572:     catch (ApiException ex)
1573:     {
1574:         _logger.LogError(ex, "API error: {StatusCode}", ex.StatusCode);
1575:         return new List<EventListDto>();
1576:     }
1577:     catch (Exception ex)
1578:     {
1579:         _logger.LogError(ex, "Unexpected error");
1580:         return new List<EventListDto>();
1581:     }
1582: }
1583: ```
1584: 
1585: ### Component-Level Error Handling
1586: 
1587: ```razor
1588: @code {
1589:     private bool _hasError = false;
1590:     private string? _errorMessage;
1591: 
1592:     protected override async Task OnInitializedAsync()
1593:     {
1594:         try
1595:         {
1596:             await LoadDataAsync();
1597:         }
1598:         catch (Exception ex)
1599:         {
1600:             _hasError = true;
1601:             _errorMessage = "Failed to load data. Please try again.";
1602:             Logger.LogError(ex, "Error in OnInitializedAsync");
1603:         }
1604:     }
1605: }
1606: 
1607: @if (_hasError)
1608: {
1609:     <MudAlert Severity="Severity.Error">@_errorMessage</MudAlert>
1610:     <MudButton OnClick="RetryAsync">Retry</MudButton>
1611: }
1612: ```
1613: 
1614: ### Global Error Boundary
1615: 
1616: ```razor
1617: @* In App.razor *@
1618: <ErrorBoundary>
1619:     <ChildContent>
1620:         <Router AppAssembly="@typeof(App).Assembly">
1621:             <!-- ... -->
1622:         </Router>
1623:     </ChildContent>
1624:     <ErrorContent Context="ex">
1625:         <MudAlert Severity="Severity.Error">
1626:             An unexpected error occurred. Please refresh the page.
1627:         </MudAlert>
1628:     </ErrorContent>
1629: </ErrorBoundary>
1630: ```
1631: 
1632: ---
1633: 
1634: ## 14. Best Practices
1635: 
1636: ### DO ✅
1637: 
1638: 1. **Use service layer** - Never call `IEventApiClient` directly from components
1639: 2. **Handle loading states** - Show skeletons or spinners during data fetching
1640: 3. **Reset pagination on filter change** - Always reset to page 1
1641: 4. **Use `[EditorRequired]`** - For mandatory parameters
1642: 5. **Log appropriately** - Use structured logging with context
1643: 6. **Dispose resources** - Implement `IDisposable` when needed
1644: 7. **Use `StateHasChanged()`** - Only when necessary (after async callbacks)
1645: 
1646: ### DON'T ❌
1647: 
1648: 1. **Don't store tokens in WASM** - BFF handles token management
1649: 2. **Don't call API directly** - Use the generated NSwag client via services
1650: 3. **Don't use `Console.WriteLine`** - Use `ILogger<T>` instead
1651: 4. **Don't block with `.Result`** - Always use `await`
1652: 5. **Don't ignore errors** - Handle and log all exceptions
1653: 6. **Don't hardcode URLs** - Use configuration
1654: 
1655: ### Performance Tips
1656: 
1657: ```csharp
1658: // Use parallel loading for independent data
1659: protected override async Task OnInitializedAsync()
1660: {
1661:     var eventsTask = EventService.GetAllEventsAsync();
1662:     var categoriesTask = CategoryService.GetAllCategoriesAsync();
1663:     var tagsTask = TagService.GetAllTagsAsync();
1664: 
1665:     await Task.WhenAll(eventsTask, categoriesTask, tagsTask);
1666: 
1667:     _events = await eventsTask;
1668:     _categories = await categoriesTask;
1669:     _tags = await tagsTask;
1670: }
1671: 
1672: // Use virtualization for large lists
1673: <MudVirtualize Items="@_largeList" Context="item" OverscanCount="5">
1674:     <ItemContent>
1675:         <EventCard Event="@item" />
1676:     </ItemContent>
1677: </MudVirtualize>
1678: ```
1679:

## File: docs/DOMAIN.md
````markdown
  1: # Domain Model
  2: 
  3: > **Project-Specific Domain Reference**
  4: >
  5: > This document describes the domain model for the ISLAMU Event platform (Explore project).
  6: > While entity names are project-specific, the architectural patterns and structure can be adapted to any .NET Clean Architecture project.
  7: >
  8: > For generic architectural guidance, see [ARCHITECTURE.md](ARCHITECTURE.md) and [GOVERNANCE.md](GOVERNANCE.md).
  9: > Placeholders use `{Placeholder}` syntax - see [TEMPLATE_GLOSSARY.md](TEMPLATE_GLOSSARY.md).
 10: 
 11: ## Placeholder Substitutions
 12: 
 13: | Placeholder | Replace With | Example (ISLAMU Event) |
 14: |-------------|--------------|------------------------|
 15: | `{Project}` | Your solution name | `Explore` |
 16: | `{Project}.Domain` | Domain layer project | `Explore.Domain` |
 17: 
 18: ---
 19: 
 20: ## Overview
 21: 
 22: The domain layer (`{Project}.Domain/`) is the heart of the application, containing all business entities, enums, and value objects. It defines **what** the system is about, independent of any technical implementation details.
 23: 
 24: ### Implementation Example: ISLAMU Event
 25: The `Explore.Domain/` layer contains entities specific to Islamic event discovery and federation, including:
 26: - Multi-tenant organization and event management
 27: - ATProto federation actors and records
 28: - Islamic-specific metadata (Madhab, prayer times)
 29: - Event registration and approval workflows
 30: 
 31: For details on how these domain models are implemented using Entity Framework Core, including conventions for IDs, numeric types, default values, and link tables, refer to the **`dotnet-efcore-guidelines` skill**.
 32: 
 33: ## Core Entities
 34: 
 35: ### Tenant Management
 36: 
 37: #### Tenant
 38: *   **Purpose**: Represents a distinct client or organization within the multi-tenant system, ensuring data isolation.
 39: *   **Key Relationships**: Core of multi-tenancy; all tenant-scoped entities link to `Tenant`.
 40: *   **Associated Concepts**: `TenantUser`, `TenantSettings`.
 41: 
 42: #### TenantUser
 43: *   **Purpose**: Links a User to a specific Tenant, often with associated roles.
 44: *   **Key Relationships**: Many-to-many relationship between `User` and `Tenant`.
 45: 
 46: #### TenantSettings
 47: *   **Purpose**: Stores tenant-specific configuration and policies.
 48: *   **Key Relationships**: One-to-one relationship with `Tenant`.
 49: 
 50: #### UserRole
 51: *   **Purpose**: Defines roles users can have within a tenant (e.g., Admin, Moderator, Member).
 52: *   **Key Relationships**: Used to classify `TenantUser` permissions.
 53: 
 54: ### User Management
 55: 
 56: #### User
 57: *   **Purpose**: Represents a user account in the system.
 58: *   **Key Relationships**: Can link to an `Actor` for federation, and associated with `UserAuthenticationToken`, `UserExternalLogin`, `OrganizationMember`, `EventRegistration`.
 59: 
 60: #### UserAuthenticationToken
 61: *   **Purpose**: Stores authentication-related tokens for users (e.g., from Keycloak, ATProto OAuth).
 62: *   **Key Relationships**: Links to `User` and `Tenant`.
 63: 
 64: #### UserExternalLogin
 65: *   **Purpose**: Records external login details, such as DID (Decentralized Identifier) or private keys for ATProto OAuth.
 66: *   **Key Relationships**: Links to `User` and `Tenant`.
 67: 
 68: ### Federation (ATProto)
 69: 
 70: #### Actor
 71: *   **Purpose**: Represents a federated identity (DID) in the ATProto network. This is the core identity for all content creators and organizations.
 72: *   **Key Relationships**: Linked to `ActorType`, `DidCustodyType`, `User`.
 73: 
 74: #### ActorType
 75: *   **Purpose**: Categorizes actors (e.g., User, Organization, Service, Bot).
 76: 
 77: #### DidCustodyType
 78: *   **Purpose**: Defines who controls an Actor's DID keys (e.g., Self-Custodied, Custodial).
 79: 
 80: #### ActorKeyStore
 81: *   **Purpose**: Securely stores cryptographic keys associated with an `Actor`.
 82: *   **Key Relationships**: Links to `Actor` and `Tenant`.
 83: 
 84: #### IndexedDid
 85: *   **Purpose**: Tracks DIDs discovered and indexed from the ATProto network.
 86: 
 87: #### SyncState
 88: *   **Purpose**: Manages the synchronization progress with federation firehoses/relays.
 89: 
 90: #### AtprotoRecord
 91: *   **Purpose**: Links local entities (like `Event` or `EventRegistration`) to their corresponding records on the ATProto network.
 92: *   **Key Relationships**: Linked to entities that are federated.
 93: 
 94: ### Organization Management
 95: 
 96: #### Organization
 97: *   **Purpose**: Represents an entity that creates and manages events (e.g., a mosque, a university, a community group).
 98: *   **Key Relationships**: Linked to `ApprovalStatus`, `Actor`, and has associated `OrganizationMember`s and `OrganizationReview`s.
 99: *   **Associated Concepts**: Supports a two-tier verification system (User-Submitted vs. Verified).
100: 
101: #### OrganizationMember
102: *   **Purpose**: Represents a `User`'s membership within an `Organization`, defining their role and position.
103: *   **Key Relationships**: Links `Organization` with `User`.
104: 
105: #### OrganizationRole
106: *   **Purpose**: Defines predefined roles for `OrganizationMember`s (e.g., Owner, Admin, Member).
107: 
108: #### OrganizationPosition
109: *   **Purpose**: Defines specific positions within an `Organization` (e.g., President, Secretary).
110: 
111: #### ApprovalStatus
112: *   **Purpose**: Defines the various stages of approval for entities like `Organization`s or `EventRegistration`s (e.g., Pending, Approved, Verified).
113: 
114: #### OrganizationReview
115: *   **Purpose**: Captures community reviews and ratings for `Organization`s.
116: 
117: ### Event Management
118: 
119: #### Event
120: *   **Purpose**: The central entity representing a scheduled occurrence (e.g., a conference, webinar, workshop).
121: *   **Key Relationships**: Links to `EventType`, `AudienceGender`, `AudienceAge`, `Actor`, `EventStatus`, `VisibilityType`, `EventFormat`, `Madhab`, `StorageObject` (for featured image), and potentially `AtprotoRecord`.
122: *   **Associated Concepts**: Can have multiple `EventSession`s.
123: 
124: #### EventSession
125: *   **Purpose**: Represents a specific time slot or segment of an `Event`. Events can have one or many sessions.
126: *   **Key Relationships**: Links to `Event`, `Location`, `RegistrationMode`.
127: *   **Associated Concepts**: Can contain `EventSessionAgendaItem`s, `EventSessionSpeaker`s, `EventSessionLanguage`s, and `EventRegistration`s.
128: 
129: #### EventSessionAgendaItem
130: *   **Purpose**: Details specific activities or segments within an `EventSession` (e.g., a speaker's talk, a break).
131: *   **Key Relationships**: Links to `EventSession`, `Location`.
132: 
133: #### EventSessionSpeaker
134: *   **Purpose**: Links an `Actor` (speaker) to an `EventSession`.
135: *   **Key Relationships**: Many-to-many relationship between `Actor` and `EventSession`.
136: 
137: #### EventSessionLanguage
138: *   **Purpose**: Indicates the languages supported or used in an `EventSession`.
139: *   **Key Relationships**: Many-to-many relationship between `EventSession` and `Language`.
140: 
141: #### EventRegistration
142: *   **Purpose**: Records a `User`'s registration for an `EventSession`.
143: *   **Key Relationships**: Links to `User`, `EventSession`, `ApprovalStatus`, and potentially `AtprotoRecord`.
144: 
145: #### RegistrationMode
146: *   **Purpose**: Defines the method of registration for an `EventSession` (e.g., Open, Approval Required, Invitation Only).
147: 
148: ### Module-Specific Entity Extensions
149: 
150: The system supports **modular event types** through aspect entities that extend the base `Event` entity with domain-specific fields. This pattern allows different event types to have specialized properties while maintaining a consistent core event model.
151: 
152: #### EventIslamicAspect
153: *   **Purpose**: Extends `Event` with Islamic-specific fields for religious events (e.g., prayer times, gender segregation, madhab compatibility).
154: *   **Key Fields**:
155:     -   `PrayerTimesAvailable` (bool) - Indicates if prayer facilities are provided
156:     -   `GenderSegregated` (bool) - Indicates gender-separated seating/areas
157:     -   `MadhabFocus` - Primary Islamic jurisprudence school
158:     -   `IslamicCalendarDate` - Date in Hijri calendar
159: *   **Relationship**: One-to-one with `Event` (optional)
160: *   **Module Governance**: Enabled per-tenant via `TenantCapability` table
161: 
162: #### EventTechAspect
163: *   **Purpose**: Extends `Event` with technology-specific fields for tech conferences, workshops, and hackathons.
164: *   **Key Fields**:
165:     -   `TechStack` (string) - Primary technologies covered (e.g., ".NET, React, Azure")
166:     -   `SkillLevel` (enum) - Target audience skill level (Beginner, Intermediate, Advanced, Expert)
167:     -   `Platform` (string) - Development platform focus (Web, Mobile, Desktop, Cloud)
168:     -   `HandsOnLab` (bool) - Indicates if hands-on coding exercises included
169: *   **Relationship**: One-to-one with `Event` (optional)
170: *   **Module Governance**: Enabled per-tenant via `TenantCapability` table
171: 
172: #### Module Resolution Strategy Pattern
173: 
174: The system uses a **strategy pattern** to resolve module-specific aspects:
175: 
176: ```csharp
177: // Simplified conceptual example
178: public interface IModuleService<TEntity, TAspect>
179: {
180:     Task<TAspect?> GetAspectAsync(Guid entityId);
181:     Task SaveAspectAsync(TAspect aspect);
182: }
183: 
184: // Usage in handlers
185: var islamicAspect = await _islamicModuleService.GetAspectAsync(eventId);
186: if (islamicAspect != null)
187: {
188:     // Event has Islamic-specific data
189:     dto.PrayerTimes = islamicAspect.PrayerTimesAvailable;
190: }
191: ```
192: 
193: **Key Design Principles**:
194: -   **Opt-in Architecture**: Events don't require aspect entities. Only create aspect when needed.
195: -   **Tenant Control**: Modules are enabled/disabled per tenant via `TenantCapability` table
196: -   **Type Safety**: Each aspect has its own strongly-typed entity and DTO
197: -   **Separation of Concerns**: Core event logic remains clean; domain-specific logic in aspects
198: 
199: **See Also**: [CODEBASE_INSIGHTS.md](CODEBASE_INSIGHTS.md) Section 7 for module governance implementation details.
200: 
201: ### Event Session Hierarchy
202: 
203: The event session system supports complex, multi-session events with detailed scheduling:
204: 
205: ```
206: Event (e.g., "Annual Tech Conference 2026")
207: ├── EventSession 1 (e.g., "Day 1 - Morning Keynote")
208: │   ├── EventSessionAgendaItem 1 (e.g., "09:00 - Opening Remarks")
209: │   ├── EventSessionAgendaItem 2 (e.g., "09:30 - Keynote Speaker")
210: │   ├── EventSessionSpeaker 1 → Actor (Speaker)
211: │   ├── EventSessionSpeaker 2 → Actor (Speaker)
212: │   ├── EventSessionLanguage 1 → Language (English)
213: │   └── EventRegistration records (Users registered for this session)
214: ├── EventSession 2 (e.g., "Day 1 - Afternoon Workshop Track A")
215: │   ├── EventSessionAgendaItem 1 (e.g., "14:00 - Workshop: Clean Architecture")
216: │   ├── EventSessionSpeaker 1 → Actor (Instructor)
217: │   ├── EventSessionLanguage 1 → Language (English)
218: │   └── EventRegistration records
219: └── EventSession 3 (e.g., "Day 2 - Closing Session")
220:     └── ...
221: ```
222: 
223: **Relationships**:
224: -   **Event → EventSession**: One-to-many (an event can have multiple sessions)
225: -   **EventSession → EventSessionAgendaItem**: One-to-many (a session has a timeline of agenda items)
226: -   **EventSession → EventSessionSpeaker**: Many-to-many (a session can have multiple speakers; a speaker can appear in multiple sessions)
227: -   **EventSession → EventSessionLanguage**: Many-to-many (a session can support multiple languages)
228: -   **EventSession → EventRegistration**: One-to-many (users register for specific sessions)
229: -   **EventSession → Location**: Many-to-one (each session has a location; location can host multiple sessions)
230: -   **EventSession → RegistrationMode**: Many-to-one (defines registration requirements)
231: 
232: **Design Notes**:
233: -   Sessions provide flexibility for multi-day, multi-track events
234: -   Each session can have its own location (useful for hybrid events)
235: -   Registration is at the session level (users can attend specific sessions)
236: -   Agenda items provide detailed scheduling within a session
237: -   Speaker and language associations are session-specific (different speakers/languages per session)
238: 
239: ### Event Metadata
240: 
241: #### EventType
242: *   **Purpose**: Classifies `Event`s (e.g., Conference, Webinar, Workshop).
243: 
244: #### EventStatus
245: *   **Purpose**: Tracks the lifecycle status of an `Event` (e.g., Draft, Published, Cancelled).
246: 
247: #### VisibilityType
248: *   **Purpose**: Controls the visibility of an `Event` (e.g., Public, Private, Unlisted).
249: 
250: #### EventFormat
251: *   **Purpose**: Describes the delivery format of an `Event` (e.g., In-person, Online, Hybrid).
252: 
253: #### Madhab
254: *   **Purpose**: Classifies `Event`s or `Actor`s by Islamic jurisprudence school (e.g., Hanafi, Maliki).
255: 
256: #### AudienceAge
257: *   **Purpose**: Categorizes the target age demographic for an `Event` (e.g., Children, Youth, Adults).
258: 
259: #### AudienceGender
260: *   **Purpose**: Categorizes the target gender for an `Event` (e.g., Men-only, Women-only, Mixed).
261: 
262: #### Category
263: *   **Purpose**: Provides hierarchical categorization for `Event`s (e.g., Aqidah, Fiqh, Tafsir).
264: *   **Key Relationships**: Can be self-referencing for parent-child relationships.
265: 
266: #### EventCategories
267: *   **Purpose**: Links `Event`s to `Category`s.
268: 
269: #### Tag
270: *   **Purpose**: Provides flexible tagging for `Event`s, `Actor`s, or other entities.
271: 
272: #### TagType
273: *   **Purpose**: Classifies the type of a `Tag` (e.g., Person, Channel, Oeuvre).
274: 
275: #### TagTypeTags
276: *   **Purpose**: Links `Tag`s to `TagType`s.
277: 
278: #### EventTags
279: *   **Purpose**: Links `Event`s to `Tag`s.
280: 
281: ### Location Management
282: 
283: #### Location
284: *   **Purpose**: Defines physical or virtual locations where `EventSession`s can occur.
285: *   **Associated Concepts**: Can include geographic coordinates for spatial queries.
286: 
287: ### Storage Management
288: 
289: #### StorageObject
290: *   **Purpose**: Represents files stored in the system (e.g., images, documents).
291: *   **Key Relationships**: Links to `FileType` and `Actor` (owner).
292: 
293: #### FileType
294: *   **Purpose**: Classifies `StorageObject`s (e.g., Image, Document, Video).
295: 
296: ### Language Support
297: 
298: #### Language
299: *   **Purpose**: Represents supported human languages for `EventSession`s.
300: 
301: ## Domain Invariants
302: 
303: Domain invariants are rules that must always be true for an entity to be in a valid state. These are typically enforced within the domain entities themselves or orchestrated by the application layer.
304: 
305: *   **Event-related**: Session end time must be after start time; an event must have at least one session to be published.
306: *   **Organization-related**: Organization email must be unique within a tenant; an owner role is required for organization creation.
307: *   **Category-related**: Categories cannot form circular references in their hierarchy.
308: *   **Actor-related**: DID must be globally unique; custodial DIDs require associated keys.
309: 
310: ## Domain Events
311: 
312: Domain events are discrete occurrences within the domain that other parts of the system might need to react to.
313: 
314: *   **Event Lifecycle Events**: `EventCreated`, `EventPublished`, `EventCancelled`, `EventStarted`, `EventEnded`.
315: *   **Organization Events**: `OrganizationCreated`, `OrganizationVerified`, `OrganizationMemberAdded`.
316: *   **Registration Events**: `UserRegisteredForSession`, `RegistrationApproved`.
````

````markdown
  1: # Deployment Modes & Customization
  2: 
  3: > **Project-Agnostic Operations & Deployment Guide**
  4: >
  5: > Placeholders use `{Placeholder}` syntax - see [TEMPLATE_GLOSSARY.md](TEMPLATE_GLOSSARY.md).
  6: 
  7: ## Placeholder Substitutions
  8: 
  9: | Placeholder | Replace With | Example (ISLAMU Event) |
 10: |-------------|--------------|------------------------|
 11: | `{Project}` | Your solution name | `Explore` |
 12: | `{Project}.Infrastructure` | Infrastructure project | `Explore.Infrastructure` |
 13: | `{Instance Name}` | Your instance display name | `ISLAMU Event` |
 14: 
 15: ---
 16: 
 17: This platform is designed to be **highly customizable** to support diverse deployment scenarios—from single-organization instances to full SaaS platforms serving multiple tenants. This section covers all customization options.
 18: 
 19: ### Implementation Example: ISLAMU Event
 20: The ISLAMU Event platform (project name: Explore) is the reference implementation of this system, designed for Islamic event discovery globally.
 21: 
 22: ## Deployment Modes
 23: 
 24: The platform supports two primary deployment modes:
 25: 
 26: ```
 27: ┌─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐
 28: │                      DEPLOYMENT MODES                               │
 29: ├─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┤
 30: │                                                                     │
 31: │  MODE 1: Single-Instance Deployment                                 │
 32: │  ─────────────────────────────────────                              │
 33: │  • Multi-tenancy DISABLED                                           │
 34: │  • One organization/community per deployment                        │
 35: │  • Simpler configuration and maintenance                            │
 36: │  • Example: ISLAMU's own Islamic events instance                    │
 37: │  • Example: A university running their own event platform           │
 38: │                                                                     │
 39: │  ┌─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐    │
 40: │  │              Single Instance                                │    │
 41: │  │  ┌─────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐    │    │
 42: │  │  │  events.islamu.org                                  │    │    │
 43: │  │  │  • All events in one space                          │    │    │
 44: │  │  │  • Single admin team                                │    │    │
 45: │  │  │  • Unified branding                                 │    │    │
 46: │  │  └─────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘    │    │
 47: │  └─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘    │
 48: │                                                                     │
 49: │  MODE 2: Multi-Tenant SaaS Deployment                               │
 50: │  ────────────────────────────────────                               │
 51: │  • Multi-tenancy ENABLED                                            │
 52: │  • Multiple isolated organizations/communities                      │
 53: │  • For SaaS providers offering ISLAMU Event as a service            │
 54: │  • Each tenant has custom domain, branding, settings                │
 55: │  • Shared infrastructure, isolated data                             │
 56: │                                                                     │
 57: │  ┌─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐    │
 58: │  │              Multi-Tenant SaaS Platform                     │    │
 59: │  │  ┌───────────────┐ ┌───────────────┐ ┌───────────────┐      │    │
 60: │  │  │ Tenant A      │ │ Tenant B      │ │ Tenant C      │      │    │
 61: │  │  │ mosque-a.com  │ │ uni-events.eu │ │ community.org │      │    │
 62: │  │  │ Own settings  │ │ Own settings  │ │ Own settings  │      │    │
 63: │  │  │ Own branding  │ │ Own branding  │ │ Own branding  │      │    │
 64: │  │  └───────────────┘ └───────────────┘ └───────────────┘      │    │
 65: │  │                    Shared Infrastructure                    │    │
 66: │  └─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘    │
 67: │                                                                     │
 68: └─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘
 69: ```
 70: 
 71: ### Environment Configuration for Deployment Mode
 72: 
 73: ```yaml
 74: # docker-compose.yml
 75: services:
 76:   explore-api:
 77:     environment:
 78:       # Deployment Mode
 79:       - EXPLORE__MULTITENANCY__ENABLED=false          # true for SaaS mode
 80:       - EXPLORE__MULTITENANCY__DEFAULT_TENANT=default # Used when disabled
 81:       
 82:       # Instance Identity (Single-Instance Mode)
 83:       - EXPLORE__INSTANCE__NAME=ISLAMU Event
 84:       - EXPLORE__INSTANCE__DOMAIN=events.islamu.ngo
 85:       - EXPLORE__INSTANCE__DESCRIPTION=Islamic Event Discovery Platform
 86: ```
 87: 
 88: ## Blazor Rendering Modes
 89: 
 90: The platform supports **three Blazor rendering modes** configurable via environment variables:
 91: 
 92: | Mode | Description | Use Case |
 93: |------|-------------|----------|
 94: | **Server** | Server-side rendering | real-time updates |
 95: | **WebAssembly** | Client-side rendering in browser | Offline capability, reduced server load |
 96: | **Auto** | Server initially, then WebAssembly | Best of both worlds (recommended) |
 97: 
 98: ### Configuration
 99: 
100: ```yaml
101: # docker-compose.yml
102: services:
103:   explore-blazor:
104:     environment:
105:       # Blazor Rendering Mode: Server | WebAssembly | Auto
106:       - BLAZOR__RENDER_MODE=Auto
107:       
108:       # Additional Blazor Settings
109:       - BLAZOR__PRERENDER=true                    # Enable prerendering for SEO
110:       - BLAZOR__DETAILED_ERRORS=false             # Show detailed errors (dev only)
111:       - BLAZOR__WEBSOCKET_COMPRESSION=true        # Compress SignalR traffic
112: ```
113: 
114: ```csharp
115: // Program.cs - Runtime configuration
116: var renderMode = builder.Configuration["Blazor:RenderMode"] ?? "Auto";
117: 
118: builder.Services.AddRazorComponents()
119:     .AddInteractiveServerComponents()
120:     .AddInteractiveWebAssemblyComponents();
121: 
122: // In App.razor - Dynamic render mode
123: @code {
124:     private IComponentRenderMode RenderMode => 
125:         Configuration["Blazor:RenderMode"] switch
126:         {
127:             "Server" => RenderMode.InteractiveServer,
128:             "WebAssembly" => RenderMode.InteractiveWebAssembly,
129:             "Auto" => RenderMode.InteractiveAuto,
130:             _ => RenderMode.InteractiveAuto
131:         };
132: }
133: ```
134: 
135: ## Instance-Level Administration
136: 
137: Instance Administrators (not organization admins) can configure platform-wide behavior through the **Instance Settings** panel or environment variables.
138: 
139: ### Organization & Event Publishing Policies
140: 
141: Configurable inside the **Instance Settings** panel in the webapp for instance administrator.
142: 
143: ```
144: ┌─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐
145: │              INSTANCE-LEVEL POLICY CONFIGURATION                    │
146: ├─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┤
147: │                                                                     │
148: │  ORGANIZATION CREATION POLICY                                       │
149: │  ────────────────────────────                                       │
150: │  ┌──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐   │
151: │  │  Option A: Open Registration (Default)                       │   │
152: │  │  • Anyone can create an organization                         │   │
153: │  │  • Organizations start as "Unverified"                       │   │
154: │  │  • Can publish events immediately                            │   │
155: │  │                                                              │   │
156: │  │  Option B: Approval Required (ISLAMU Instance)               │   │
157: │  │  • Anyone can REQUEST to create an organization              │   │
158: │  │  • Instance admin must APPROVE before org is active          │   │
159: │  │  • Only approved orgs can publish events                     │   │
160: │  │                                                              │   │
161: │  │  Option C: Invite Only                                       │   │
162: │  │  • Only instance admins can create organizations             │   │
163: │  │  • Most restrictive, for curated platforms                   │   │
164: │  └──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘   │
165: │                                                                     │
166: │  USER EVENT PUBLISHING POLICY                                       │
167: │  ────────────────────────────                                       │
168: │  ┌──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐   │
169: │  │  Option A: Users Can Publish (marked as "User Reported")     │   │
170: │  │  • Individual users can post events                          │   │
171: │  │  • Events flagged with "User Reported" badge                 │   │
172: │  │  • Subject to community moderation                           │   │
173: │  │                                                              │   │
174: │  │  Option B: Users Cannot Publish Directly                     │   │
175: │  │  • Only organizations can publish events                     │   │
176: │  │  • Higher quality control                                    │   │
177: │  │                                                              │   │
178: │  │  Option C: Users Publish with Approval                       │   │
179: │  │  • Users submit events for review                            │   │
180: │  │  • Instance moderators approve before publishing             │   │
181: │  │  • Balance between openness and quality                      │   │
182: │  │                                                              │   │
183: │  │  Option D: Users Publish without approval nor verification   │   │
184: │  │  • Users submit events                                       │   │
185: │  │  • fully open                                                │   │
186: │  └──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘   │
187: │                                                                     │
188: └─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘
189: ```
190:

192: ## Tenant-Level Configuration (BYOK - Bring Your Own Keys)
193: 
194: Tenant-level BYOK integrations are a **roadmap** capability.

199: - Other per-tenant integrations (analytics, payments, AI services, email/SMS routing) are not implemented yet.

239: ## Organization-Level Integrations
240: 
241: Organization administrators can configure their own notification channels and webhooks for their organization's events.
242: 
243: ```
244: ┌─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐
245: │              ORGANIZATION INTEGRATION OPTIONS                       │
246: ├─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┤
247: │                                                                     │
248: │  NOTIFICATION CHANNELS                                              │
249: │  ─────────────────────                                              │
250: │  ┌──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐   │
251: │  │  Slack Integration                                           │   │
252: │  │  • New event created → Post to channel                       │   │
253: │  │  • New registration → Notify organizers                      │   │
254: │  │  • Event reminder → Scheduled messages                       │   │
255: │  │  • Capacity alert → Warning when nearly full                 │   │
256: │  │                                                              │   │
257: │  │  Telegram Integration                                        │   │
258: │  │  • Bot notifications to group/channel                        │   │
259: │  │  • Event announcements                                       │   │
260: │  │  • Registration confirmations                                │   │
261: │  │                                                              │   │
262: │  │  Email Notifications                                         │   │
263: │  │  • Customizable templates                                    │   │
264: │  │  • Digest options (immediate/daily/weekly)                   │   │
265: │  │  • Role-based routing                                        │   │
266: │  │                                                              │   │
267: │  │  Discord Integration                                         │   │
268: │  │  • Webhook-based notifications                               │   │
269: │  │  • Rich embeds for events                                    │   │
270: │  │                                                              │   │
271: │  │  Matrix Integration                                          │   │
272: │  │  • Room notifications                                        │   │
273: │  │  • Decentralized messaging                                   │   │
274: │  └─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘   │
275: │                                                                     │
276: │  WEBHOOKS                                                           │
277: │  ────────                                                           │
278: │  ┌─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐   │
279: │  │  Configurable webhooks for all event types:                  │   │
280: │  │                                                              │   │
281: │  │  Event Lifecycle:                                            │   │
282: │  │  • event.created        • event.published                    │   │
283: │  │  • event.updated        • event.cancelled                    │   │
284: │  │  • event.deleted        • event.started                      │   │
285: │  │  • event.ended          • event.reminder (configurable)      │   │
286: │  │                                                              │   │
287: │  │  Participation:                                              │   │
288: │  │  • participant.registered    • participant.cancelled         │   │
289: │  │  • participant.checked_in    • participant.waitlisted        │   │
290: │  │  • capacity.threshold_reached                                │   │
291: │  │                                                              │   │
292: │  │  Organization:                                               │   │
293: │  │  • organization.member_joined   • organization.member_left   │   │
294: │  │  • organization.verified        • organization.settings_changed│  │
295: │  │                                                              │   │
296: │  │  Moderation:                                                 │   │
