## File: Explore.API/Dockerfile
````
 1: # Explore.API/Dockerfile
 2: # Multi-stage build for production deployment
 3: # Secrets are loaded at runtime via AddSecretManagement() - no CLI needed
 4: # Supports zero-downtime deployments with Coolify
 5: 
 6: FROM mcr.microsoft.com/dotnet/aspnet:10.0 AS base
 7: USER $APP_UID
 8: WORKDIR /app
 9: EXPOSE 8080
10: EXPOSE 8081
11: 
12: FROM mcr.microsoft.com/dotnet/sdk:10.0 AS build
13: ARG BUILD_CONFIGURATION=Release
14: WORKDIR /src
15: 
16: # Copy all project files for restore
17: COPY ["Explore.API/Explore.API.csproj", "Explore.API/"]
18: COPY ["Explore.Application/Explore.Application.csproj", "Explore.Application/"]
19: COPY ["Explore.Domain/Explore.Domain.csproj", "Explore.Domain/"]
20: COPY ["Explore.Infrastructure/Explore.Infrastructure.csproj", "Explore.Infrastructure/"]
21: COPY ["Explore.Persistence/Explore.Persistence.csproj", "Explore.Persistence/"]
22: COPY ["Explore.Secrets/Explore.Secrets.csproj", "Explore.Secrets/"]
23: COPY ["Explore.ServiceDefaults/Explore.ServiceDefaults.csproj", "Explore.ServiceDefaults/"]
24: 
25: RUN dotnet restore "./Explore.API/Explore.API.csproj"
26: COPY . .
27: WORKDIR "/src/Explore.API"
28: RUN dotnet build "./Explore.API.csproj" -c $BUILD_CONFIGURATION -o /app/build
29: 
30: FROM build AS publish
31: ARG BUILD_CONFIGURATION=Release
32: RUN dotnet publish "./Explore.API.csproj" -c $BUILD_CONFIGURATION -o /app/publish /p:UseAppHost=false
33: 
34: FROM base AS final
35: WORKDIR /app
36: 
37: # Copy published application
38: COPY --from=publish /app/publish .
39: 
40: # Secret management is handled by the application via AddSecretManagement()
41: # Configure via environment variables:
42: #   SECRET_PROVIDER=infisical (or "none" for env vars only)
43: #   Infisical__ProjectId, Infisical__ClientId, Infisical__ClientSecret, etc.
44: # See docs/CONFIGURATION.md for full list of options
45: 
46: ENTRYPOINT ["dotnet", "Explore.API.dll"]
````

## File: Explore.API/Services/OpenApiExportService.cs
````csharp
  1: using System.Text.Json;
  2: using Microsoft.AspNetCore.Builder;
  3: using Microsoft.Extensions.Hosting;
  4: using Microsoft.Extensions.Logging;
  5: 
  6: namespace Explore.API.Services;
  7: 
  8: 
  9: 
 10: 
 11: 
 12: 
 13: 
 14: 
 15: public class OpenApiExportService : BackgroundService
 16: {
 17:     private readonly IServiceProvider _serviceProvider;
 18:     private readonly ILogger<OpenApiExportService> _logger;
 19:     private readonly IHostEnvironment _hostEnvironment;
 20:     private readonly IConfiguration _configuration;
 21: 
 22:     public OpenApiExportService(
 23:         IServiceProvider serviceProvider,
 24:         ILogger<OpenApiExportService> logger,
 25:         IHostEnvironment hostEnvironment,
 26:         IConfiguration configuration)
 27:     {
 28:         _serviceProvider = serviceProvider;
 29:         _logger = logger;
 30:         _hostEnvironment = hostEnvironment;
 31:         _configuration = configuration;
 32:     }
 33: 
 34:     protected override async Task ExecuteAsync(CancellationToken stoppingToken)
 35:     {
 36: 
 37:         if (!_hostEnvironment.IsDevelopment())
 38:         {
 39:             _logger.LogInformation("OpenAPI export skipped - not in Development environment");
 40:             return;
 41:         }
 42: 
 43: 
 44:         await Task.Delay(TimeSpan.FromSeconds(3), stoppingToken);
 45: 
 46:         try
 47:         {
 48:             await ExportOpenApiSpecAsync(stoppingToken);
 49:         }
 50:         catch (Exception ex)
 51:         {
 52:             _logger.LogError(ex, "Failed to export OpenAPI specification");
 53:         }
 54:     }
 55: 
 56:     private async Task ExportOpenApiSpecAsync(CancellationToken stoppingToken)
 57:     {
 58:         using var scope = _serviceProvider.CreateScope();
 59: 
 60: 
 61:         var httpClientFactory = scope.ServiceProvider.GetRequiredService<IHttpClientFactory>();
 62:         var client = httpClientFactory.CreateClient();
 63: 
 64: 
 65:         var baseUrl = _configuration["ASPNETCORE_URLS"]?.Split(';').FirstOrDefault()
 66:                       ?? "https://localhost:7039";
 67: 
 68: 
 69: 
 70: 
 71:         var openApiSchemaUri = $"{baseUrl}/openapi/explore-api.json";
 72: 
 73:         _logger.LogInformation("Fetching OpenAPI spec from {Url}", openApiSchemaUri);
 74: 
 75: 
 76:         const int maxRetries = 5;
 77:         for (int i = 0; i < maxRetries; i++)
 78:         {
 79:             try
 80:             {
 81: 
 82:                 var handler = new HttpClientHandler
 83:                 {
 84:                     ServerCertificateCustomValidationCallback = (_, _, _, _) => true
 85:                 };
 86:                 using var httpClient = new HttpClient(handler);
 87: 
 88:                 var response = await httpClient.GetAsync(openApiSchemaUri, stoppingToken);
 89:                 response.EnsureSuccessStatusCode();
 90: 
 91:                 var swaggerJson = await response.Content.ReadAsStringAsync(stoppingToken);
 92: 
 93: 
 94:                 var jsonDoc = JsonDocument.Parse(swaggerJson);
 95:                 var prettyJson = JsonSerializer.Serialize(jsonDoc, new JsonSerializerOptions
 96:                 {
 97:                     WriteIndented = true
 98:                 });
 99: 
100: 
101:                 var projectDir = _hostEnvironment.ContentRootPath;
102:                 var outputPath = Path.Combine(projectDir, "swagger.json");
103: 
104:                 await File.WriteAllTextAsync(outputPath, prettyJson, stoppingToken);
105: 
106:                 _logger.LogInformation("? OpenAPI spec exported to {Path}", outputPath);
107:                 _logger.LogInformation("   Blazor.Client can now regenerate the API client");
108: 
109:                 return;
110:             }
111:             catch (HttpRequestException ex) when (i < maxRetries - 1)
112:             {
113:                 _logger.LogWarning("Attempt {Attempt}/{MaxRetries} failed: {Message}. Retrying...",
114:                     i + 1, maxRetries, ex.Message);
115:                 await Task.Delay(TimeSpan.FromSeconds(2), stoppingToken);
116:             }
117:         }
118: 
119:         _logger.LogError("Failed to fetch OpenAPI spec after {MaxRetries} attempts", maxRetries);
120:     }
121: }
````

## File: Explore.API/Services/TenantContext.cs
````csharp
  1: using System.Text.Json;
  2: using Explore.Application.Contracts.Infrastructure;
  3: using Explore.Domain.Constants;

  5: using Explore.Persistence;

 10: 
 11: 
 12: 
 13: 
 14: 
 15: 
 16: public class TenantContext : ITenantContext
 17: {
 18:     private const string TenantIdHeaderName = "X-Tenant-Id";
 19:     private const string ResolvedTenantContextItemKey = "__resolved_tenant_id";
 20: 
 21: 
 22: 
 23: 
 24: 
 25: 
 26:     private static readonly Guid FallbackDefaultTenantId = Guid.Parse("018e4e5c-7f00-7000-8000-000000000001");
 27: 
 28:     private readonly IHttpContextAccessor _httpContextAccessor;
 29:     private readonly DeploymentSettings _deploymentSettings;
 30:     private readonly IDbContextFactory<ExploreDbContext>? _dbContextFactory;
 31: 
 32:     public TenantContext(
 33:         IHttpContextAccessor httpContextAccessor,
 34:         IOptions<DeploymentSettings> deploymentSettings,
 35:         IDbContextFactory<ExploreDbContext>? dbContextFactory = null)
 36:     {
 37:         _httpContextAccessor = httpContextAccessor;
 38:         _deploymentSettings = deploymentSettings.Value;
 39:         _dbContextFactory = dbContextFactory;
 40:     }
 41: 
 42: 
 43: 
 44: 
 45: 
 46: 
 47:     public Guid TenantId
 48:     {
 49:         get
 50:         {
 51:             return ResolveTenantFromRequest();
 52:         }
 53:     }
 54: 
 55: 
 56: 
 57: 
 58:     private Guid GetDefaultTenantId()
 59:     {
 60:         return _deploymentSettings.DefaultTenantId != Guid.Empty
 61:             ? _deploymentSettings.DefaultTenantId
 62:             : FallbackDefaultTenantId;
 63:     }
 64: 
 65: 
 66: 
 67: 
 68: 
 69:     private Guid ResolveTenantFromRequest()
 70:     {
 71:         var httpContext = _httpContextAccessor.HttpContext;
 72:         if (httpContext == null)
 73:         {
 74:             return GetDefaultTenantId();
 75:         }
 76: 
 77:         if (httpContext.Items.TryGetValue(ResolvedTenantContextItemKey, out var cached) &&
 78:             cached is Guid cachedTenantId &&
 79:             cachedTenantId != Guid.Empty)
 80:         {
 81:             return cachedTenantId;
 82:         }
 83: 
 84: 
 85:         if (httpContext.Request.Headers.TryGetValue(TenantIdHeaderName, out var tenantIdHeader) &&
 86:             Guid.TryParse(tenantIdHeader.FirstOrDefault(), out var tenantId))
 87:         {
 88:             httpContext.Items[ResolvedTenantContextItemKey] = tenantId;
 89:             return tenantId;
 90:         }
 91: 
 92: 
 93:         if (_dbContextFactory == null)
 94:         {
 95:             var fallbackMode = _deploymentSettings.IsSingleTenant ? "SingleTenant" : "MultiTenant";
 96:             if (fallbackMode.Equals("SingleTenant", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase))
 97:             {
 98:                 var defaultTenantId = GetDefaultTenantId();
 99:                 httpContext.Items[ResolvedTenantContextItemKey] = defaultTenantId;
100:                 return defaultTenantId;
101:             }
102: 
103:             var hostFromRequest = GetRequestHost(httpContext);
104:             var fallbackSubdomain = ExtractFallbackSubdomain(hostFromRequest);
105:             if (!string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(fallbackSubdomain))
106:             {
107: 
108:                 var defaultTenantId = GetDefaultTenantId();
109:                 httpContext.Items[ResolvedTenantContextItemKey] = defaultTenantId;
110:                 return defaultTenantId;
111:             }
112: 
113:             var fallbackTenant = GetDefaultTenantId();
114:             httpContext.Items[ResolvedTenantContextItemKey] = fallbackTenant;
115:             return fallbackTenant;
116:         }
117: 
118:         using var dbContext = _dbContextFactory.CreateDbContext();
119:         var runtimeMode = ResolveRuntimeDeploymentMode(dbContext);
120:         if (runtimeMode.Equals("SingleTenant", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase))
121:         {
122:             var defaultTenantId = GetDefaultTenantId();
123:             httpContext.Items[ResolvedTenantContextItemKey] = defaultTenantId;
124:             return defaultTenantId;
125:         }
126: 
127:         var host = GetRequestHost(httpContext);
128: 
129: 
130:         var customDomainTenantId = TryResolveTenantByCustomDomain(dbContext, host);
131:         if (customDomainTenantId.HasValue)
132:         {
133:             httpContext.Items[ResolvedTenantContextItemKey] = customDomainTenantId.Value;
134:             return customDomainTenantId.Value;
135:         }
136: 
137: 
138:         var subdomainTenantId = TryResolveTenantBySubdomain(dbContext, host);
139:         if (subdomainTenantId.HasValue)
140:         {
141:             httpContext.Items[ResolvedTenantContextItemKey] = subdomainTenantId.Value;
142:             return subdomainTenantId.Value;
143:         }
144: 
145: 
146:         var fallbackTenantId = GetDefaultTenantId();
147:         httpContext.Items[ResolvedTenantContextItemKey] = fallbackTenantId;
148:         return fallbackTenantId;
149:     }
150: 
151:     private string ResolveRuntimeDeploymentMode(ExploreDbContext dbContext)
152:     {
153:         try
154:         {
155:             var rawSetting = dbContext.SystemSettings
156:                 .AsNoTracking()
157:                 .Where(s => s.SettingKey == GovernanceSettingKeys.DeploymentMode)
158:                 .Select(s => s.Value)
159:                 .FirstOrDefault();
160: 
161:             var modeFromSettings = DeserializeString(rawSetting, string.Empty);
162:             if (modeFromSettings.Equals("SingleTenant", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase))
163:             {
164:                 return "SingleTenant";
165:             }
166: 
167:             if (modeFromSettings.Equals("MultiTenant", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase))
168:             {
169:                 return "MultiTenant";
170:             }
171:         }
172:         catch
173:         {
174: 
175:         }
176: 
177:         return _deploymentSettings.IsSingleTenant ? "SingleTenant" : "MultiTenant";
178:     }
179: 
180:     private static string GetRequestHost(HttpContext httpContext)
181:     {
182:         var forwardedHost = httpContext.Request.Headers["X-Forwarded-Host"].FirstOrDefault();
183:         var candidate = string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(forwardedHost)
184:             ? httpContext.Request.Host.Value
185:             : forwardedHost.Split(',')[0].Trim();
186: 
187:         return NormalizeHost(candidate);
188:     }
189: 
190:     private Guid? TryResolveTenantByCustomDomain(ExploreDbContext dbContext, string host)
191:     {
192:         if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(host))
193:         {
194:             return null;
195:         }
196: 
197:         var allowCustomDomainsRaw = dbContext.SystemSettings
198:             .AsNoTracking()
199:             .Where(s => s.SettingKey == GovernanceSettingKeys.DomainsAllowTenantCustomDomain)
200:             .Select(s => s.Value)
201:             .FirstOrDefault();
202: 
203:         if (!DeserializeBoolean(allowCustomDomainsRaw, true))
204:         {
205:             return null;
206:         }
207: 
208:         var serializedHost = JsonSerializer.Serialize(host);
209:         var tenantId = dbContext.TenantSettingOverrides
210:             .AsNoTracking()
211:             .IgnoreQueryFilters()
212:             .Where(s => s.SettingKey == GovernanceSettingKeys.DomainsTenantCustomDomain && s.Value == serializedHost)
213:             .Select(s => s.TenantId)
214:             .FirstOrDefault();
215: 
216:         if (tenantId == Guid.Empty)
217:         {
218:             return null;
219:         }
220: 
221:         return dbContext.Tenants.AsNoTracking().Any(t => t.Id == tenantId && t.IsActive)
222:             ? tenantId
223:             : null;
224:     }
225: 
226:     private Guid? TryResolveTenantBySubdomain(ExploreDbContext dbContext, string host)
227:     {
228:         if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(host))
229:         {
230:             return null;
231:         }
232: 
233:         var baseDomainRaw = dbContext.SystemSettings
234:             .AsNoTracking()
235:             .Where(s => s.SettingKey == GovernanceSettingKeys.DomainsInstanceBaseDomain)
236:             .Select(s => s.Value)
237:             .FirstOrDefault();
238: 
239:         var baseDomain = NormalizeHost(DeserializeString(baseDomainRaw, string.Empty));
240:         var candidateSubdomain = ExtractSubdomainFromBaseDomain(host, baseDomain) ?? ExtractFallbackSubdomain(host);
241:         if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(candidateSubdomain))
242:         {
243:             return null;
244:         }
245: 
246:         var serializedSubdomain = JsonSerializer.Serialize(candidateSubdomain);
247:         var tenantId = dbContext.TenantSettingOverrides
248:             .AsNoTracking()
249:             .IgnoreQueryFilters()
250:             .Where(s => s.SettingKey == GovernanceSettingKeys.DomainsTenantSubdomain && s.Value == serializedSubdomain)
251:             .Select(s => s.TenantId)
252:             .FirstOrDefault();
253: 
254:         if (tenantId != Guid.Empty && dbContext.Tenants.AsNoTracking().Any(t => t.Id == tenantId && t.IsActive))
255:         {
256:             return tenantId;
257:         }
258: 
259:         var slugTenant = dbContext.Tenants
260:             .AsNoTracking()
261:             .FirstOrDefault(t => t.IsActive && t.Slug.ToLower() == candidateSubdomain);
262: 
263:         return slugTenant?.Id;
264:     }
265: 
266:     private static string? ExtractSubdomainFromBaseDomain(string host, string baseDomain)
267:     {
268:         if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(baseDomain))
269:         {
270:             return null;
271:         }
272: 
273:         if (host.Equals(baseDomain, StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase))
274:         {
275:             return null;
276:         }
277: 
278:         var suffix = "." + baseDomain;
279:         if (!host.EndsWith(suffix, StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase))
280:         {
281:             return null;
282:         }
283: 
284:         var prefix = host[..^suffix.Length];
285:         if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(prefix))
286:         {
287:             return null;
288:         }
289: 
290:         var firstLabel = prefix.Split('.', StringSplitOptions.RemoveEmptyEntries).FirstOrDefault();
291:         return NormalizeSubdomain(firstLabel);
292:     }
293: 
294: 
295: 
296: 
297: 
298:     private static string? ExtractFallbackSubdomain(string host)
299:     {
300:         var hostWithoutPort = NormalizeHost(host);
301:         var parts = hostWithoutPort.Split('.', StringSplitOptions.RemoveEmptyEntries);
302: 
303:         if (parts.Length < 3)
304:         {
305:             return null;
306:         }
307: 
308:         var subdomain = NormalizeSubdomain(parts[0]);
309:         if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(subdomain))
310:         {
311:             return null;
312:         }
313: 
314:         var ignoredSubdomains = new[] { "www", "api", "app", "admin", "localhost" };
315:         if (ignoredSubdomains.Contains(subdomain, StringComparer.OrdinalIgnoreCase))
316:         {
317:             return null;
318:         }
319: 
320:         return subdomain;
321:     }
322: 
323:     private static string NormalizeHost(string? host)
324:     {
325:         if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(host))
326:         {
327:             return string.Empty;
328:         }
329: 
330:         var normalized = host.Trim().ToLowerInvariant();
331:         normalized = normalized.Replace("https://", string.Empty, StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase);
332:         normalized = normalized.Replace("http://", string.Empty, StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase);
333: 
334:         var withoutPort = normalized.Split(':')[0].Trim();
335:         return withoutPort.Trim('/');
336:     }
337: 
338:     private static string? NormalizeSubdomain(string? value)
339:     {
340:         if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(value))
341:         {
342:             return null;
343:         }
344: 
345:         var normalized = value.Trim().ToLowerInvariant();
346:         normalized = new string(normalized.Where(c => char.IsLetterOrDigit(c) || c == '-').ToArray());
347:         return string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(normalized) ? null : normalized;
348:     }
349: 
350:     private static bool DeserializeBoolean(string? rawValue, bool fallback)
351:     {
352:         if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(rawValue))
353:         {
354:             return fallback;
355:         }
356: 
357:         try
358:         {
359:             return JsonSerializer.Deserialize<bool>(rawValue);
360:         }
361:         catch
362:         {
363:             return bool.TryParse(rawValue, out var parsed) ? parsed : fallback;
364:         }
365:     }
366: 
367:     private static string DeserializeString(string? rawValue, string fallback)
368:     {
369:         if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(rawValue))
370:         {
371:             return fallback;
372:         }
373: 
374:         try
375:         {
376:             var deserialized = JsonSerializer.Deserialize<string>(rawValue);
377:             return deserialized ?? fallback;
378:         }
379:         catch
380:         {
381:             return rawValue.Trim('"');
382:         }
383:     }
384: }
````

## File: Explore.Application/DTOs/Organization/Validators/CreateOrganizationDtoValidator.cs
````csharp
 1: using System;
 2: using System.Collections.Generic;
 3: using System.Text;
 4: using Explore.Application.Contracts.Persistence;
 5: using FluentValidation;
 6: 
 7: namespace Explore.Application.DTOs.Organization.Validators;
 8: 
 9: public class CreateOrganizationDtoValidator : AbstractValidator<CreateOrganizationDto>
10: {
11:     private readonly IApprovalStatusRepository _statusTypeRepository;
12: 
13:     public CreateOrganizationDtoValidator(IApprovalStatusRepository statusTypeRepository)
14:     {
15:         _statusTypeRepository = statusTypeRepository;
16: 
17:         RuleFor(p => p.FullName)
18:             .NotEmpty().WithMessage("{PropertyName} is required.")
19:             .NotNull()
20:             .MaximumLength(100).WithMessage("{PropertyName} must not exceed 100 characters.");
21: 
22:         RuleFor(p => p.WebsiteUrl)
23:             .MaximumLength(200).When(p => p.WebsiteUrl.Length > 0)
24:             .WithMessage("{PropertyName} must not exceed 200 characters.")
25:             .Must(uri => Uri.IsWellFormedUriString(uri, UriKind.Absolute)).When(p => p.WebsiteUrl.Length > 0)
26:             .WithMessage("{PropertyName} must be a valid Uri.");
27: 
28:         RuleFor(p => p.Email)
29:             .NotEmpty().WithMessage("{PropertyName} is required.")
30:             .NotNull()

35:             .NotNull()
36:             .MaximumLength(50).WithMessage("{PropertyName} must not exceed 50 characters.");
37:

39:             .NotEmpty().WithMessage("{PropertyName} is required.")
40:             .NotNull()

42:
````

## File: Explore.Application/Features/Events/Handlers/Commands/CreateEventWithSessionsCommandHandler.cs
````csharp
  1: using System;
  2: using System.Collections.Generic;
  3: using System.Linq;
  4: using System.Text.RegularExpressions;
  5: using System.Threading;
  6: using System.Threading.Tasks;
  7: using AutoMapper;
  8: using Explore.Application.Contracts.Identity;
  9: using Explore.Application.Contracts.Infrastructure;
 10: using Explore.Application.Contracts.Persistence;
 11: using Explore.Application.DTOs.Event.Validators;
 12: using Explore.Application.Features.Events.Requests.Commands;
 13: using Explore.Application.Responses;
 14: using Explore.Domain;
 15: using MediatR;
 16: 
 17: namespace Explore.Application.Features.Events.Handlers.Commands;
 18: 
 19: 
 20: 
 21: 
 22: 
 23: public class CreateEventWithSessionsCommandHandler : IRequestHandler<CreateEventWithSessionsCommand, BaseCommandResponse<Guid>>
 24: {
 25:     private readonly IEventRepository _eventRepository;
 26:     private readonly IEventSessionRepository _eventSessionRepository;
 27:     private readonly IEventSessionLanguageRepository _eventSessionLanguageRepository;
 28:     private readonly IActorRepository _actorRepository;
 29:     private readonly IOrganizationRepository _organizationRepository;
 30:     private readonly IOrganizationMemberRepository _organizationMemberRepository;
 31:     private readonly IAudienceAgeRepository _audienceAgeRepository;
 32:     private readonly IAudienceGenderRepository _audienceGenderRepository;
 33:     private readonly IEventTypeRepository _eventTypeRepository;
 34:     private readonly IStorageObjectRepository _storageObjectRepository;
 35:     private readonly ILocationRepository _locationRepository;
 36:     private readonly IRegistrationModeRepository _registrationModeRepository;
 37:     private readonly ILanguageRepository _languageRepository;
 38:     private readonly IUserContext _userContext;
 39:     private readonly ITenantContext _tenantContext;
 40:     private readonly IMapper _mapper;
 41: 
 42:     public CreateEventWithSessionsCommandHandler(
 43:         IEventRepository eventRepository,
 44:         IEventSessionRepository eventSessionRepository,
 45:         IEventSessionLanguageRepository eventSessionLanguageRepository,
 46:         IActorRepository actorRepository,
 47:         IOrganizationRepository organizationRepository,
 48:         IOrganizationMemberRepository organizationMemberRepository,
 49:         IAudienceAgeRepository audienceAgeRepository,
 50:         IAudienceGenderRepository audienceGenderRepository,
 51:         IEventTypeRepository eventTypeRepository,
 52:         IStorageObjectRepository storageObjectRepository,
 53:         ILocationRepository locationRepository,
 54:         IRegistrationModeRepository registrationModeRepository,
 55:         ILanguageRepository languageRepository,
 56:         IUserContext userContext,
 57:         ITenantContext tenantContext,
 58:         IMapper mapper)
 59:     {
 60:         _eventRepository = eventRepository;
 61:         _eventSessionRepository = eventSessionRepository;
 62:         _eventSessionLanguageRepository = eventSessionLanguageRepository;
 63:         _actorRepository = actorRepository;
 64:         _organizationRepository = organizationRepository;
 65:         _organizationMemberRepository = organizationMemberRepository;
 66:         _audienceAgeRepository = audienceAgeRepository;
 67:         _audienceGenderRepository = audienceGenderRepository;
 68:         _eventTypeRepository = eventTypeRepository;
 69:         _storageObjectRepository = storageObjectRepository;
 70:         _locationRepository = locationRepository;
 71:         _registrationModeRepository = registrationModeRepository;
 72:         _languageRepository = languageRepository;
 73:         _userContext = userContext;
 74:         _tenantContext = tenantContext;
 75:         _mapper = mapper;
 76:     }
 77: 
 78:     public async Task<BaseCommandResponse<Guid>> Handle(CreateEventWithSessionsCommand request, CancellationToken cancellationToken)
 79:     {
 80:         var response = new BaseCommandResponse<Guid>();
 81: 
 82: 
 83:         var currentUserId = _userContext.GetRequiredUserId();
 84: 
 85: 
 86:         var validator = new CreateEventWithSessionsDtoValidator(
 87:             _audienceAgeRepository,
 88:             _audienceGenderRepository,
 89:             _eventTypeRepository,
 90:             _organizationRepository,
 91:             _storageObjectRepository,
 92:             _locationRepository,
 93:             _registrationModeRepository,
 94:             _languageRepository);
 95: 
 96:         var validationResult = await validator.ValidateAsync(request.EventWithSessionsDto, cancellationToken);
 97:         if (!validationResult.IsValid)
 98:         {
 99:             response.Success = false;
100:             response.Message = "Event creation failed due to validation errors.";
101:             response.Errors = validationResult.Errors.Select(e => e.ErrorMessage).ToList();
102:             return response;
103:         }
104: 
105: 
106:         Guid actorId;
107:         var dto = request.EventWithSessionsDto;
108: 
109:         if (dto.OrganizationId.HasValue)
110:         {
111: 
112:             var organizationId = dto.OrganizationId.Value;
113: 
114: 
115:             var isAdmin = await _organizationMemberRepository.IsUserAdminOfOrganization(organizationId, currentUserId);
116:             if (!isAdmin)
117:             {
118:                 response.Success = false;
119:                 response.Message = "You do not have permission to create events for this organization.";
120:                 response.Errors = new List<string>
121:                 {
122:                     "User must be a Creator, Co-Owner, or Admin of the organization to create events."
123:                 };
124:                 return response;
125:             }
126: 
127: 
128:             var organizationActor = await _actorRepository.GetActorByOrganizationId(organizationId);
129:             if (organizationActor == null)
130:             {
131:                 response.Success = false;
132:                 response.Message = "Organization does not have an associated actor.";
133:                 response.Errors = new List<string>
134:                 {
135:                     "The organization is not properly configured. Please contact support."
136:                 };
137:                 return response;
138:             }
139: 
140:             actorId = organizationActor.Id;
141:         }
142:         else
143:         {
144: 
145:             var userActor = await _actorRepository.GetActorByUserId(currentUserId);
146:             if (userActor == null)
147:             {
148:                 response.Success = false;
149:                 response.Message = "Your personal actor was not found.";
150:                 response.Errors = new List<string>
151:                 {
152:                     "Your account is not properly set up. Please sync your profile first."
153:                 };
154:                 return response;
155:             }
156: 
157:             actorId = userActor.Id;
158:         }
159: 
160: 
161:         var sessions = dto.Sessions;
162:         var firstSessionDate = sessions.Min(s => s.StartTime);
163:         var lastSessionDate = sessions.Max(s => s.EndTime);
164: 
165: 
166:         var firstSessionDateOnly = DateOnly.FromDateTime(firstSessionDate.UtcDateTime);
167:         var lastSessionDateOnly = DateOnly.FromDateTime(lastSessionDate.UtcDateTime);
168: 
169: 
170:         var @event = new Event
171:         {
172:             Title = dto.Title,
173:             Description = dto.Description,
174:             Slug = string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(dto.Slug) ? GenerateSlug(dto.Title) : dto.Slug,
175:             EventTypeId = dto.EventTypeId,
176:             AudienceGenderId = dto.AudienceGenderId,
177:             AudienceAgeId = dto.AudienceAgeId,
178:             Price = dto.Price,
179:             CurrencyCode = dto.CurrencyCode,
180:             FeaturedImageId = dto.FeaturedImageId,
181:             IsRegistrationRequired = dto.IsRegistrationRequired,
182:             ExternalRegistrationUrl = dto.ExternalRegistrationUrl,
183:             EventStatusId = dto.EventStatusId == 0 ? 1 : dto.EventStatusId,
184:             VisibilityTypeId = dto.VisibilityTypeId == 0 ? 1 : dto.VisibilityTypeId,
185:             EventFormatId = dto.EventFormatId == 0 ? 1 : dto.EventFormatId,
186:             MadhabId = dto.MadhabId,
187:             Timezone = dto.Timezone,
188:             EventUrl = dto.EventUrl,
189:             ActorId = actorId,
190:             Actor = null!,
191:             TenantId = _tenantContext.TenantId,
192:             Tenant = null!,
193:             TotalViews = 0,
194:             IsUserReported = !dto.OrganizationId.HasValue,
195:             VisibilityType = null!,
196:             EventStatus = null!,
197:             EventFormat = null!,
198: 
199:             FirstSessionDate = firstSessionDateOnly,
200:             LastSessionDate = lastSessionDateOnly,
201:             SessionCount = sessions.Count
202:         };
203: 
204:         @event = await _eventRepository.Create(@event);
205:         Console.WriteLine($"[CREATE EVENT WITH SESSIONS] Event created with ID: {@event.Id}");
206: 
207: 
208:         if (dto.FeaturedImageId.HasValue)
209:         {
210:             var storageObject = await _storageObjectRepository.GetById(dto.FeaturedImageId.Value);
211:             if (storageObject != null)
212:             {
213:                 storageObject.ActorId = actorId;
214:                 await _storageObjectRepository.Update(storageObject);
215:                 Console.WriteLine($"[CREATE EVENT WITH SESSIONS] StorageObject {storageObject.Id} ActorId updated to {actorId}");
216:             }
217:         }
218: 
219: 
220:         var sessionIndex = 0;
221:         foreach (var sessionDto in sessions)
222:         {
223:             sessionIndex++;
224: 
225:             var eventSession = new EventSession
226:             {
227:                 EventId = @event.Id,
228:                 Event = null!,
229:                 TenantId = _tenantContext.TenantId,
230:                 Tenant = null!,
231:                 Title = string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(sessionDto.Title) ? @event.Title : sessionDto.Title,
232:                 Description = sessionDto.Description,
233:                 StartTime = sessionDto.StartTime,
234:                 EndTime = sessionDto.EndTime,
235:                 LocationId = sessionDto.LocationId,
236:                 MaxAudienceAttendees = sessionDto.MaxAudienceAttendees,
237:                 CurrentAudienceAttendees = 0,
238:                 RegistrationModeId = sessionDto.RegistrationModeId ?? (dto.IsRegistrationRequired ? 1 : null),
239:                 Slug = GenerateSlug(string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(sessionDto.Title) ? $"{@event.Title}-session-{sessionIndex}" : sessionDto.Title)
240:             };
241: 
242:             eventSession = await _eventSessionRepository.Create(eventSession);
243:             Console.WriteLine($"[CREATE EVENT WITH SESSIONS] EventSession {sessionIndex} created with ID: {eventSession.Id}");
244: 
245: 
246:             foreach (var languageId in sessionDto.LanguageIds)
247:             {
248:                 var sessionLanguage = new EventSessionLanguage
249:                 {
250:                     EventSessionId = eventSession.Id,
251:                     EventSession = null!,
252:                     LanguageId = languageId,
253:                     Language = null!,
254:                     TenantId = _tenantContext.TenantId,
255:                     Tenant = null!
256:                 };
257: 
258:                 await _eventSessionLanguageRepository.Create(sessionLanguage);
259:             }
260: 
261:             if (sessionDto.LanguageIds.Any())
262:             {
263:                 Console.WriteLine($"[CREATE EVENT WITH SESSIONS] {sessionDto.LanguageIds.Count} languages assigned to session {eventSession.Id}");
264:             }
265:         }
266: 
267:         response.Success = true;
268:         response.Id = @event.Id;
269:         response.Message = $"Event and {sessions.Count} session(s) created successfully.";
270: 
271:         return response;
272:     }
273: 
274: 
275: 
276: 
277:     private static string GenerateSlug(string title)
278:     {
279:         if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(title))
280:             return $"event-{Guid.NewGuid().ToString("N").Substring(0, 8)}";
281: 
282:         var slug = title.ToLowerInvariant()
283:             .Replace(" ", "-")
284:             .Replace("'", "")
285:             .Replace("\"", "")
286:             .Replace(".", "")
287:             .Replace(",", "");
288: 
289:         // Remove any non-alphanumeric characters except hyphens
290:         slug = Regex.Replace(slug, @"[^a-z0-9\-]", "");
291: 
292: 
293:         if (slug.Length > 50)
294:             slug = slug.Substring(0, 50);
295: 
296:         return slug;
297:     }
298: }
````

## File: Explore.Application/Features/Organizations/Handlers/Commands/UpdateOrganizationDetailsCommandHandler.cs
````csharp
 1: using System;
 2: using System.Collections.Generic;
 3: using System.Linq;
 4: using System.Threading;
 5: using System.Threading.Tasks;
 6: using AutoMapper;
 7: using Explore.Application.Contracts.Persistence;
 8: using Explore.Application.Features.Organizations.Requests.Commands;
 9: using Explore.Application.Responses;
10: using Explore.Domain.Enums;
11: using MediatR;
12: using Microsoft.Extensions.Caching.Hybrid;
13: 
14: namespace Explore.Application.Features.Organizations.Handlers.Commands;
15: 
16: public class UpdateOrganizationDetailsCommandHandler : IRequestHandler<UpdateOrganizationDetailsCommand, BaseCommandResponse<Guid>>
17: {
18:     private readonly IOrganizationRepository _organizationRepository;
19:     private readonly IOrganizationMemberRepository _organizationMemberRepository;
20:     private readonly IMapper _mapper;
21:     private readonly HybridCache _cache;
22: 
23:     public UpdateOrganizationDetailsCommandHandler(
24:         IOrganizationRepository organizationRepository,
25:         IOrganizationMemberRepository organizationMemberRepository,
26:         IMapper mapper,
27:         HybridCache cache)
28:     {
29:         _organizationRepository = organizationRepository;
30:         _organizationMemberRepository = organizationMemberRepository;
31:         _mapper = mapper;
32:         _cache = cache;
33:     }
34: 
35:     public async Task<BaseCommandResponse<Guid>> Handle(UpdateOrganizationDetailsCommand request, CancellationToken cancellationToken)
36:     {
37:         var response = new BaseCommandResponse<Guid>();
38: 
39: 
40:         var organization = await _organizationRepository.GetById(request.Id);
41: 
42:         if (organization == null)
43:         {
44:             response.Success = false;
45:             response.Message = "Organization not found.";
46:             return response;
47:         }
48: 
49: 
50:         var members = await _organizationMemberRepository.GetMembersByOrganizationId(request.Id);
51:         if (Guid.TryParse(request.UserId, out Guid userGuid))
52:         {
53:             var requesterMember = members.FirstOrDefault(m => m.UserId == userGuid);
54:             if (requesterMember == null || requesterMember.OrganizationRoleId != (int)OrganizationRoleEnum.Admin)
55:             {
56:                 response.Success = false;
57:                 response.Message = "You are not authorized to update this organization.";
58:                 return response;
59:             }
60:         }
61:         else
62:         {
63:             response.Success = false;
64:             response.Message = "Invalid user ID.";
65:             return response;
66:         }
67: 
68: 
69:         organization.FullName = request.OrganizationDto.FullName;
70:         organization.WebsiteUrl = request.OrganizationDto.WebsiteUrl;
71:         organization.Email = request.OrganizationDto.Email;
72:         organization.Country = request.OrganizationDto.Country;
73:         organization.City = request.OrganizationDto.City;
74:         organization.Postcode = request.OrganizationDto.Postcode.ToString();
75:         organization.Address = request.OrganizationDto.Address;
76:         organization.MetadataJson = request.OrganizationDto.MetadataJson;
77: 
78:         await _organizationRepository.Update(organization);
79:         await _cache.RemoveAsync($"organization:detail:{organization.Id}", cancellationToken);
80: 
81:         response.Success = true;
82:         response.Message = "Organization updated successfully.";
83:         response.Id = organization.Id;
84:         return response;
85:     }
86: }
````

## File: Explore.Application/Features/Organizations/Handlers/Queries/GetMyOrganizationsRequestHandler.cs
````csharp
 1: using AutoMapper;
 2: using Explore.Application.Contracts.Infrastructure;
 3: using Explore.Application.Contracts.Persistence;
 4: using Explore.Application.DTOs.Organization;
 5: using Explore.Application.Features.Organizations.Requests.Queries;
 6: using Explore.Application.Responses;
 7: using Explore.Domain.Enums;
 8: using MediatR;
 9: using Microsoft.Extensions.Logging;
10: 
11: namespace Explore.Application.Features.Organizations.Handlers.Queries;
12: 
13: public class GetMyOrganizationsRequestHandler : IRequestHandler<GetMyOrganizationsRequest, PaginatedResult<OrganizationListDto>>
14: {
15:     private readonly IOrganizationRepository _organizationRepository;
16:     private readonly IOrganizationMemberRepository _organizationMemberRepository;
17:     private readonly IMapper _mapper;
18:     private readonly IObjectStorageService _objectStorageService;
19:     private readonly ILogger<GetMyOrganizationsRequestHandler> _logger;
20: 
21:     public GetMyOrganizationsRequestHandler(
22:         IOrganizationRepository organizationRepository,
23:         IOrganizationMemberRepository organizationMemberRepository,
24:         IMapper mapper,
25:         IObjectStorageService objectStorageService,
26:         ILogger<GetMyOrganizationsRequestHandler> logger)
27:     {
28:         _organizationRepository = organizationRepository;
29:         _organizationMemberRepository = organizationMemberRepository;
30:         _mapper = mapper;
31:         _objectStorageService = objectStorageService;
32:         _logger = logger;
33:     }
34: 
35:     public async Task<PaginatedResult<OrganizationListDto>> Handle(GetMyOrganizationsRequest request, CancellationToken cancellationToken)
36:     {
37:         if (!Guid.TryParse(request.UserId, out Guid userGuid))
38:         {
39:             return PaginatedResult<OrganizationListDto>.Create(new List<OrganizationListDto>(), 0, request.PageNumber, request.PageSize);
40:         }
41: 
42: 
43:         var (organizations, totalCount) = await _organizationRepository.GetMyOrganizationsPaged(userGuid, request.PageNumber, request.PageSize);
44: 
45: 
46:         var memberships = await _organizationMemberRepository.GetMembershipsByUser(userGuid);
47:         var membershipDict = memberships.ToDictionary(m => m.OrganizationId, m => m.OrganizationRoleId);
48: 
49: 
50:         var dtos = new List<OrganizationListDto>();
51:         foreach (var org in organizations)
52:         {
53:             var dto = _mapper.Map<OrganizationListDto>(org);
54:             if (membershipDict.TryGetValue(org.Id, out var roleId))
55:             {
56:                 dto.CurrentUserRole = (OrganizationRoleEnum)roleId;
57:             }
58: 
59:             dto.ActorProfilePictureUri = ResolveImageUrl(dto.ActorProfilePictureUri);
60:             dtos.Add(dto);
61:         }
62: 
63:         return PaginatedResult<OrganizationListDto>.Create(dtos, totalCount, request.PageNumber, request.PageSize);
64:     }
65: 
66: 
67: 
68: 
69:     private string? ResolveImageUrl(string? objectKeyOrUri)
70:     {
71:         if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(objectKeyOrUri))
72:             return null;
73: 
74:         try
75:         {
76: 
77:             if (objectKeyOrUri.StartsWith("http://", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase) ||
78:                 objectKeyOrUri.StartsWith("https://", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase))
79:             {
80:                 if (Uri.TryCreate(objectKeyOrUri, UriKind.Absolute, out var uri))
81:                 {
82:                     var objectKey = uri.AbsolutePath.TrimStart('/');
83:                     return _objectStorageService.GeneratePresignedDownloadUrl(objectKey, 60);
84:                 }
85:                 return objectKeyOrUri;
86:             }
87: 
88: 
89:             return _objectStorageService.GeneratePresignedDownloadUrl(objectKeyOrUri, 60);
90:         }
91:         catch (Exception ex)
92:         {
93:             _logger.LogError(ex, "Failed to generate presigned URL for object key: {ObjectKey}", objectKeyOrUri);
94:             return null;
95:         }
96:     }
97: }
````

## File: Explore.Infrastructure/Services/ModuleService.cs
````csharp
  1: namespace Explore.Infrastructure.Services;
  2: 
  3: using Explore.Application.Contracts.Infrastructure;
  4: using Explore.Application.Contracts.Persistence;
  5: using Explore.Domain.Modules;
  6: using Microsoft.Extensions.Caching.Memory;
  7: 
  8: 
  9: 
 10: 
 11: public class ModuleService : IModuleService
 12: {
 13:     private readonly IModuleDefinitionRepository _moduleDefinitionRepository;
 14:     private readonly ITenantCapabilityRepository _tenantCapabilityRepository;
 15:     private readonly IMemoryCache _cache;
 16:     private readonly TimeSpan _cacheExpiration = TimeSpan.FromMinutes(5);
 17: 
 18:     private const string AllModulesCacheKey = "Modules_All";
 19:     private const string TenantModulesCacheKeyPrefix = "Modules_Tenant_";
 20: 
 21:     public ModuleService(
 22:         IModuleDefinitionRepository moduleDefinitionRepository,
 23:         ITenantCapabilityRepository tenantCapabilityRepository,
 24:         IMemoryCache cache)
 25:     {
 26:         _moduleDefinitionRepository = moduleDefinitionRepository;
 27:         _tenantCapabilityRepository = tenantCapabilityRepository;
 28:         _cache = cache;
 29:     }
 30: 
 31:     public async Task<IReadOnlyList<ModuleInfo>> GetAllModulesAsync(CancellationToken cancellationToken = default)
 32:     {
 33:         return await _cache.GetOrCreateAsync(AllModulesCacheKey, async entry =>
 34:         {
 35:             entry.AbsoluteExpirationRelativeToNow = _cacheExpiration;
 36:             var modules = await _moduleDefinitionRepository.GetAllActive();
 37:             return modules.Select(m => MapToModuleInfo(m)).ToList();
 38:         }) ?? new List<ModuleInfo>();
 39:     }
 40: 
 41:     public async Task<IReadOnlyList<ModuleInfo>> GetEnabledModulesAsync(Guid tenantId, CancellationToken cancellationToken = default)
 42:     {
 43:         var cacheKey = $"{TenantModulesCacheKeyPrefix}{tenantId}";
 44: 
 45:         return await _cache.GetOrCreateAsync(cacheKey, async entry =>
 46:         {
 47:             entry.AbsoluteExpirationRelativeToNow = _cacheExpiration;
 48: 
 49:             var capabilities = await _tenantCapabilityRepository.GetEnabledByTenantId(tenantId);
 50:             return capabilities
 51:                 .Where(c => c.Module != null)
 52:                 .Select(c => MapToModuleInfo(c.Module!, isEnabledForTenant: true))
 53:                 .ToList();
 54:         }) ?? new List<ModuleInfo>();
 55:     }
 56: 
 57:     public async Task<bool> IsModuleEnabledAsync(Guid tenantId, string moduleKey, CancellationToken cancellationToken = default)
 58:     {
 59: 
 60:         var enabledModules = await GetEnabledModulesAsync(tenantId, cancellationToken);
 61:         return enabledModules.Any(m => m.ModuleKey.Equals(moduleKey, StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase));
 62:     }
 63: 
 64:     public async Task<string?> GetModuleWizardSchemaUrlAsync(string moduleKey, CancellationToken cancellationToken = default)
 65:     {
 66:         var module = await _moduleDefinitionRepository.GetByKey(moduleKey);
 67:         return module?.WizardSchemaUrl;
 68:     }
 69: 
 70:     public async Task<bool> EnableModuleAsync(Guid tenantId, string moduleKey, Guid? enabledBy = null, CancellationToken cancellationToken = default)
 71:     {
 72: 
 73:         var module = await _moduleDefinitionRepository.GetByKey(moduleKey);
 74:         if (module == null || !module.IsActive)
 75:             return false;
 76: 
 77: 
 78:         var existing = await _tenantCapabilityRepository.GetByTenantAndModuleKey(tenantId, moduleKey);
 79:         if (existing != null)
 80:         {
 81: 
 82:             if (!existing.IsEnabled)
 83:             {
 84:                 existing.IsEnabled = true;
 85:                 existing.EnabledAt = DateTime.UtcNow;
 86:                 existing.EnabledBy = enabledBy;
 87:                 await _tenantCapabilityRepository.Update(existing);
 88:                 InvalidateCache(tenantId);
 89:             }
 90:             return true;
 91:         }
 92: 
 93: 
 94:         var capability = new TenantCapability
 95:         {
 96:             TenantId = tenantId,
 97:             Tenant = null!,
 98:             ModuleId = module.Id,
 99:             Module = null!,
100:             IsEnabled = true,
101:             EnabledAt = DateTime.UtcNow,
102:             EnabledBy = enabledBy
103:         };
104: 
105:         await _tenantCapabilityRepository.Create(capability);
106:         InvalidateCache(tenantId);
107:         return true;
108:     }
109: 
110:     public async Task<bool> DisableModuleAsync(Guid tenantId, string moduleKey, CancellationToken cancellationToken = default)
111:     {
112:         var capability = await _tenantCapabilityRepository.GetByTenantAndModuleKey(tenantId, moduleKey);
113:         if (capability == null)
114:             return false;
115: 
116: 
117:         capability.IsEnabled = false;
118:         await _tenantCapabilityRepository.Update(capability);
119:         InvalidateCache(tenantId);
120:         return true;
121:     }
122: 
123:     public void InvalidateCache(Guid? tenantId = null)
124:     {
125:         _cache.Remove(AllModulesCacheKey);
126: 
127:         if (tenantId.HasValue)
128:         {
129:             _cache.Remove($"{TenantModulesCacheKeyPrefix}{tenantId}");
130:         }
131:     }
132: 
133:     private static ModuleInfo MapToModuleInfo(ModuleDefinition module, bool? isEnabledForTenant = null)
134:     {
135:         return new ModuleInfo
136:         {
137:             Id = module.Id,
138:             ModuleKey = module.ModuleKey,
139:             Name = module.Name,
140:             Description = module.Description,
141:             IconName = module.IconName,
142:             Category = module.Category,
143:             DisplayOrder = module.DisplayOrder,
144:             WizardSchemaUrl = module.WizardSchemaUrl,
145:             IsActive = module.IsActive,
146:             IsEnabledForTenant = isEnabledForTenant
147:         };
148:     }
149: }
````

## File: Explore.Infrastructure/Services/SettingsResolver.cs
````csharp
  1: namespace Explore.Infrastructure.Services;
  2: 
  3: using System.Text.Json;
  4: using Explore.Application.Contracts.Infrastructure;
  5: using Explore.Application.Contracts.Persistence;
  6: using Explore.Domain;
  7: using Microsoft.Extensions.Caching.Memory;
  8: 
  9: 
 10: 
 11: 
 12: public class SettingsResolver : ISettingsResolver
 13: {
 14:     private readonly ISystemSettingRepository _systemSettingRepository;
 15:     private readonly ITenantSettingRepository _tenantSettingRepository;
 16:     private readonly IMemoryCache _cache;
 17:     private readonly TimeSpan _cacheExpiration = TimeSpan.FromMinutes(5);
 18: 
 19:     private const string SystemSettingsCacheKey = "SystemSettings_All";
 20:     private const string TenantSettingsCacheKeyPrefix = "TenantSettings_";
 21: 
 22:     public SettingsResolver(
 23:         ISystemSettingRepository systemSettingRepository,
 24:         ITenantSettingRepository tenantSettingRepository,
 25:         IMemoryCache cache)
 26:     {
 27:         _systemSettingRepository = systemSettingRepository;
 28:         _tenantSettingRepository = tenantSettingRepository;
 29:         _cache = cache;
 30:     }
 31: 
 32:     public async Task<T?> GetSettingAsync<T>(string settingKey, Guid? tenantId = null, CancellationToken cancellationToken = default)
 33:     {
 34:         var resolved = await GetSettingWithMetadataAsync(settingKey, tenantId, cancellationToken);
 35:         if (resolved == null)
 36:             return default;
 37: 
 38:         try
 39:         {
 40:             return JsonSerializer.Deserialize<T>(resolved.Value);
 41:         }
 42:         catch
 43:         {
 44:             return default;
 45:         }
 46:     }
 47: 
 48:     public async Task<ResolvedSetting?> GetSettingWithMetadataAsync(string settingKey, Guid? tenantId = null, CancellationToken cancellationToken = default)
 49:     {
 50: 
 51:         var systemSettings = await GetSystemSettingsAsync(cancellationToken);
 52:         var systemSetting = systemSettings.FirstOrDefault(s => s.SettingKey == settingKey);
 53: 
 54:         if (systemSetting == null)
 55:             return null;
 56: 
 57: 
 58:         if (systemSetting.IsLocked || tenantId == null)
 59:         {
 60:             return new ResolvedSetting
 61:             {
 62:                 Key = systemSetting.SettingKey,
 63:                 Value = systemSetting.Value,
 64:                 ValueType = systemSetting.ValueType,
 65:                 Source = systemSetting.IsLocked ? SettingSource.SystemLocked : SettingSource.SystemDefault,
 66:                 IsLocked = systemSetting.IsLocked,
 67:                 Description = systemSetting.Description,
 68:                 Category = systemSetting.Category,
 69:                 AllowedValues = systemSetting.AllowedValues
 70:             };
 71:         }
 72: 
 73: 
 74:         var tenantSettings = await GetTenantSettingsAsync(tenantId.Value, cancellationToken);
 75:         var tenantOverride = tenantSettings.FirstOrDefault(s => s.SettingKey == settingKey);
 76: 
 77:         if (tenantOverride != null)
 78:         {
 79:             return new ResolvedSetting
 80:             {
 81:                 Key = settingKey,
 82:                 Value = tenantOverride.Value,
 83:                 ValueType = systemSetting.ValueType,
 84:                 Source = SettingSource.TenantOverride,
 85:                 IsLocked = false,
 86:                 Description = systemSetting.Description,
 87:                 Category = systemSetting.Category,
 88:                 AllowedValues = systemSetting.AllowedValues
 89:             };
 90:         }
 91: 
 92: 
 93:         return new ResolvedSetting
 94:         {
 95:             Key = systemSetting.SettingKey,
 96:             Value = systemSetting.Value,
 97:             ValueType = systemSetting.ValueType,
 98:             Source = SettingSource.SystemDefault,
 99:             IsLocked = false,
100:             Description = systemSetting.Description,
101:             Category = systemSetting.Category,
102:             AllowedValues = systemSetting.AllowedValues
103:         };
104:     }
105: 
106:     public async Task<IReadOnlyList<ResolvedSetting>> GetAllSettingsAsync(Guid? tenantId = null, string? category = null, CancellationToken cancellationToken = default)
107:     {
108:         var systemSettings = await GetSystemSettingsAsync(cancellationToken);
109:         var tenantSettings = tenantId.HasValue
110:             ? await GetTenantSettingsAsync(tenantId.Value, cancellationToken)
111:             : new List<TenantSetting>();
112: 
113:         var tenantSettingsDict = tenantSettings.ToDictionary(s => s.SettingKey, s => s.Value);
114: 
115:         var result = systemSettings
116:             .Where(s => category == null || s.Category == category)
117:             .Select(s =>
118:             {
119:                 var hasOverride = tenantSettingsDict.TryGetValue(s.SettingKey, out var overrideValue);
120:                 var effectiveValue = s.IsLocked || !hasOverride ? s.Value : overrideValue!;
121:                 var source = s.IsLocked ? SettingSource.SystemLocked
122:                     : hasOverride ? SettingSource.TenantOverride
123:                     : SettingSource.SystemDefault;
124: 
125:                 return new ResolvedSetting
126:                 {
127:                     Key = s.SettingKey,
128:                     Value = effectiveValue,
129:                     ValueType = s.ValueType,
130:                     Source = source,
131:                     IsLocked = s.IsLocked,
132:                     Description = s.Description,
133:                     Category = s.Category,
134:                     AllowedValues = s.AllowedValues
135:                 };
136:             })
137:             .ToList();
138: 
139:         return result;
140:     }
141: 
142:     public async Task<bool> CanOverrideAsync(string settingKey, CancellationToken cancellationToken = default)
143:     {
144:         return !await _systemSettingRepository.IsLocked(settingKey);
145:     }
146: 
147:     public async Task<bool> SetTenantOverrideAsync(string settingKey, object value, Guid tenantId, CancellationToken cancellationToken = default)
148:     {
149: 
150:         if (!await CanOverrideAsync(settingKey, cancellationToken))
151:             return false;
152: 
153:         var existingOverride = await _tenantSettingRepository.GetByTenantAndKey(tenantId, settingKey);
154:         var jsonValue = JsonSerializer.Serialize(value);
155: 
156:         if (existingOverride != null)
157:         {
158:             existingOverride.Value = jsonValue;
159:             existingOverride.UpdatedAt = DateTime.UtcNow;
160:             await _tenantSettingRepository.Update(existingOverride);
161:         }
162:         else
163:         {
164:             var newOverride = new TenantSetting
165:             {
166:                 TenantId = tenantId,
167:                 Tenant = null!,
168:                 SettingKey = settingKey,
169:                 Value = jsonValue,
170:                 CreatedAt = DateTime.UtcNow
171:             };
172:             await _tenantSettingRepository.Create(newOverride);
173:         }
174: 
175:         InvalidateCache(settingKey, tenantId);
176:         return true;
177:     }
178: 
179:     public async Task<bool> RemoveTenantOverrideAsync(string settingKey, Guid tenantId, CancellationToken cancellationToken = default)
180:     {
181:         var result = await _tenantSettingRepository.RemoveOverride(tenantId, settingKey);
182:         if (result)
183:         {
184:             InvalidateCache(settingKey, tenantId);
185:         }
186:         return result;
187:     }
188: 
189:     public void InvalidateCache(string? settingKey = null, Guid? tenantId = null)
190:     {
191:         if (settingKey == null && tenantId == null)
192:         {
193:             _cache.Remove(SystemSettingsCacheKey);
194:         }
195:         else if (tenantId.HasValue)
196:         {
197:             _cache.Remove($"{TenantSettingsCacheKeyPrefix}{tenantId}");
198:         }
199:         else
200:         {
201:             _cache.Remove(SystemSettingsCacheKey);
202:         }
203:     }
204: 
205:     private async Task<List<SystemSetting>> GetSystemSettingsAsync(CancellationToken cancellationToken)
206:     {
207:         return await _cache.GetOrCreateAsync(SystemSettingsCacheKey, async entry =>
208:         {
209:             entry.AbsoluteExpirationRelativeToNow = _cacheExpiration;
210:             return await _systemSettingRepository.GetAllSettings();
211:         }) ?? new List<SystemSetting>();
212:     }
213: 
214:     private async Task<List<TenantSetting>> GetTenantSettingsAsync(Guid tenantId, CancellationToken cancellationToken)
215:     {
216:         var cacheKey = $"{TenantSettingsCacheKeyPrefix}{tenantId}";
217:         return await _cache.GetOrCreateAsync(cacheKey, async entry =>
218:         {
219:             entry.AbsoluteExpirationRelativeToNow = _cacheExpiration;
220:             return await _tenantSettingRepository.GetAllForTenant(tenantId);
221:         }) ?? new List<TenantSetting>();
222:     }
223: }
````

## File: Explore.Persistence/Repositories/AppSettingRepository.cs
````csharp
  1: namespace Explore.Persistence.Repositories;
  2: 
  3: using Explore.Application.Contracts.Persistence;
  4: using Explore.Domain;
  5: using Microsoft.EntityFrameworkCore;
  6: 
  7: public class AppSettingRepository : IAppSettingRepository
  8: {
  9:     private readonly ExploreDbContext _dbContext;
 10: 
 11:     public AppSettingRepository(ExploreDbContext dbContext)
 12:     {
 13:         _dbContext = dbContext;
 14:     }
 15: 
 16:     public async Task<AppSetting?> GetByKeyAsync(string configKey)
 17:     {
 18:         return await _dbContext.AppSettings
 19:             .AsNoTracking()
 20:             .FirstOrDefaultAsync(s => s.ConfigKey == configKey);
 21:     }
 22: 
 23:     public async Task<List<AppSetting>> GetByCategoryAsync(string? category = null)
 24:     {
 25:         var query = _dbContext.AppSettings.AsNoTracking();
 26: 
 27:         if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(category))
 28:         {
 29:             query = query.Where(s => s.Category == category);
 30:         }
 31: 
 32:         return await query
 33:             .OrderBy(s => s.Category)
 34:             .ThenBy(s => s.ConfigKey)
 35:             .ToListAsync();
 36:     }
 37: 
 38:     public async Task<List<AppSetting>> GetSettingsNeedingReEncryptionAsync(int currentKeyVersion)
 39:     {
 40:         return await _dbContext.AppSettings
 41:             .AsNoTracking()
 42:             .Where(s => s.KeyVersion < currentKeyVersion)
 43:             .OrderBy(s => s.ConfigKey)
 44:             .ToListAsync();
 45:     }
 46: 
 47:     public async Task<List<AppSetting>> GetAllAsync()
 48:     {
 49:         return await _dbContext.AppSettings
 50:             .AsNoTracking()
 51:             .OrderBy(s => s.ConfigKey)
 52:             .ToListAsync();
 53:     }
 54: 
 55:     public async Task<AppSetting> CreateAsync(AppSetting setting)
 56:     {
 57:         await _dbContext.AppSettings.AddAsync(setting);
 58:         await _dbContext.SaveChangesAsync();
 59:         return setting;
 60:     }
 61: 
 62:     public async Task UpdateAsync(AppSetting setting)
 63:     {
 64: 
 65:         _dbContext.AppSettings.Update(setting);
 66:         await _dbContext.SaveChangesAsync();
 67:     }
 68: 
 69:     public async Task<bool> DeleteAsync(string configKey)
 70:     {
 71:         var setting = await _dbContext.AppSettings.FirstOrDefaultAsync(s => s.ConfigKey == configKey);
 72:         if (setting == null)
 73:         {
 74:             return false;
 75:         }
 76: 
 77:         _dbContext.AppSettings.Remove(setting);
 78:         await _dbContext.SaveChangesAsync();
 79:         return true;
 80:     }
 81: 
 82:     public async Task<bool> ExistsAsync(string configKey)
 83:     {
 84:         return await _dbContext.AppSettings
 85:             .AsNoTracking()
 86:             .AnyAsync(s => s.ConfigKey == configKey);
 87:     }
 88: 
 89:     public async Task BulkUpdateAsync(IEnumerable<AppSetting> settings)
 90:     {
 91:         await using var transaction = await _dbContext.Database.BeginTransactionAsync();
 92:         try
 93:         {
 94:             foreach (var setting in settings)
 95:             {
 96:                 _dbContext.AppSettings.Update(setting);
 97:             }
 98:             await _dbContext.SaveChangesAsync();
 99:             await transaction.CommitAsync();
100:         }
101:         catch
102:         {
103:             await transaction.RollbackAsync();
104:             throw;
105:         }
106:     }
107: }
````

````csharp
 32: 
 33:         await LookupTableSeeder.SeedAsync(context, cancellationToken);

 35:
````

````csharp
 27: 
 28:         RuleFor(p => p.Id)
 29:             .NotEmpty().WithMessage("{PropertyName} is required.")
 30:             .NotNull();
 31: 
 32:         RuleFor(p => p.Title)
 33:             .NotEmpty().WithMessage("{PropertyName} is required.")
 34:             .MaximumLength(500).WithMessage("{PropertyName} must not exceed 500 characters.");
 35: 
 36:         RuleFor(p => p.Subtitle)
 37:             .MaximumLength(200).WithMessage("{PropertyName} must not exceed 200 characters.");
 38: 
 39:         RuleFor(p => p.Description)
 40:             .NotEmpty().WithMessage("{PropertyName} is required.")
 41:             .NotNull()
 42:             .MaximumLength(500).WithMessage("{PropertyName} must not exceed 500 characters.");
 43: 
 44:         RuleFor(p => p.Slug)
 45:             .MaximumLength(500).WithMessage("{PropertyName} must not exceed 500 characters.");
 46: 
 47:         RuleFor(p => p.EventTypeId)
 48:             .MustAsync(async (id, cancellation) =>
 49:             {
 50:                 if (!id.HasValue) return true;
 51:                 var exists = await _eventTypeRepository.Exists(id.Value);
 52:                 return exists;
 53:             })
 54:             .When(p => p.EventTypeId.HasValue)
 55:             .WithMessage("{PropertyName} does not exist.");
 56: 
 57:         RuleFor(p => p.AudienceGenderId)
 58:             .MustAsync(async (id, cancellation) =>
 59:             {
 60:                 if (!id.HasValue) return true;
 61:                 var audienceGenderExists = await _audienceGenderRepository.Exists(id.Value);
 62:                 return audienceGenderExists;
 63:             })
 64:             .When(p => p.AudienceGenderId.HasValue)
 65:             .WithMessage("{PropertyName} does not exist.");
 66: 
 67:         RuleFor(p => p.AudienceAgeId)
 68:             .MustAsync(async (id, cancellation) =>
 69:             {
 70:                 if (!id.HasValue) return true;
 71:                 var audienceAgeExists = await _audienceAgeRepository.Exists(id.Value);
 72:                 return audienceAgeExists;
 73:             })
 74:             .When(p => p.AudienceAgeId.HasValue)
 75:             .WithMessage("{PropertyName} does not exist.");
 76: 
 77:         RuleFor(p => p.ActorId)
 78:             .NotEmpty().WithMessage("{PropertyName} is required.")
 79:             .NotNull()
 80:             .MustAsync(async (id, cancellation) =>
 81:             {
 82:                 var actorExists = await _actorRepository.Exists(id);
 83:                 return actorExists;
 84:             }).WithMessage("{PropertyName} does not exist.");
 85: 
 86:         RuleFor(p => p.Price)
 87:             .GreaterThanOrEqualTo(0).When(p => p.Price.HasValue)
 88:             .WithMessage("{PropertyName} must be greater than or equal to 0.");
 89: 
 90:         RuleFor(p => p.CurrencyCode)
 91:             .MaximumLength(3).When(p => !string.IsNullOrEmpty(p.CurrencyCode))
 92:             .WithMessage("{PropertyName} must be a valid 3-letter currency code.");
 93: 
 94:         RuleFor(p => p.FeaturedImageId)

102:

105:

111:
````

````csharp
 62:     {
 63: 
 64:         var userId = _currentUserService.UserId;
 65:         if (userId == null)
 66:         {
 67:             _logger.LogWarning("Delete event failed: User ID not found in authentication context");
 68:             return false;
 69:         }
 70: 
 71: 
 72:         var @event = await _eventRepository.GetById(request.Id);
 73:         if (@event == null)
 74:         {
 75:             _logger.LogWarning("Delete event failed: Event {EventId} not found", request.Id);
 76:             return false;
 77:         }
 78: 
 79: 
 80:         var isAuthorized = await IsUserAuthorizedToDelete(@event, userId.Value, cancellationToken);
 81:         if (!isAuthorized)
 82:         {
 83:             _logger.LogWarning(
 84:                 "Delete event failed: User {UserId} not authorized to delete event {EventId}",
 85:                 userId.Value,
 86:                 request.Id);
 87:             return false;
 88:         }
 89: 
 90: 
 91:         var sessions = await _eventSessionRepository.GetSessionsByEvent(request.Id);
 92:         _logger.LogInformation(
 93:             "Cascading soft delete: Found {SessionCount} event session(s) for event {EventId}",
 94:             sessions.Count,
 95:             request.Id);
 96: 
 97:         foreach (var session in sessions)
 98:         {
 99:             _logger.LogDebug(
100:                 "Soft deleting event session {SessionId} (Title: {SessionTitle}) for event {EventId}",
101:                 session.Id,
102:                 session.Title ?? "Untitled",
103:                 request.Id);
104:             await _eventSessionRepository.Delete(session);
105:         }
106: 
107:         if (sessions.Count > 0)
108:         {
109:             _logger.LogInformation(
110:                 "Successfully cascaded soft delete to {SessionCount} event session(s) for event {EventId}",
111:                 sessions.Count,
112:                 request.Id);
113:         }
114: 
115: 
116:         await _eventRepository.Delete(@event);
117: 
118:         _logger.LogInformation(
119:             "Event {EventId} successfully deleted by user {UserId}",
120:             request.Id,
121:             userId.Value);
122: 
123:         await _cache.RemoveAsync($"event:detail:{request.Id}", cancellationToken);
124:         await _cache.RemoveAsync("events:list:1:20", cancellationToken);
125: 
126:         return true;
127:     }
128: 
129: 
130: 
131: 
132: 
133:     private async Task<bool> IsUserAuthorizedToDelete(Domain.Event @event, Guid userId, CancellationToken cancellationToken)
134:     {
135: 
136:         if (await IsSystemAdmin(userId, cancellationToken))
137:         {
138:             _logger.LogDebug("User {UserId} authorized as system Admin", userId);
139:             return true;
140:         }
141: 
142: 
143:         var actor = await _actorRepository.GetById(@event.ActorId);
144:         if (actor == null)
145:         {
146:             _logger.LogWarning("Actor {ActorId} not found for event {EventId}", @event.ActorId, @event.Id);
147:             return false;
148:         }
149: 
150: 
151:         if (actor.OrganizationId.HasValue)
152:         {
153:             var isOrgAuthorized = await IsOrganizationMemberAuthorized(
154:                 actor.OrganizationId.Value,
155:                 userId,
156:                 cancellationToken);
157: 
158:             if (isOrgAuthorized)
159:             {
160:                 _logger.LogDebug(
161:                     "User {UserId} authorized as organization member for org {OrgId}",
162:                     userId,
163:                     actor.OrganizationId.Value);
164:                 return true;
165:             }
166:         }
167: 
168: 
169:         if (actor.UserId.HasValue && actor.UserId.Value == userId)
170:         {
171:             _logger.LogDebug("User {UserId} authorized as event owner", userId);
172:             return true;
173:         }
174: 
175: 
176:         return false;
177:     }
178: 
179: 
180: 
181: 
182: 
183: 
184:     private async Task<bool> IsSystemAdmin(Guid userId, CancellationToken cancellationToken)
185:     {
186:         try
187:         {
188: 
189: 
190:             var tenantUsers = await _tenantUserRepository.GetByUser(userId);
191:             return tenantUsers.Any(tu => tu.UserRole?.MasterCode != null &&
192:                 tu.UserRole.MasterCode.Equals("Admin", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase));
193:         }
194:         catch (Exception ex)
195:         {
196:             _logger.LogError(ex, "Error checking system admin status for user {UserId}", userId);
197:             return false;
198:         }
199:     }
200: 
201: 
202: 
203: 
204: 
205: 
206:     private async Task<bool> IsOrganizationMemberAuthorized(
207:         Guid organizationId,
208:         Guid userId,
209:         CancellationToken cancellationToken)
210:     {
211:         try
212:         {
213: 
214: 
215:             var member = await _organizationMemberRepository.GetByOrganizationAndUser(organizationId, userId);
216: 
217:             if (member == null || member.IsDeleted)
218:             {
219:                 return false;
220:             }
221: 
222: 
223:             return member.OrganizationRoleId == (int)OrganizationRoleEnum.Creator ||
224:                    member.OrganizationRoleId == (int)OrganizationRoleEnum.CoOwner ||
225:                    member.OrganizationRoleId == (int)OrganizationRoleEnum.Admin;
226:         }
227:         catch (Exception ex)
228:         {
229:             _logger.LogError(
230:                 ex,
231:                 "Error checking organization membership for user {UserId} in org {OrgId}",
232:                 userId,
233:                 organizationId);
234:             return false;
235:         }
236:     }
237: }
````

````csharp
16: {
````

````csharp
19:     private readonly IObjectStorageService _objectStorageService;
20:     private readonly ILogger<GetEventDetailsRequestHandler> _logger;

22: 
23:     public GetEventDetailsRequestHandler(
24:         IEventRepository eventRepository,
25:         IMapper mapper,
26:         IObjectStorageService objectStorageService,
27:         ILogger<GetEventDetailsRequestHandler> logger,
28:         HybridCache cache)
29:     {
30:         _eventRepository = eventRepository;
31:         _mapper = mapper;
32:         _objectStorageService = objectStorageService;
33:         _logger = logger;
34:         _cache = cache;

36: 
37:     public async Task<EventDto> Handle(GetEventDetailsRequest request, CancellationToken cancellationToken)
38:     {
39:         var cacheKey = $"event:detail:{request.Id}";
40: 
41:         var eventDto = await _cache.GetOrCreateAsync(
42:             cacheKey,
43:             async _ =>
44:             {
45:                 var @event = await _eventRepository.GetEventWithDetails(request.Id);
46:                 return _mapper.Map<EventDto>(@event);
47:             },
48:             new HybridCacheEntryOptions
49:             {
50:                 Expiration = TimeSpan.FromMinutes(5),
51:                 LocalCacheExpiration = TimeSpan.FromMinutes(1)
52:             },
53:             cancellationToken: cancellationToken);
54: 
55: 
56:         if (eventDto != null)
57:         {
58:             eventDto.FeaturedImageUri = ResolveImageUrl(eventDto.FeaturedImageUri);
59:             eventDto.ActorProfilePictureUri = ResolveImageUrl(eventDto.ActorProfilePictureUri);
60:         }
61: 
62:         return eventDto;
63:     }
64: 
65: 
66: 
67: 
68: 
69:     private string? ResolveImageUrl(string? objectKeyOrUri)
70:     {
71:         if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(objectKeyOrUri))
72:             return null;
73: 
74:         try
75:         {
76: 
77:             if (objectKeyOrUri.StartsWith("http://", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase) ||
78:                 objectKeyOrUri.StartsWith("https://", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase))
79:             {
80: 
81:                 if (Uri.TryCreate(objectKeyOrUri, UriKind.Absolute, out var uri))
82:                 {
83:                     var objectKey = uri.AbsolutePath.TrimStart('/');
84:                     return _objectStorageService.GeneratePresignedDownloadUrl(objectKey, 60);
85:                 }
86:                 return objectKeyOrUri;
87:             }
88: 
89: 
90:             return _objectStorageService.GeneratePresignedDownloadUrl(objectKeyOrUri, 60);
91:         }
92:         catch (Exception ex)
93:         {
94:             _logger.LogError(ex, "Failed to generate presigned URL for object key: {ObjectKey}", objectKeyOrUri);
95:             return null;
96:         }
97:     }
98: }
````

````csharp
 16: public class AddOrganizationMemberCommandHandler : IRequestHandler<AddOrganizationMemberCommand, BaseCommandResponse<Guid>>

 23:     public AddOrganizationMemberCommandHandler(
 24:         IOrganizationMemberRepository organizationMemberRepository,
 25:         IOrganizationRepository organizationRepository,
 26:         IUserRepository userRepository,
 27:         IMapper mapper)

 29:         _organizationMemberRepository = organizationMemberRepository;

 31:         _userRepository = userRepository;
 32:         _mapper = mapper;

 34:

 38:         var dto = request.AddOrganizationMemberDto;
 39: 
 40: 
 41:         var organization = await _organizationRepository.GetById(dto.OrganizationId);

 43:         {
 44:             response.Success = false;
 45:             response.Message = "Organization not found";
 46:             return response;

 48: 
 49:

 53:         {
 54:             var requesterMember = members.FirstOrDefault(m => m.UserId == requesterGuid);
 55: 
 56:             if (requesterMember == null || requesterMember.OrganizationRoleId != (int)OrganizationRoleEnum.Admin)
 57:             {
 58:                 response.Success = false;
 59:                 response.Message = "You do not have permission to invite members.";
 60:                 return response;
 61:             }
 62:         }
 63:         else
 64:         {
 65:             response.Success = false;
 66:             response.Message = "Invalid requester User ID.";

 68:         }
 69: 
 70: 
 71:         var userToAdd = await _userRepository.GetUserByEmail(dto.Email);

 73:         {
 74:             response.Success = false;
 75:             response.Message = "User with this email not found.";
 76:             return response;
 77:         }
 78: 
 79: 
 80:         if (members.Any(m => m.UserId == userToAdd.Id))
 81:         {
 82:             response.Success = false;
 83:             response.Message = "User is already a member of this organization.";
 84:             return response;
 85:         }
 86: 
 87: 
 88:         var organizationMember = new OrganizationMember
 89:         {
 90:             OrganizationId = dto.OrganizationId,
 91:             Organization = null!,
 92:             UserId = userToAdd.Id,
 93:             User = null!,
 94:             OrganizationRoleId = (int)dto.Role,
 95:             OrganizationRole = null!,
 96:             Tenant = null!
 97:         };
 98: 
 99:         organizationMember = await _organizationMemberRepository.Create(organizationMember);
100: 
101:         response.Success = true;
102:         response.Message = "Member added successfully";
103:         response.Id = organizationMember.Id;
104:

106:     }
````

````csharp
29:         var memberToDelete = await _organizationMemberRepository.GetById(request.MemberId);
30: 
31:         if (memberToDelete == null)
32:         {
33:             response.Success = false;
34:             response.Message = "Member not found";
35:             return response;
36:         }
37: 
38:         var organization = await _organizationRepository.GetById(memberToDelete.OrganizationId);
39:         if (organization == null)
40:         {
41:             response.Success = false;
42:             response.Message = "Organization not found";
43:             return response;

45:

47:         var members = await _organizationMemberRepository.GetMembersByOrganizationId(memberToDelete.OrganizationId);
48:         if (Guid.TryParse(request.RequesterUserId, out Guid requesterGuid))
49:         {
50:             var requesterMember = members.FirstOrDefault(m => m.UserId == requesterGuid);
51: 
52:             if (requesterMember == null || requesterMember.OrganizationRoleId != (int)OrganizationRoleEnum.Admin)
53:             {
54:                 response.Success = false;
55:                 response.Message = "You do not have permission to remove members.";
56:                 return response;
57:             }
58:         }
59:         else
60:         {
61:             response.Success = false;
62:             response.Message = "Invalid requester User ID.";
63:             return response;
64:         }
````

````csharp
51: 
52:         var members = await _organizationMemberRepository.GetMembersByOrganizationId(memberToUpdate.OrganizationId);
53:         if (Guid.TryParse(request.RequesterUserId, out Guid requesterGuid))
54:         {
55:             var requesterMember = members.FirstOrDefault(m => m.UserId == requesterGuid);
56: 
57:             if (requesterMember == null || requesterMember.OrganizationRoleId != (int)OrganizationRoleEnum.Admin)
58:             {
59:                 response.Success = false;
60:                 response.Message = "You do not have permission to update roles.";
61:                 return response;
62:             }
63: 
64: 
65:             var adminCount = members.Count(m => m.OrganizationRoleId == (int)OrganizationRoleEnum.Admin);
66:             if (memberToUpdate.OrganizationRoleId == (int)OrganizationRoleEnum.Admin &&
67:                 (int)dto.Role != (int)OrganizationRoleEnum.Admin &&
68:                 adminCount <= 1)
69:             {
70:                 response.Success = false;
71:                 response.Message = "Cannot demote the last admin of the organization.";
72:                 return response;
73:             }
74:         }
75:         else
76:         {
77:             response.Success = false;
78:             response.Message = "Invalid requester User ID.";
79:             return response;
80:         }
81: 
82:         memberToUpdate.OrganizationRoleId = (int)dto.Role;
83:         await _organizationMemberRepository.Update(memberToUpdate);
84: 
85:         response.Success = true;
86:         response.Message = "Member role updated successfully";
87:         response.Id = memberToUpdate.Id;
88: 
89:         return response;
90:     }
91: }
````

````csharp
67:     {

70:

73:
````

## File: Explore.Application/Features/Users/Handlers/Commands/SyncUserCommandHandler.cs
````csharp
  1: using AutoMapper;
  2: using Explore.Application.Contracts.Persistence;

 12: namespace Explore.Application.Features.Users.Handlers.Commands;
 13: 
 14: public class SyncUserCommandHandler : IRequestHandler<SyncUserCommand, BaseCommandResponse<Guid>>
 15: {
 16:     private readonly IUserRepository _userRepository;
 17:     private readonly IActorRepository _actorRepository;
 18:     private readonly ITenantRepository _tenantRepository;
 19:     private readonly IMapper _mapper;
 20:     private readonly IConfiguration _configuration;
````
