 22: 
 23:     public SyncUserCommandHandler(
 24:         IUserRepository userRepository,
 25:         IActorRepository actorRepository,
 26:         ITenantRepository tenantRepository,
 27:         IMapper mapper,
 28:         IConfiguration configuration,
 29:         HybridCache cache)
 30:     {
 31:         _userRepository = userRepository;
 32:         _actorRepository = actorRepository;
 33:         _tenantRepository = tenantRepository;
 34:         _mapper = mapper;
 35:         _configuration = configuration;
 36:         _cache = cache;
 37:     }
 38: 
 39:     public async Task<BaseCommandResponse<Guid>> Handle(SyncUserCommand request, CancellationToken cancellationToken)
 40:     {
 41:         var response = new BaseCommandResponse<Guid>();
 42:         var userDto = request.UserDto;
 43: 
 44:         try
 45:         {
 46:             Console.WriteLine($"[USER SYNC] Starting sync for user - ID: {userDto.Id}, Email: {userDto.Email}");
 47: 
 48: 
 49:             var existingUserById = await _userRepository.GetById(userDto.Id);
 50:             var existingUserByEmail = await _userRepository.GetUserByEmail(userDto.Email);
 51: 
 52:             Console.WriteLine($"[USER SYNC] Existing user by ID: {(existingUserById != null ? existingUserById.Id.ToString() : "NOT FOUND")}");
 53:             Console.WriteLine($"[USER SYNC] Existing user by email: {(existingUserByEmail != null ? existingUserByEmail.Id.ToString() : "NOT FOUND")}");
 54: 
 55:             // If user exists by email but different ID, this is a conflict
 56:             if (existingUserByEmail != null && existingUserByEmail.Id != userDto.Id)
 57:             {
 58:                 Console.WriteLine($"[USER SYNC] CONFLICT - Email exists with different ID. DB User ID: {existingUserByEmail.Id}, Keycloak User ID: {userDto.Id}");
 59:                 response.Success = false;
 60:                 response.Message = $"A user with email {userDto.Email} already exists with a different ID. Database ID: {existingUserByEmail.Id}, Keycloak ID: {userDto.Id}";
 61:                 return response;
 62:             }
 63: 
 64:             // Use whichever exists (prefer by ID)
 65:             var existingUser = existingUserById ?? existingUserByEmail;
 66: 
 67:             if (existingUser == null)
 68:             {
 69:                 Console.WriteLine($"[USER SYNC] No existing user found - Creating new user");
 70: 
 71: 
 72: 
 73:                 var defaultTenantId = await GetDefaultTenantIdAsync();
 74: 
 75: 
 76:                 var user = new User
 77:                 {
 78:                     Id = userDto.Id,
 79:                     Email = userDto.Email,
 80:                     FirstName = userDto.FirstName,
 81:                     LastName = userDto.LastName,
 82:                     ActorId = null,
 83:                     AuthProvider = "keycloak",
 84:                     AuthProviderId = userDto.Id.ToString(),
 85:                     EmailVerified = true,
 86:                     DefaultActorId = null
 87:                 };
 88: 
 89:                 try
 90:                 {
 91:                     user = await _userRepository.Create(user);
 92:                     Console.WriteLine($"[USER SYNC] User created successfully - ID: {user.Id}");
 93:                 }
 94:                 catch (InvalidOperationException ex) when (ex.Message.Contains("ix_users_email"))
 95:                 {
 96:                     Console.WriteLine($"[USER SYNC] Race condition detected - User was created by another thread");
 97: 
 98: 
 99: 
100:                     existingUser = await _userRepository.GetUserByEmail(userDto.Email);
101:                     if (existingUser != null)
102:                     {
103:                         Console.WriteLine($"[USER SYNC] Found user created by another thread - ID: {existingUser.Id}");
104: 
105: 
106:                         existingUser.FirstName = userDto.FirstName;
107:                         existingUser.LastName = userDto.LastName;
108: 
109:                         if (existingUser.ActorId != null)
110:                         {
111:                             var actor = await _actorRepository.GetById(existingUser.ActorId.Value);
112:                             if (actor != null)
113:                             {
114:                                 actor.DisplayName = $"{userDto.FirstName} {userDto.LastName}".Trim();
115:                                 await _actorRepository.Update(actor);
116:                             }
117:                         }
118: 
119:                         await _userRepository.Update(existingUser);
120:                         response.Success = true;
121:                         response.Message = "User updated successfully (created by another request)";
122:                         response.Id = existingUser.Id;
123:                         await _cache.RemoveAsync($"user:detail:{existingUser.Id}", cancellationToken);
124:                         Console.WriteLine($"[USER SYNC] User updated after race condition - ID: {existingUser.Id}");
125:                         return response;
126:                     }
127: 
128:                     Console.WriteLine($"[USER SYNC] ERROR - Could not find user after race condition");
129:                     throw;
130:                 }
131: 
132: 
133:                 var newActor = new Actor
134:                 {
135:                     ActorTypeId = (int)ActorTypeEnum.User,
136:                     ActorType = null!,
137:                     TenantId = defaultTenantId,
138:                     Tenant = null!,
139:                     DisplayName = $"{userDto.FirstName} {userDto.LastName}".Trim(),
140:                     Handle = GenerateHandle(userDto.Username, userDto.Email),
141:                     Description = null,
142:                     UserId = user.Id,
143:                     OrganizationId = null
144:                 };
145: 
146:                 newActor = await _actorRepository.Create(newActor);
147:                 Console.WriteLine($"[USER SYNC] Actor created successfully - ID: {newActor.Id}");
148: 
149: 
150:                 user.ActorId = newActor.Id;
151:                 user.DefaultActorId = newActor.Id;
152:                 await _userRepository.Update(user);
153: 
154:                 response.Success = true;
155:                 response.Message = "User and Actor created successfully";
156:                 response.Id = user.Id;
157:                 await _cache.RemoveAsync($"user:detail:{user.Id}", cancellationToken);
158:                 Console.WriteLine($"[USER SYNC] User creation completed - ID: {user.Id}");
159:             }
160:             else
161:             {
162:                 Console.WriteLine($"[USER SYNC] Existing user found - Updating user ID: {existingUser.Id}");
163: 
164: 
165: 
166: 
167:                 existingUser.Email = userDto.Email;
168:                 existingUser.FirstName = userDto.FirstName;
169:                 existingUser.LastName = userDto.LastName;
170: 
171: 
172:                 if (existingUser.ActorId != null)
173:                 {
174:                     var actor = await _actorRepository.GetById(existingUser.ActorId.Value);
175:                     if (actor != null)
176:                     {
177:                         var newDisplayName = $"{userDto.FirstName} {userDto.LastName}".Trim();
178:                         if (actor.DisplayName != newDisplayName)
179:                         {
180:                             Console.WriteLine($"[USER SYNC] Updating actor display name from '{actor.DisplayName}' to '{newDisplayName}'");
181:                             actor.DisplayName = newDisplayName;
182:                             await _actorRepository.Update(actor);
183:                         }
184:                     }
185:                 }
186: 
187:                 await _userRepository.Update(existingUser);
188:                 response.Success = true;
189:                 response.Message = "User updated successfully";
190:                 response.Id = existingUser.Id;
191:                 await _cache.RemoveAsync($"user:detail:{existingUser.Id}", cancellationToken);
192:                 Console.WriteLine($"[USER SYNC] User update completed - ID: {existingUser.Id}");
193:             }
194:         }
195:         catch (Exception ex)
196:         {
197:             response.Success = false;
198:             response.Message = $"Error syncing user: {ex.Message}";
199:             Console.WriteLine($"[USER SYNC] ERROR - Exception occurred: {ex.GetType().Name}");
200:             Console.WriteLine($"[USER SYNC] ERROR - Message: {ex.Message}");
201:             Console.WriteLine($"[USER SYNC] ERROR - StackTrace: {ex.StackTrace}");
202: 
203:             if (ex.InnerException != null)
204:             {
205:                 Console.WriteLine($"[USER SYNC] ERROR - InnerException: {ex.InnerException.GetType().Name}");
206:                 Console.WriteLine($"[USER SYNC] ERROR - InnerException Message: {ex.InnerException.Message}");
207:             }
208:         }
209: 
210:         return response;
211:     }
212: 
213:     private async Task<Guid> GetDefaultTenantIdAsync()
214:     {
215: 
216:         var configuredTenantId = _configuration["DefaultTenantId"];
217:         if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(configuredTenantId) && Guid.TryParse(configuredTenantId, out var tenantId))
218:         {
219:             return tenantId;
220:         }
221: 
222: 
223:         var tenants = await _tenantRepository.GetAll();
224:         var defaultTenant = tenants.FirstOrDefault(t => t.IsActive);
225: 
226:         if (defaultTenant == null)
227:         {
228:             throw new InvalidOperationException("No active tenant found in the system.");
229:         }
230: 
231:         return defaultTenant.Id;
232:     }
233: 
234:     private static string GenerateHandle(string? username, string email)
235:     {
236: 
237:         if (!string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(username))
238:         {
239:             return username.ToLowerInvariant().Replace(" ", "-");
240:         }
241: 
242:         var emailPrefix = email.Split('@')[0];
243:         return emailPrefix.ToLowerInvariant().Replace(".", "-").Replace(" ", "-");
244:     }
245: }

 13: namespace Explore.Application.Features.Users.Handlers.Queries;
 14: 
 15: public class GetUserRequestHandler : IRequestHandler<GetUserRequest, UserDto>
 16: {
 17:     private readonly IUserRepository _userRepository;
 18:     private readonly IObjectStorageService _objectStorageService;
 19:     private readonly IMapper _mapper;
 20:     private readonly ILogger<GetUserRequestHandler> _logger;
 21:     private readonly HybridCache _cache;
 22: 
 23:     public GetUserRequestHandler(
 24:         IUserRepository userRepository,
 25:         IObjectStorageService objectStorageService,
 26:         IMapper mapper,
 27:         ILogger<GetUserRequestHandler> logger,
 28:         HybridCache cache)
 29:     {
 30:         _userRepository = userRepository;
 31:         _objectStorageService = objectStorageService;
 32:         _mapper = mapper;
 33:         _logger = logger;
 34:         _cache = cache;
 35:     }
 36: 
 37:     public async Task<UserDto> Handle(GetUserRequest request, CancellationToken cancellationToken)
 38:     {
 39:         var cacheKey = $"user:detail:{request.UserId}";
 40: 
 41:         var userDto = await _cache.GetOrCreateAsync(
 42:             cacheKey,
 43:             async _ =>
 44:             {
 45:                 var user = await _userRepository.GetUserWithDetails(request.UserId);
 46:                 if (user == null)
 47:                 {
 48:                     return null;
 49:                 }
 50: 
 51:                 var dto = _mapper.Map<UserDto>(user);
 52: 
 53:                 if (user.Actor?.ProfilePicture != null)
 54:                 {
 55:                     dto.ProfileImageKey = user.Actor.ProfilePicture.Uri;
 56:                     dto.ProfileImageUri = user.Actor.ProfilePicture.Uri;
 57:                 }
 58:                 else if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(user.Actor?.ProfilePictureUri))
 59:                 {
 60:                     dto.ProfileImageUri = user.Actor.ProfilePictureUri;
 61:                 }
 62: 
 63:                 return dto;
 64:             },
 65:             new HybridCacheEntryOptions
 66:             {
 67:                 Expiration = TimeSpan.FromMinutes(5),
 68:                 LocalCacheExpiration = TimeSpan.FromMinutes(1)
 69:             },
 70:             cancellationToken: cancellationToken);
 71: 
 72:         if (userDto != null && !string.IsNullOrEmpty(userDto.ProfileImageKey))
 73:         {
 74:             userDto.ProfileImageUri = ResolveImageUrl(userDto.ProfileImageKey);
 75:         }
 76: 
 77:         return userDto;
 78:     }
 79: 
 80:     private string? ResolveImageUrl(string? objectKeyOrUri)
 81:     {
 82:         if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(objectKeyOrUri))
 83:         {
 84:             return null;
 85:         }
 86: 
 87:         try
 88:         {
 89: 
 90:             if (objectKeyOrUri.StartsWith("http://") || objectKeyOrUri.StartsWith("https://"))
 91:             {
 92:                 if (Uri.TryCreate(objectKeyOrUri, UriKind.Absolute, out var uri))
 93:                 {
 94: 
 95:                     var objectKey = uri.AbsolutePath.TrimStart('/');
 96:                     return _objectStorageService.GeneratePresignedDownloadUrl(objectKey, 60);
 97:                 }
 98:                 _logger.LogWarning("Failed to parse legacy URL: {Uri}", objectKeyOrUri);
 99:                 return objectKeyOrUri;
100:             }
101: 
102: 
103:             return _objectStorageService.GeneratePresignedDownloadUrl(objectKeyOrUri, 60);
104:         }
105:         catch (Exception ex)
106:         {
107:             _logger.LogError(ex, "Failed to generate presigned URL for: {ObjectKeyOrUri}", objectKeyOrUri);
108:             return null;
109:         }
110:     }
111: }

````csharp
  1: using Amazon;
  2: using Amazon.S3;
  3: using Explore.Application.Contracts.Identity;
  4: using Explore.Application.Contracts.Infrastructure;
  5: using Explore.Application.Contracts.Strategies;
  6: using Explore.Application.Models;
  7: using Explore.Infrastructure.Identity;
  8: using Explore.Infrastructure.Mail;
  9: using Explore.Infrastructure.Services;
 10: using Explore.Infrastructure.Services.Federation;
 11: using Explore.Infrastructure.Strategies;
 12: using Microsoft.Extensions.Configuration;
 13: using Microsoft.Extensions.DependencyInjection;
 14: using Microsoft.Extensions.DependencyInjection.Extensions;
 15: using Microsoft.Extensions.Options;
 16: 
 17: namespace Explore.Infrastructure;
 18: 
 19: public static class InfrastructureServicesRegistration
 20: {
 21:     public static IServiceCollection ConfigureInfrastructureServices(this IServiceCollection services, IConfiguration configuration)
 22:     {
 23:         services.Configure<EmailSettings>(configuration.GetSection("EmailSettings"));
 24:         services.AddTransient<IEmailSender, EmailSender>();
 25: 
 26:         services.Configure<S3Settings>(configuration.GetSection("S3Settings"));
 27: 
 28:         services.AddSingleton<IAmazonS3>(sp =>
 29:         {
 30:             var s3Options = sp.GetRequiredService<IOptions<S3Settings>>().Value;
 31: 
 32:             if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(s3Options.AccessKeyId))
 33:             {
 34:                 throw new InvalidOperationException("S3 AccessKeyId is not configured (S3Settings:AccessKeyId).");
 35:             }
 36:             if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(s3Options.SecretAccessKey))
 37:             {
 38:                 throw new InvalidOperationException("S3 SecretAccessKey is not configured (S3Settings:SecretAccessKey).");
 39:             }
 40: 
 41:             var config = new AmazonS3Config
 42:             {
 43:                 ForcePathStyle = true
 44:             };
 45: 
 46:             if (!string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(s3Options.Endpoint))
 47:             {
 48:                 var endpoint = s3Options.Endpoint.Trim();
 49:                 if (!endpoint.StartsWith("http://", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase) &&
 50:                     !endpoint.StartsWith("https://", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase))
 51:                 {
 52:                     endpoint = $"https://{endpoint}";
 53:                 }
 54: 
 55:                 config.ServiceURL = endpoint;
 56:                 config.UseHttp = endpoint.StartsWith("http://", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase);
 57:                 config.AuthenticationRegion = string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(s3Options.Region) ? "fsn1" : s3Options.Region;
 58:             }
 59:             else
 60:             {
 61:                 if (!string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(s3Options.Region))
 62:                 {
 63:                     config.RegionEndpoint = RegionEndpoint.GetBySystemName(s3Options.Region);
 64:                 }
 65:                 else
 66:                 {
 67:                     config.RegionEndpoint = RegionEndpoint.EUWest1;
 68:                     Console.WriteLine("[S3] Warning: No Region or Endpoint configured in S3Settings. Using default region eu-west-1.");
 69:                 }
 70:             }
 71: 
 72:             return new AmazonS3Client(s3Options.AccessKeyId, s3Options.SecretAccessKey, config);
 73:         });
 74: 
 75:         services.AddTransient<IObjectStorageService, ObjectStorageService>();
 76: 
 77: 
 78:         services.AddScoped<IUserContext, UserContext>();
 79:         services.AddScoped<ICurrentUserService, CurrentUserService>();
 80: 
 81: 
 82:         services.AddMemoryCache();
 83: 
 84: 
 85:         services.AddScoped<ISettingsResolver, SettingsResolver>();
 86:         services.AddScoped<IModuleService, ModuleService>();
 87: 
 88: 
 89:         services.AddScoped<IEventStrategy, IslamicEventStrategy>();
 90:         services.AddScoped<IEventStrategy, TechEventStrategy>();
 91:         services.AddScoped<IStrategyResolver, StrategyResolver>();
 92: 
 93: 
 94:         services.Configure<PdsSyncSettings>(configuration.GetSection(PdsSyncSettings.SectionName));
 95:         services.AddHttpClient("PdsService");
 96:         services.AddScoped<IPdsService, PdsService>();
 97: 
 98: 
 99:         services.Configure<DeploymentSettings>(configuration.GetSection(DeploymentSettings.SectionName));
100: 
101:         return services;
102:     }
103: }

````csharp
  1: using System;
  2: using System.Collections.Generic;
  3: using System.IO;
  4: using System.Text;
  5: using Amazon.S3;
  6: using Amazon.S3.Model;
  7: using Explore.Application.Contracts.Infrastructure;
  8: using Explore.Application.DTOs.StorageObject;
  9: using FluentValidation;
 10: using Microsoft.Extensions.Options;
 11: 
 12: namespace Explore.Infrastructure.Services;
 13: 
 14: public class ObjectStorageService : IObjectStorageService
 15: {
 16:     private readonly IAmazonS3 _s3Client;
 17:     private readonly IAmazonS3 _presignClient;
 18:     private readonly S3Settings _s3Settings;
 19:     private const int UploadUrlExpirationMinutes = 40;
 20: 
 21:     public ObjectStorageService(IAmazonS3 s3Client, IOptions<S3Settings> s3Settings)
 22:     {
 23:         _s3Client = s3Client;
 24:         _s3Settings = s3Settings.Value;
 25:         _presignClient = CreatePresignClient(_s3Settings) ?? _s3Client;
 26:     }
 27: 
 28:     public Task<UploadUrlResponseDto> GeneratePresignedUploadUrl(string fileName, string contentType)
 29:     {
 30:         if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(fileName))
 31:             throw new ArgumentException("fileName must be provided", nameof(fileName));
 32:         if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(contentType))
 33:             throw new ArgumentException("contentType must be provided", nameof(contentType));
 34: 
 35:         if (_s3Settings == null)
 36:             throw new InvalidOperationException("S3 settings are not configured.");
 37: 
 38:         if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(_s3Settings.BucketName))
 39:             throw new InvalidOperationException("S3 bucket name is not configured (S3Settings:BucketName).");
 40: 
 41: 
 42:         var timestamp = DateTime.UtcNow.ToString("yyyyMMdd-HHmmss");
 43:         var uniqueId = Guid.NewGuid().ToString("N")[..8];
 44:         var extension = Path.GetExtension(fileName);
 45:         var sanitizedName = Path.GetFileNameWithoutExtension(fileName)
 46:             .Replace(" ", "-")
 47:             .ToLowerInvariant();
 48: 
 49:         var objectKey = $"uploads/{timestamp}/{uniqueId}-{sanitizedName}{extension}";
 50: 
 51:         var request = new GetPreSignedUrlRequest
 52:         {
 53:             BucketName = _s3Settings.BucketName,
 54:             Key = objectKey,
 55:             Verb = HttpVerb.PUT,
 56:             Expires = DateTime.UtcNow.AddMinutes(UploadUrlExpirationMinutes),
 57:             ContentType = contentType
 58:         };
 59: 
 60:         string? uploadUrl;
 61:         try
 62:         {
 63:             uploadUrl = _presignClient.GetPreSignedURL(request);
 64:         }
 65:         catch (Exception ex)
 66:         {
 67:             throw new InvalidOperationException("Failed to generate pre-signed upload URL. Verify S3 configuration and credentials.", ex);
 68:         }
 69: 
 70:         if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(uploadUrl))
 71:         {
 72:             throw new InvalidOperationException("Failed to generate pre-signed upload URL: the S3 client returned an empty URL. Verify bucket, endpoint and credentials.");
 73:         }
 74: 
 75: 
 76:         var viewUrl = ConstructViewUrl(objectKey);
 77: 
 78:         var response = new UploadUrlResponseDto
 79:         {
 80:             UploadUrl = uploadUrl,
 81:             ObjectKey = objectKey,
 82:             ViewUrl = viewUrl,
 83:             ExpiresInMinutes = UploadUrlExpirationMinutes
 84:         };
 85: 
 86:         return Task.FromResult(response);
 87:     }
 88: 
 89:     public async Task<(Stream FileStream, string ContentType)> GetFileStream(string fileKey)
 90:     {
 91:         if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(fileKey))
 92:             throw new ArgumentException("fileKey must be provided", nameof(fileKey));
 93: 
 94:         try
 95:         {
 96:             var request = new GetObjectRequest
 97:             {
 98:                 BucketName = _s3Settings.BucketName,
 99:                 Key = fileKey
100:             };
101: 
102:             var response = await _s3Client.GetObjectAsync(request);
103:             return (response.ResponseStream, response.Headers.ContentType);
104:         }
105:         catch (AmazonS3Exception ex) when (ex.StatusCode == System.Net.HttpStatusCode.NotFound)
106:         {
107:             throw new KeyNotFoundException($"S3 object not found. Key: {fileKey}", ex);
108:         }
109:     }
110: 
111:     Task<(Stream FileStream, string ContentType)> IObjectStorageService.GetFileStream(string fileKey)
112:         => GetFileStream(fileKey);
113: 
114:     public string GeneratePresignedDownloadUrl(string objectKey, int expirationMinutes = 60)
115:     {
116:         if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(objectKey))
117:             throw new ArgumentException("objectKey must be provided", nameof(objectKey));
118: 
119:         if (_s3Settings == null)
120:             throw new InvalidOperationException("S3 settings are not configured.");
121: 
122:         if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(_s3Settings.BucketName))
123:             throw new InvalidOperationException("S3 bucket name is not configured (S3Settings:BucketName).");
124: 
125:         var request = new GetPreSignedUrlRequest
126:         {
127:             BucketName = _s3Settings.BucketName,
128:             Key = objectKey,
129:             Verb = HttpVerb.GET,
130:             Expires = DateTime.UtcNow.AddMinutes(expirationMinutes)
131:         };
132: 
133:         string? downloadUrl;
134:         try
135:         {
136:             downloadUrl = _presignClient.GetPreSignedURL(request);
137:         }
138:         catch (Exception ex)
139:         {
140:             throw new InvalidOperationException("Failed to generate pre-signed download URL. Verify S3 configuration and credentials.", ex);
141:         }
142: 
143:         if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(downloadUrl))
144:         {
145:             throw new InvalidOperationException("Failed to generate pre-signed download URL: the S3 client returned an empty URL.");
146:         }
147: 
148:         return downloadUrl;
149:     }
150: 
151:     private string ConstructViewUrl(string objectKey)
152:     {
153: 
154: 
155: 
156: 
157: 
158: 
159:         return objectKey;
160:     }
161: 
162:     private static IAmazonS3? CreatePresignClient(S3Settings settings)
163:     {
164:         if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(settings.PublicEndpoint))
165:         {
166:             return null;
167:         }
168: 
169:         if (string.Equals(settings.PublicEndpoint.Trim(), settings.Endpoint?.Trim(), StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase))
170:         {
171:             return null;
172:         }
173: 
174:         var config = new AmazonS3Config
175:         {
176:             ForcePathStyle = true
177:         };
178: 
179:         var endpoint = settings.PublicEndpoint.Trim();
180:         if (!endpoint.StartsWith("http://", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase) &&
181:             !endpoint.StartsWith("https://", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase))
182:         {
183:             endpoint = $"https://{endpoint}";
184:         }
185: 
186:         config.ServiceURL = endpoint;
187:         config.UseHttp = endpoint.StartsWith("http://", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase);
188:         config.AuthenticationRegion = string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(settings.Region) ? "us-east-1" : settings.Region;
189: 
190:         return new AmazonS3Client(settings.AccessKeyId, settings.SecretAccessKey, config);
191:     }
192: }

## File: Explore.Persistence/Repositories/GenericRepository.cs
````csharp
  1: using System;
  2: using System.Collections.Generic;
  3: using System.Text;
  4: using Explore.Application.Contracts.Persistence;
  5: using Explore.Domain.Interfaces;
  6: using Microsoft.EntityFrameworkCore;
  7: using Npgsql;
  8: 
  9: namespace Explore.Persistence.Repositories;
 10: 
 11: public class GenericRepository<T, TKey> : IGenericRepository<T, TKey> where T : class
 12: {
 13:     private readonly ExploreDbContext _dbContext;
 14: 
 15:     public GenericRepository(ExploreDbContext dbContext)
 16:     {
 17:         _dbContext = dbContext;
 18:     }
 19: 
 20:     public async Task<T> Create(T entity)
 21:     {
 22:         try
 23:         {
 24:             await _dbContext.AddAsync(entity);
 25:             await _dbContext.SaveChangesAsync();
 26:             return entity;
 27:         }
 28:         catch (DbUpdateException ex) when (ex.InnerException is PostgresException pgEx && pgEx.SqlState == "23505")
 29:         {
 30: 
 31:             _dbContext.Entry(entity).State = EntityState.Detached;
 32:             throw new InvalidOperationException(
 33:                 $"A record with the same unique key already exists. Constraint: {pgEx.ConstraintName}. " +
 34:                 $"Detail: {pgEx.Detail}",
 35:                 ex);
 36:         }
 37:     }
 38: 
 39: 
 40: 
 41: 
 42: 
 43:     public async Task Delete(T entity)
 44:     {
 45: 
 46:         if (entity is ISoftDeletable)
 47:         {
 48: 
 49:             _dbContext.Entry(entity).State = EntityState.Deleted;
 50:             await _dbContext.SaveChangesAsync();
 51:         }
 52:         else
 53:         {
 54: 
 55:             _dbContext.Set<T>().Remove(entity);
 56:             await _dbContext.SaveChangesAsync();
 57:         }
 58:     }
 59: 
 60: 
 61: 
 62: 
 63: 
 64: 
 65:     public async Task HardDelete(T entity)
 66:     {
 67:         _dbContext.Set<T>().Remove(entity);
 68:         await _dbContext.SaveChangesAsync();
 69:     }
 70: 
 71:     public async Task<bool> Exists(TKey id)
 72:     {
 73:         var entity = await GetById(id);
 74:         return entity != null;
 75:     }
 76: 
 77:     public async Task<IReadOnlyList<T>> GetAll()
 78:     {
 79:         return await _dbContext.Set<T>().AsNoTracking().ToListAsync();
 80:     }
 81: 
 82:     public async Task<(IReadOnlyList<T> Items, int TotalCount)> GetAllPaged(int pageNumber, int pageSize)
 83:     {
 84:         var query = _dbContext.Set<T>().AsNoTracking();
 85:         var totalCount = await query.CountAsync();
 86:         var items = await query
 87:             .Skip((pageNumber - 1) * pageSize)
 88:             .Take(pageSize)
 89:             .ToListAsync();
 90:         return (items, totalCount);
 91:     }
 92: 
 93:     public async Task<T?> GetById(TKey id)
 94:     {
 95:         return await _dbContext.Set<T>().FindAsync(id);
 96:     }
 97: 
 98:     public async Task Update(T entity)
 99:     {
100:         _dbContext.Entry(entity).State = EntityState.Modified;
101:         await _dbContext.SaveChangesAsync();
102:     }
103: }
````

## File: docs/TROUBLESHOOTING.md
````markdown
  1: # Troubleshooting
  2: 
  3: > **Project-Agnostic .NET Backend Troubleshooting Guide**
  4: >
  5: > Placeholders use `{Placeholder}` syntax - see [TEMPLATE_GLOSSARY.md](TEMPLATE_GLOSSARY.md).
  6: 
  7: **Last Updated**: January 2026
  8: 
  9: ---
 10: 
 11: ## Placeholder Substitutions
 12: 
 13: | Placeholder | Replace With | Example (ISLAMU Event) |
 14: |-------------|--------------|------------------------|
 15: | `{Project}` | Your solution name | `Explore` |
 16: | `{Project}.API` | API project | `Explore.API` |
 17: | `{Project}.Application` | Application project | `Explore.Application` |
 18: | `{Project}.Domain` | Domain project | `Explore.Domain` |
 19: | `{Project}.Persistence` | Persistence project | `Explore.Persistence` |
 20: | `{Project}.Infrastructure` | Infrastructure project | `Explore.Infrastructure` |
 21: 
 22: ---
 23: 
 24: This guide focuses on common issues when working on the **backend** projects:
 25: 
 26: - `{Project}.API`
 27: - `{Project}.Application`
 28: - `{Project}.Domain`
 29: - `{Project}.Persistence`
 30: - `{Project}.Infrastructure`
 31: - Migration/worker services (if applicable)
 32: 
 33: ### Implementation Example: ISLAMU Event
 34: 
 35: ```
 36: - Explore.API
 37: - Explore.Application
 38: - Explore.Domain
 39: - Explore.Persistence
 40: - Explore.Infrastructure
 41: - Event.MigrationService
 42: ```
 43: 
 44: ## Build & Restore
 45: 
 46: ### Effective Commands for Error Visibility
 47: 
 48: Basic `dotnet build` and `dotnet test` hide important error details. Use these commands instead:
 49: 
 50: #### Building
 51: 
 52: ```bash
 53: # Clean summary with error/warning counts
 54: dotnet build --configuration Release --verbosity quiet
 55: 
 56: # Full error details when you need them
 57: dotnet build --configuration Release --verbosity normal
 58: ```
 59: 
 60: #### Running Tests
 61: 
 62: **Always run test projects individually** — solution-level `dotnet test` fails if any project has MSBuild issues (e.g., placeholder projects without a test framework).
 63: 
 64: ```bash
 65: # Clean pass/fail summary per project
 66: dotnet test --project Event.Application.UnitTests/Event.Application.UnitTests.csproj --configuration Release --verbosity quiet
 67: 
 68: # Inline error details
 69: dotnet test --project Event.API.IntegrationTests/Event.API.IntegrationTests.csproj --configuration Release --verbosity normal
 70: ```
 71: 
 72: **Important:** Always use `--project` flag. Positional project path (e.g., `dotnet test path.csproj`) does not work reliably — use `dotnet test --project path.csproj`.
 73: 
 74: #### Debugging Test Failures with TRX Reports
 75: 
 76: When you need detailed failure analysis (failed test names, error messages, stack traces), generate a TRX report:
 77: 
 78: ```bash
 79: # Generate TRX report
 80: dotnet test --project Event.API.IntegrationTests/Event.API.IntegrationTests.csproj --configuration Release -- --report-trx --report-trx-filename results.trx
 81: ```
 82: 
 83: **TRX file location:** `<ProjectDir>/bin/Release/net10.0/TestResults/results.trx`
 84: 
 85: **Analyzing the TRX file** (use Grep tool, not bash grep):
 86: 
 87: ```
 88: # Find all failed tests
 89: Grep pattern: outcome="Failed"
 90: 
 91: # Get full class.method names for failed tests
 92: Grep pattern: className=
 93: # Correlate testId from failed entries to className entries
 94: 
 95: # Read error messages and stack traces
 96: Grep pattern: <Message>
 97: Grep pattern: <StackTrace>
 98: ```
 99: 
100: **TRX workflow summary:**
101: 1. Generate TRX with `-- --report-trx --report-trx-filename results.trx`
102: 2. Grep for `outcome="Failed"` to find failed test entries and their `testId`
103: 3. Grep for `className=` with the `testId` to get the full `Namespace.Class.Method`
104: 4. Read the `<Message>` and `<StackTrace>` elements for error details
105: 
106: #### Test Projects (Run Individually)
107: 
108: ```bash
109: dotnet test --project Event.Application.UnitTests/Event.Application.UnitTests.csproj --configuration Release
110: dotnet test --project Event.Domain.UnitTests/Event.Domain.UnitTests.csproj --configuration Release
111: dotnet test --project Event.Architecture.Tests/Event.Architecture.Tests.csproj --configuration Release
112: dotnet test --project Explore.Secrets.UnitTests/Explore.Secrets.UnitTests.csproj --configuration Release
113: dotnet test --project Event.Persistence.IntegrationTests/Event.Persistence.IntegrationTests.csproj --configuration Release
114: dotnet test --project Event.API.IntegrationTests/Event.API.IntegrationTests.csproj --configuration Release
115: dotnet test --project Explore.Blazor.Client.Tests/Explore.Blazor.Client.Tests.csproj --configuration Release
116: ```
117: 
118: #### Known Pitfalls
119: 
120: | Pitfall | Solution |
121: |---------|----------|
122: | `dotnet test` at solution level fails | Run each test project individually |
123: | Positional project path doesn't work | Use `--project` flag: `dotnet test --project path.csproj` |
124: | `findstr /i` fails on French-locale Windows | Use exact case patterns instead of `/i` flag |
125: | `--treenode-filter` for TUnit filtering | Does not work reliably — use TRX reports instead |
126: | Running test DLL directly | Causes MSBuild errors — always test via `.csproj` |
127: | Basic `dotnet test` hides failures | Use `--verbosity normal` or TRX reports |
128: | Basic `dotnet build` hides errors | Use `--verbosity quiet` for summary or `normal` for details |
129: 
130: ### Common issues
131: 
132: #### Target framework / SDK mismatch
133: 
134: All backend projects target `net10.0`. If your SDK is older, install the .NET 10 SDK.
135: 
136: #### "The type or namespace name 'X' could not be found"
137: 
138: Typical causes:
139: 
140: - Missing `using` (do not remove existing usings)
141: - Missing project reference (check `.csproj`)
142: - Wrong layer dependency (see `docs/ARCHITECTURE.md` and `docs/QUICK_REFERENCE.md`)
143: 
144: ## OpenAPI / Swagger / Scalar
145: 
146: ### Swagger UI loads but endpoints are missing metadata
147: 
148: Controllers should annotate actions with:
149: 
150: - `[EndpointSummary]`
151: - `[EndpointDescription]`
152: - `[ProducesResponseType]`
153: 
154: See `docs/API.md`.
155: 
156: ### swagger.json file is stale
157: 
158: In Development, `{Project}.API` runs `OpenApiExportService` which exports a `swagger.json` file at startup.
159: 
160: If it doesn't update:
161: 
162: - Ensure `{Project}.API` starts successfully in Development.
163: - Check startup logs for the hosted service.
164: - Confirm the file is not locked by another process.
165: 
166: **Example (ISLAMU Event)**: `Explore.API` exports `swagger.json` to `Explore.API/swagger.json`
167: 
168: ## Authentication / Authorization
169: 
170: ### 401 Unauthorized on write endpoints
171: 
172: - Ensure you are sending `Authorization: Bearer <token>`.
173: - Confirm Keycloak settings in configuration match your environment.
174: 
175: ### UserId missing in token
176: 
177: Controllers that require a user id MUST use the fallback claim extraction:
178: 
179: `sub` → `http://schemas.xmlsoap.org/ws/2005/05/identity/claims/nameidentifier` → `sid`
180: 
181: If all are missing, return `401`.
182: 
183: ## Database / EF Core / Migrations
184: 
185: ### Apply migrations (Development)
186: 
187: `{Project}.API` exposes a Development-only endpoint:
188: 
189: ```http
190: POST /admin/migrate
191: ```
192: 
193: It is protected with `.RequireAuthorization()`.
194: 
195: **Example (ISLAMU Event)**: `Explore.API` provides `POST /admin/migrate`
196: 
197: ### Migration worker (if applicable)
198: 
199: If your project has a dedicated migration service, it's responsible for background migration/maintenance tasks.
200: 
201: **Example (ISLAMU Event)**: `Event.MigrationService` handles background migrations (see `Event.MigrationService/Program.cs`)
202: 
203: ### Duplicate key violations
204: 
205: `GenericRepository.Create` catches PostgreSQL unique constraint violations (`SqlState == "23505"`) and rethrows with more context.
206: 
207: If you see duplicate key errors:
208: 
209: - Check unique constraints in EF configurations/migrations.
210: - Verify seed data and id generation.
211: 
212: 
213: ### Development URLs (Default)
214: 
215: | Service | URL |
216: |---------|-----|
217: | Aspire Dashboard | `https://localhost:17225` |
218: | API | `https://localhost:7001` |
219: | Blazor | `https://localhost:7002` |
220: | Scalar API Docs | `https://localhost:7001/scalar/v1` |
221: | Swagger UI | `https://localhost:7001/swagger` |
````

 21:         _mediator = mediator;

 23: 
 24: 
 25:

 27: 
 28: 
 29:     [HttpPost("sync")]
 30:     [Authorize]
 31:     [EndpointSummary("Sync user from Keycloak")]
 32:     [EndpointDescription("Creates or updates the user in the local database. Also creates the user's personal Actor if new user. Call this after login/registration.")]
 33:     public async Task<ActionResult<BaseCommandResponse<Guid>>> SyncUser(CancellationToken cancellationToken = default)
 34:     {
 35:         var userId = User.FindFirst("sub")?.Value
 36:                      ?? User.FindFirst(ClaimTypes.NameIdentifier)?.Value;
 37: 
 38:         if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(userId) || !Guid.TryParse(userId, out var guidUserId))
 39:         {
 40:             return BadRequest(new BaseCommandResponse<Guid>
 41:             {
 42:                 Success = false,
 43:                 Message = "Invalid User ID in token",
 44:                 Errors = new List<string> { "Could not parse user ID from authentication token." }
 45:             });
 46:         }
 47: 
 48:         var email = User.FindFirst("email")?.Value
 49:                     ?? User.FindFirst(ClaimTypes.Email)?.Value ?? "";
 50: 
 51:         var firstName = User.FindFirst("given_name")?.Value
 52:                         ?? User.FindFirst(ClaimTypes.GivenName)?.Value ?? "";
 53: 
 54:         var lastName = User.FindFirst("family_name")?.Value
 55:                        ?? User.FindFirst(ClaimTypes.Surname)?.Value ?? "";
 56: 
 57:         var username = User.FindFirst("preferred_username")?.Value
 58:                        ?? User.FindFirst(ClaimTypes.Name)?.Value ?? "";
 59: 
 60:         // Validate required fields
 61:         if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(email))
 62:         {
 63:             return BadRequest(new BaseCommandResponse<Guid>
 64:             {
 65:                 Success = false,
 66:                 Message = "Email is required",
 67:                 Errors = new List<string> { "Email claim not found in token." }
 68:             });
 69:         }
 70: 
 71:         var userDto = new UserDto
 72:         {
 73:             Id = guidUserId,
 74:             Email = email,
 75:             FirstName = string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(firstName) ? "User" : firstName,
 76:             LastName = string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(lastName) ? "" : lastName,
 77:             Username = username
 78:         };
 79: 
 80:         var command = new SyncUserCommand { UserDto = userDto };
 81:         var response = await _mediator.Send(command, cancellationToken);
 82: 
 83:         if (!response.Success)
 84:         {
 85:             return BadRequest(response);
 86:         }
 87: 
 88:         return Ok(response);
 89:     }

 91:     [HttpGet]
 92:     [Authorize]
 93:     public async Task<ActionResult<UserDto>> GetCurrentUser(CancellationToken cancellationToken = default)
 94:     {
 95:         var userId = User.FindFirst("sub")?.Value
 96:                      ?? User.FindFirst(ClaimTypes.NameIdentifier)?.Value;
 97: 
 98:         if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(userId) || !Guid.TryParse(userId, out var guidUserId))
 99:         {
100:             return BadRequest("Invalid User ID in token");
101:         }
102: 
103:         var query = new GetUserRequest { UserId = guidUserId };
104:         var user = await _mediator.Send(query, cancellationToken);
105: 
106: 
107:         if (user == null)
108:         {
109:             Console.WriteLine($"[USER API] User not found in database: {guidUserId}");
110:             return NotFound(new
111:             {
112:                 message = "User not found in database. Please refresh the page to sync your profile.",
113:                 userId = guidUserId
114:             });
115:         }
116: 
117:         Console.WriteLine($"[USER API] User found: {user.Email}");
118:         return Ok(user);
119:     }

134: 
135:         if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(currentUserId) || !Guid.TryParse(currentUserId, out var guidCurrentUserId))
136:         {
137:             return Unauthorized("Invalid User ID in token");
138:         }
139: 
140: 
141: 
142:         if (userId != guidCurrentUserId)
143:         {
144:             return Forbid("You can only view your own organizations");
145:         }

147:         Console.WriteLine($"[USER API] Getting organizations for user: {userId}");
148:

## File: Explore.Application/Features/Events/Handlers/Queries/GetEventListRequestHandler.cs
````csharp
 1: using System;
 2: using System.Collections.Generic;
 3: using System.Text;
 4: using AutoMapper;
 5: using Explore.Application.Contracts.Infrastructure;
 6: using Explore.Application.Contracts.Persistence;
 7: using Explore.Application.DTOs.Event;
 8: using Explore.Application.Features.Events.Requests.Queries;
 9: using Explore.Application.Responses;
10: using MediatR;
11: using Microsoft.Extensions.Caching.Hybrid;
12: using Microsoft.Extensions.Logging;
13: 
14: namespace Explore.Application.Features.Events.Handlers.Queries;
15: 
16: public class GetEventListRequestHandler : IRequestHandler<GetEventListRequest, PaginatedResult<EventListDto>>
17: {
18:     private readonly IEventRepository _eventRepository;
19:     private readonly IMapper _mapper;
20:     private readonly IObjectStorageService _objectStorageService;
21:     private readonly ILogger<GetEventListRequestHandler> _logger;
22:     private readonly HybridCache _cache;
23: 
24:     public GetEventListRequestHandler(
25:         IEventRepository eventRepository,
26:         IMapper mapper,
27:         IObjectStorageService objectStorageService,
28:         ILogger<GetEventListRequestHandler> logger,
29:         HybridCache cache)
30:     {
31:         _eventRepository = eventRepository;
32:         _mapper = mapper;
33:         _objectStorageService = objectStorageService;
34:         _logger = logger;
35:         _cache = cache;
36:     }
37: 
38:     public async Task<PaginatedResult<EventListDto>> Handle(GetEventListRequest request, CancellationToken cancellationToken)
39:     {
40:         var cacheKey = $"events:list:{request.PageNumber}:{request.PageSize}";
41:         var cachedResult = await _cache.GetOrCreateAsync(
42:             cacheKey,
43:             async _ =>
44:             {
45:                 var (events, totalCount) = await _eventRepository.GetEventsWithDetailsPaged(request.PageNumber, request.PageSize);
46:                 var eventDtos = _mapper.Map<List<EventListDto>>(events);
47:                 return PaginatedResult<EventListDto>.Create(eventDtos, totalCount, request.PageNumber, request.PageSize);
48:             },
49:             new HybridCacheEntryOptions
50:             {
51:                 Expiration = TimeSpan.FromMinutes(5),
52:                 LocalCacheExpiration = TimeSpan.FromMinutes(1)
53:             },
54:             cancellationToken: cancellationToken);
55: 
56: 
57:         foreach (var dto in cachedResult.Items)
58:         {
59:             dto.FeaturedImageUri = ResolveImageUrl(dto.FeaturedImageUri);
60:             dto.ActorProfilePictureUri = ResolveImageUrl(dto.ActorProfilePictureUri);
61:         }
62: 
63:         return cachedResult;
64:     }
65: 
66: 
67: 
68: 
69: 
70:     private string? ResolveImageUrl(string? objectKeyOrUri)
71:     {
72:         if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(objectKeyOrUri))
73:             return null;
74: 
75:         try
76:         {
77: 
78:             if (objectKeyOrUri.StartsWith("http://", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase) ||
79:                 objectKeyOrUri.StartsWith("https://", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase))
80:             {
81: 
82:                 if (Uri.TryCreate(objectKeyOrUri, UriKind.Absolute, out var uri))
83:                 {
84:                     var objectKey = uri.AbsolutePath.TrimStart('/');
85:                     return _objectStorageService.GeneratePresignedDownloadUrl(objectKey, 60);
86:                 }
87:                 return objectKeyOrUri;
88:             }
89: 
90: 
91:             return _objectStorageService.GeneratePresignedDownloadUrl(objectKeyOrUri, 60);
92:         }
93:         catch (Exception ex)
94:         {
95:             _logger.LogError(ex, "Failed to generate presigned URL for object key: {ObjectKey}", objectKeyOrUri);
96:             return null;
97:         }
98:     }
99: }
````

 1: using Explore.Application.Contracts.Persistence;

 3: using Microsoft.EntityFrameworkCore;
 4: 
 5: namespace Explore.Persistence.Repositories;
 6: 
 7: public class OrganizationReviewRepository : GenericRepository<OrganizationReview, Guid>, IOrganizationReviewRepository
 8: {
 9:     private readonly ExploreDbContext _dbContext;
10: 
11:     public OrganizationReviewRepository(ExploreDbContext dbContext) : base(dbContext)
12:     {
13:         _dbContext = dbContext;
14:     }
15: 
16:     public async Task<List<OrganizationReview>> GetByOrganizationId(Guid organizationId)
17:     {
18:         return await _dbContext.Set<OrganizationReview>()
19:             .AsNoTracking()
20:             .Where(r => r.OrganizationId == organizationId)
21:             .OrderByDescending(r => r.CreatedAt)
22:             .ToListAsync();
23:     }
24: 
25:     public async Task<List<OrganizationReview>> GetByUserId(Guid userId)
26:     {
27:         return await _dbContext.Set<OrganizationReview>()
28:             .AsNoTracking()
29:             .Include(r => r.Event)
30:             .Where(r => r.UserId == userId)
31:             .OrderByDescending(r => r.CreatedAt)
32:             .ToListAsync();
33:     }
34: 
35:     public async Task<bool> HasUserReviewedProgram(Guid userId, Guid programId)
36:     {
37:         return await _dbContext.Set<OrganizationReview>()
38:             .AsNoTracking()
39:             .AnyAsync(r => r.UserId == userId && r.EventId == programId);
40:     }
41: }

## File: README.md
````markdown
  1: <a name="readme-top"></a>
  2: 
  3: <div align="center">
  4: 
  5: # ISLAMU Event
  6: 
  7: # Event Platform & Management System in Heavy Development
  8: 
  9: ISLAMU Event is a self-hostable, decentralized, multi-tenant event platform for any community or industry. 
 10: The ISLAMU organization hosts a public instance focused on Islamic events, but the software itself is purpose-agnostic, fully white-label, and designed to be rebranded for any use case.
 11: 
 12: ![GitHub Workflow Status][github-workflow-status-shield]
 13: [![Codecov][codecov-shield]][codecov-link]
 14: [![Quality Gate Status][sonarcloud-shield]][sonarcloud-link]
 15: [![GitHub License][github-license-shield]][github-license-link]
 16: [![GitHub Repo Stars][github-stars-shield]][github-stars-link]
 17: [![GitHub Last Commit][github-last-commit-shield]][github-last-commit-link]
 18: [![Contributors][github-contributors-shield]][github-contributors-link]
 19: [![Discussions][github-discussions-shield]][github-discussions-link]
 20: [![Discord][discord-shield]][discord-link]
 21: 
 22: [**ISLAMU's Islamic Instance**][islamu-platform] · [**Docs**](docs/index.md) · [**Roadmap**][roadmap-link]
 23: 
 24: </div>
 25: 
 26: ---
 27: 
 28: ## ℹ About ISLAMU Event
 29: 
 30: ISLAMU Event is an Event Platform & Management System built for both allowing the best Event Discovery and Event Management Experience.
 31: 
 32: > Give us a Star ⭐️
 33: 
 34: - **The software is general-purpose**: it can be used for any kind of Events, Communities, and Organizations.
 35: - **The ISLAMU-hosted instance is Islamic-focused**: ISLAMU’s public instance is curated for Islamic Events and Community needs.
 36: 
 37: ## ✨ Why ISLAMU Event
 38: 
 39: ### Key Differentiators
 40: 
 41: - **🌍 Decentralized by Design:** Federation-ready architecture with ATProto / ActivityPub planned
 42: - **🔐 Privacy-First:** Self-hostable with complete data ownership
 43: - **🎯 Cultural Intelligence:** Advanced filtering by madhab, gender, age, and prayer times
 44: - **🛡️ Verified Organizations:** Two-tier verification system for trust and quality
 45: - **Runtime Mode Switching** Single-tenant ↔ Multi-tenant without code changes
 46: - **Policy-Based Rendering** Blazor render modes controlled by policy, not hardcoded
 47: - **📖 Open Source:** AGPL-3.0 licensed for transparency and community ownership
 48: 
 49: ---
 50: 
 51: ## 🎯 Core Features
 52: 
 53: ### For Event Seekers
 54: 
 55: - **🔍 Powerful discovery** Search & filter events with location, category, language, and time filters
 56: - **👨‍👩‍👧‍👦 Culturally-aware filters** (e.g., audience, gender, prayer-relative timing) for instances that need them
 57: - **🌐 Multi-language support** for global communities
 58: - **📱 Mobile-friendly experience** across devices
 59: 
 60: ### For Event Organizers
 61: 
 62: - **📅 Multi-session events** for conferences, seminars, and recurring programs
 63: - **✅ Verification system** to build trust and credibility
 64: - **📊 Analytics and engagement tracking** for organizers
 65: - **Flexible publishing policies** (open, approval-based, or invite-only)
 66: - **Event Extensibility** 
 67: 
 68: ### For Platform Owners
 69: 
 70: - **🐳 Docker-Ready** One-command deployment with docker-compose
 71: - **💼 Single or Multi-Tenancy Support**
 72: - **🛠️ Full white-label control** (branding, domain, instance identity)
 73: - **Configurable policies** Choose who can publish, verification criteria, categories, and more
 74: - **Federation-ready architecture** with ATProto / ActivityPub planned
 75: - **📚 Comprehensive Docs** for deployment, customization, and operation
 76: 
 77: ##  Deployment & Hosting Options
 78: 
 79: This platform is designed to be flexible and self-hostable for any organization.
 80: 
 81: - **Single-Instance Mode**: One organization or community per deployment
 82: - **Multi-Tenant SaaS Mode**: Multiple isolated tenants with custom domains and branding
 83: 
 84: See [Operations Guide][operations-doc] for full deployment details and examples.
 85: 
 86: ## 🎨 Branding & Customization
 87: 
 88: ISLAMU Event is built for white-label use:
 89: 
 90: - **Change instance name and domain**
 91: - **Customize logos, colors, and UI**
 92: - **Define your own categories, tags, and policies**
 93: - **Decide who can publish events and how verification works**
 94: 
 95: See [Configuration Guide][configuration-doc] for full customization options.
 96: 
 97: ## 🛡️ Enterprise Security & Compliance
 98: 
 99: We treat security as a first-class citizen, not an afterthought.
100: 
101: * **Identity & Access:** Managed via **Keycloak**, supporting MFA, Social Login, and SAML/LDAP integration.
102: * **Authorization:** Fine-grained access control (FGAC) powered by **Cerbos**: Policy Decision Point that coordinates unified policy-based authorization, allowing for complex "Who can do what" logic with human readable yaml for non technical users.
103: * **Data Integrity:** All database interactions use **Parameterized EF Core queries** to eliminate SQL injection.
104: * **Secret Management:** Zero hardcoded credentials; all secrets are injected at runtime via **Infisical**.
105: * **Observability:** Integrated **OpenTelemetry** for distributed tracing and real-time security monitoring.
106: 
107: ### Security Features
108: 
109: - **🔒 HTTPS Enforcement:** All traffic encrypted with HSTS
110: - **🔐 Modern Authentication:** OAuth 2.0/OIDC via Keycloak
111: - **🗝️ Secret Management:** Infisical vault for credentials
112: - **🛡️ Authorization:** Policy-based access control via Cerbos
113: - **🔍 Input Validation:** FluentValidation + ASP.NET Core model binding
114: - **🚫 SQL Injection Prevention:** Parameterized queries (EF Core)
115: - **🌐 CORS:** Configurable origin whitelist
116: - **⏱️ Rate Limiting:** ASP.NET Core middleware
117: 
118: ### Extensibility Model
119: 
120: Events use **composition over inheritance**:
121: 
122: ```
123: Event (Core)
124:   ├── IslamicDetails (optional aspect)
125:   ├── TechDetails (optional aspect)
126:   └── EducationalDetails (optional aspect)
127: ```
128: 
129: A "Ramadan Tech Workshop" has both Islamic and Tech aspects. No class explosion.
130: 
131: See [EXTENSIBILITY.md](docs/EXTENSIBILITY.md) and [MODULAR_EVENTS.md](docs/MODULAR_EVENTS.md).
132:

134: 
135: ### 🌐 Use Our Hosted Instance
136:

138: - Browse events (no account needed)
139: - Create account to post events
140: - Register for events
141: - Follow organizations

143: ### 🖥️ Self-Host Your Instance (Advanced)
144:

150: docker-compose up -d
151: 
152: # Start the full stack (API, DB, Auth, UI, Object Storage...)
153: docker-compose up --profile storage -d
154: 
155: 
156: ```
157:

229: ## 🏗️ Technical Overview
230: 
231: ISLAMU Event is built on **Clean Architecture + CQRS** with a **BFF (Backend-for-Frontend)** pattern.
232: 
233: ### Stack
234: 
235: [- **Backend**: .NET 10, ASP.NET Core, MediatR, EF Core
236: - **Frontend**: Blazor Server + WASM, MudBlazor
237: - **Database**: PostgreSQL + PostGIS
238: - **AuthN**: Keycloak (OIDC/OAuth2)(Core: .NET 10 (LTS) & ASP.NET Core
239: - **AuthZ**: Cerbos (Policy Decision Point)
240: - **Secrets**: Infisical Vault
241: - **Observability**: Serilog, OpenTelemetry
242: 
243: ### The Request Lifecycle (CQRS)
244: We utilize **MediatR** for a decoupled command/query pipeline. This ensures that our business logic is isolated from transport layers (API/Blazor).
245: 
246: ```mermaid
247: graph TD
248:     subgraph Client_Layer [Presentation]
249:         A[Blazor WASM / Mobile] -->|HTTPS/REST| B[ASP.NET Core API]
250:     end
251: 
252:     subgraph Application_Layer [Business Logic]
253:         B -->|Command/Query| C[MediatR Pipeline]
254:         C -->|Validation| D[FluentValidation]
255:         D -->|Execution| E[Domain Handler]
256:     end
257: 
258:     subgraph Infrastructure_Layer [Data & Services]
259:         E -->|EF Core| F[(PostgreSQL + PostGIS)]
260:         E -->|OIDC| G[Keycloak]
261:         E -->|Events| H[Svix Webhooks]
262:     end
263: 
264:     E -.->|Future| I[ATProto / ActivityPub Gateway]
265: ```
266: 
267: ```mermaid
268: graph LR
269:     A[Request] --> B[Controller]
270:     B --> C[MediatR]
271:     C --> D[Handler]
272:     D --> E[Repository]
273:     E --> F[(PostgreSQL)]
274:     D --> G[Response]
275: ```
276:
